16: 
17: | Module | Upstream role | AURA disposition |
18: | --- | --- | --- |
19: | `:app` | Android UI, app lifecycle, dependency injection, Room, Media3 service, widgets and integrations | Retain and rework for AURA local playback |
20: | `:innertube` | YouTube Music/Innertube networking and extraction | Remove from AURA runtime/build |
21: | `:jiosaavn` | JioSaavn search/streaming integration | Remove from AURA runtime/build |
22: | `:spotify` | Spotify API/Canvas integration | Remove from AURA runtime/build |
23: | `:lastfm` | Last.fm integration/scrobbling | Remove from AURA runtime/build |
24: | `:kizzy` | Discord rich-presence integration | Remove from AURA runtime/build |
25: | `:shazamkit` | ShazamKit integration | Remove from AURA runtime/build |
26: | `:artistvideo` | Artist-video feature | Remove from AURA runtime/build |
27: | `:Motionartwork` | Motion artwork/Canvas provider | Remove from AURA runtime/build |
28: | `:lyricsProvider` | Online lyrics providers/scraping | Remove from AURA runtime/build; retain only sidecar/local lyrics support if needed |
29: 
30: The exact dependency edges and unused code should be rechecked as each module is detached; deleting source modules before Gradle references and UI entry points are removed risks breaking compilation.
31: 
32: ## Architecture findings
33: 
34: ### Dependency injection
35: 
36: The app is Hilt-based. `app/src/main/kotlin/com/music/vivi/di/AppModule.kt` supplies application-level dependencies, including cache-related objects. Feature and persistence services are injected into ViewModels and the playback service. AURA should keep Hilt and bind local catalog/scanner and local-file access abstractions rather than online providers.
37: 
38: ### Database and persistence
39: 
40: `app/src/main/kotlin/com/music/vivi/db/MusicDatabase.kt` and `DatabaseDao.kt` define the Room database and queries. Upstream already has catalog-oriented song/album/artist/playlist data and database migrations. Playback queue/player state is persisted through the existing preference/state layer. The upstream database is designed primarily around remote catalog IDs and metadata; local URI, stable file identity, folder membership, and scan state are not established as a complete local-library model. Prefer additive schema changes with migrations, not destructive recreation.
41: 
42: M3U import/export exists in `BackupRestoreViewModel.kt` and `utils/PlaylistExporter.kt`, but it is oriented around playlist/catalog metadata and does not provide complete robust resolution of local filesystem entries into playable tracks. AURA needs path/URI-aware import/export and missing-file handling.
43: 
44: ### Playback
45: 
46: `playback/MusicService.kt` uses Media3 and persists playback state; `MediaLibrarySessionCallback.kt` exposes a media library/session. Existing media item construction (`extensions/MediaItemExt.kt`) assumes upstream media identities and can participate in remote stream resolution. AURA must ensure that queue items use local content URIs and that the service resolves only locally authorized media, with notification/background playback and restart restoration retained.
47: 
48: No local-device media scanner or end-to-end local-file playback path was found in the audited app source. Local permission handling, MediaStore indexing, folder browsing and selection, and `.lrc` sidecar discovery are gaps.
49: 
50: ### UI, navigation, and theme
51: 
52: The interface is a large Jetpack Compose application with player, library, search, settings, playlist, online integration, and updater routes. `ui/screens/NavigationBuilder.kt` includes online integrations. The theme is defined in `ui/theme/Theme.kt`, including Material You/dynamic color behavior. AURA requires its own monochrome palette/assets and a pared-down primary navigation for Home, Search, Library and Settings. Search should only search the indexed local catalog.
53: 
54: Canvas is overloaded in upstream source to refer both to the online animated artwork feature and to Compose drawing primitives. Removing animated online Canvas artwork must not remove Compose `Canvas` uses for sliders, lyric rendering, or other local UI drawing.
55: 
56: ## Requirement-by-requirement gap analysis
57: 
58: | Requirement | Status at upstream revision | Evidence / work required |
59: | --- | --- | --- |
60: | GPL-3.0 derivative with upstream history and remote preserved | Exists as foundation | Repository has upstream history and `origin`; retain LICENSE and relevant copyright notices, document AURA modifications and attribution. |
61: | AURA Music name, monochrome identity and assets | Missing | Project/app branding remains Vivi Music; update app labels, icons, splash/metadata, theme and documentation without removing upstream notices. |
62: | Local-only operation; no network audio/metadata acquisition | Missing | Innertube, JioSaavn, Spotify and lyrics provider integrations are included. Remove dependencies/routes and ensure local player has no network fallback. |
63: | Local device audio scanning/indexing | Missing | No complete MediaStore scanner was found. Implement permission-aware scan, refresh and catalog persistence. |
64: | Folder browsing | Missing | Build a local folder view backed by indexed local URIs/paths. |
65: | Local file playback | Missing | Existing Media3 session/player is reusable, but local content URI construction/resolution is not a full app path. |
66: | M3U import/export for local tracks | Partial | Import/export utilities exist, but local paths, URI permissions, unavailable items and local queue mapping need implementation and tests. |
67: | Local `.lrc` lyrics | Missing | Existing lyrics are provider/online oriented; implement same-directory sidecar lookup and timed/plain text parsing. |
68: | Persistent queue and playback position | Partial / present | Existing database/preferences and service persist player state. Verify restart restoration specifically for local content URIs and update/add regression tests. |
69: | Home, Search, Library, Settings navigation | Partial | Equivalent navigation and settings exist among larger online-oriented surfaces; simplify and rewire search/library to local data only. |
70: | Remove Discord presence | Present upstream; remove | `:kizzy` and associated preferences/service/UI must not be included. |
71: | Remove animated Canvas/artwork online features | Present upstream; remove | `:Motionartwork`, Spotify Canvas, artwork fetching and related settings/routes; retain ordinary Compose drawing Canvas. |
72: | Remove analytics and crash telemetry | No targeted analytics/crash SDK found in inspected app source | No Firebase Analytics/Crashlytics, Sentry, Amplitude or PostHog symbols were found by the initial targeted search. Recheck all dependencies, manifest providers and build plugins before claiming removal. |
73: | Remove OTA/updater | Present upstream; remove | Updater workers, download/install flows, release checks, update routes/notifications and update-specific permissions should be removed. |
74: | Remove hard-coded online credentials | Present upstream; remove | Last.fm values in `app/build.gradle.kts` must be deleted along with the provider integration. |
75: | Tests for local behavior and retained behavior | Missing for new functionality | Keep applicable upstream tests; add scanner, M3U, lyrics, URI playback/persistence tests and run available test/build tasks per stage. |
76: 
77: ## Removal and retention policy
78: 
79: Remove networking and online service integrations, not useful local Android infrastructure. Retain the Media3 playback service/session, Room and migrations, queue state, local playlist management, notification/background playback, widgets only if they work wholly from local data, and Compose drawing primitives. Explicitly document removed features and do not leave reachable UI routes or hidden background work for the removed services.
80: 
81: ## Staged implementation and verification
82: 
83: Changes are intended to be split into small buildable commits: (1) audit/branding and app identity; (2) offline scope and online feature detachment; (3) local catalog/scanning and folder UI; (4) local playback and persistent queue; (5) local playlists and lyrics; (6) final navigation/theme/docs and full requirement review. Each stage should run its narrow tests and compile check before committing. The baseline build is not evidence that the AURA modifications compile.

## Objective
- Build AURA Music as a GPL-3.0 local-only derivative of `vivizzz007/vivi-music`, preserving upstream history and remote.
- Audit upstream, implement and verify the app in buildable stages, and document removals, attribution, gaps, and test/build results.

## Requirements
- Document upstream architecture, DI, database, playback service, theme, SDK levels, UI, and requirement-by-requirement gaps.
- Rebrand as AURA Music with monochrome styling/assets while retaining upstream copyright notices and GPL-3.0 attribution.
- Remove or exclude streaming/scraping, presence, online Canvas artwork, telemetry/crash reporting, and OTA features; document removals.
- Support local files, scanning, folders, M3U import/export, local lyrics, persistent queue/position, and Home/Search/Library/Settings navigation.
- Retain relevant tests, add tests for new code, and build and commit each stage.

## Decisions
- Use `/tmp/opencode/aura-upstream` as the working clone; retain upstream history and `origin` (`https://github.com/vivizzz007/vivi-music.git`).
- Use local Git author identity `AURA Agent <aura-agent@users.noreply.github.com>`.

## Work State
### Completed
- Verified upstream baseline build and committed architecture/gap audit as `12fff80d docs(audit): document upstream architecture and AURA gaps`.
- Implemented AURA identity and monochrome branding; build passed and changes committed as `2eac54c8 chore(branding): rebrand app as AURA Music`.
- Removed automatic updater checks from launch and Settings entry, plus new-release worker scheduling; documented and committed as `0fbd7791 chore(offline): disable automatic update checks`.
- The working tree was clean after the latest commit.

### Active
- Detach online routes, settings, startup integrations, and playback-service hooks in buildable stages while preserving local playback, Room, WorkManager backup, notifications, and Compose drawing.
- Implement and test local-media scanning/playback, folders, playlists, lyrics, and navigation; finish removal/gap documentation.

### Blocked
- (none)

## Next Move
1. Remove online startup integrations from `App.kt` and detach online routes/settings entry points, tracing all callers before deleting modules.
2. Remove service and UI hooks for streaming, Listen Together, Last.fm, Discord, SponsorBlock, Spotify Canvas, and remote artwork while preserving local playback and Android infrastructure.
3. Remove unused modules/dependencies only after app call sites are detached; reassess app-owned Ktor consumers individually.
4. Implement and test local media requirements; complete documentation and verification.

## Relevant Files
- `/tmp/opencode/aura-upstream/docs/AURA_IMPLEMENTATION_LOG.md`: records completed stages and verification.
- `/tmp/opencode/aura-upstream/docs/AURA_UPSTREAM_AUDIT.md`: architecture, gaps, module map, and removal/retention policy.
- `/tmp/opencode/aura-upstream/app/src/main/kotlin/com/music/vivi/App.kt`: remaining YouTube, Spotify, Last.fm, proxy, and related startup integrations.
- `/tmp/opencode/aura-upstream/app/src/main/kotlin/com/music/vivi/ui/screens/NavigationBuilder.kt`: online, updater, integration, and recognition routes.
- `/tmp/opencode/aura-upstream/app/src/main/kotlin/com/music/vivi/playback/MusicService.kt`: Media3 playback mixed with online-service hooks.
- `/tmp/opencode/aura-upstream/app/build.gradle.kts` and `/tmp/opencode/aura-upstream/settings.gradle.kts`: online module dependencies and project configuration.
- `/tmp/opencode/aura-upstream/app/src/main/AndroidManifest.xml`: permissions, components, and online intent filters.

## Important Context
- Latest build verification for automatic-check removal succeeded with `bash ./gradlew assembleDebug --no-configuration-cache --console=plain`; `git diff --check` passed.
- Online modules include `:innertube`, `:jiosaavn`, `:spotify`, `:lastfm`, `:kizzy`, `:shazamkit`, `:artistvideo`, `:Motionartwork`, and `:lyricsProvider`; detach app call sites before removing them.
- App-owned Ktor consumers include remote stream extraction, online lyrics, GitHub operations, Wikipedia, and Apple Music album descriptions; do not remove Ktor solely because feature modules are detached.
- `MusicService` persistence and local auto-backup must remain; distinguish OTA/update work from local backup.
- Upstream has Room catalog, persisted queue/player state, Media3 playback, M3U utilities, and lyrics storage, but lacks a complete device-local audio scanner/file playback path; M3U import does not resolve entries to local files.
- `INTERNET` and `ACCESS_NETWORK_STATE` are in the manifest; Last.fm API credentials are embedded in `app/build.gradle.kts`. A targeted audit found no Firebase Analytics/Crashlytics, Sentry, Amplitude, or PostHog SDK references.

messages.summary:
## Objective
- Build AURA Music as a GPL-3.0 local-only derivative of `vivizzz007/vivi-music`, preserving upstream history and remote.
- Audit upstream, implement and verify the app in buildable stages, and document removals, attribution, gaps, and test/build results.

## Requirements
- Document upstream architecture, DI, database, playback service, theme, SDK levels, UI, and requirement-by-requirement gaps.
- Rebrand as AURA Music with monochrome styling/assets while retaining upstream copyright notices and GPL-3.0 attribution.
- Remove or exclude streaming/scraping, presence, online Canvas artwork, telemetry/crash reporting, and OTA features; document removals.
- Support local files, scanning, folders, M3U import/export, local lyrics, persistent queue/position, and Home/Search/Library/Settings navigation.
- Retain relevant tests, add tests for new code, and build and commit each stage.

## Decisions
- Use `/tmp/opencode/aura-upstream` as the working clone; retain upstream history and `origin` (`https://github.com/vivizzz007/vivi-music.git`).
- Use local Git author identity `AURA Agent <aura-agent@users.noreply.github.com>`.

## Work State
### Completed
- Verified the upstream baseline build and committed the architecture/gap audit as `12fff80d docs(audit): document upstream architecture and AURA gaps`.
- Implemented AURA identity and monochrome branding; build passed and changes committed as `2eac54c8 chore(branding): rebrand app as AURA Music`.
- Removed automatic updater checks from launch and Settings entry, plus new-release worker scheduling; documented and committed as `0fbd7791 chore(offline): disable automatic update checks`.

### Active
- Detach online routes, settings, startup integrations, and playback-service hooks in buildable stages while preserving local playback, Room, WorkManager backup, notifications, and Compose drawing.
- Implement and test local-media scanning/playback, folders, playlists, lyrics, and navigation; finish removal/gap documentation.

### Blocked
- (none)

## Next Move
1. Remove online startup integrations from `App.kt` and detach online routes/settings entry points, tracing callers before deleting modules.
2. Remove service and UI hooks for streaming, Listen Together, Last.fm, Discord, SponsorBlock, Spotify Canvas, and remote artwork while preserving local playback.
3. Remove unused modules/dependencies only after app call sites are detached; reassess app-owned Ktor consumers individually.
4. Implement and test local-media requirements; complete documentation and verification.

## Relevant Files
- `/tmp/opencode/aura-upstream/docs/AURA_IMPLEMENTATION_LOG.md`: records completed stages and verification.
- `/tmp/opencode/aura-upstream/docs/AURA_UPSTREAM_AUDIT.md`: architecture, gaps, module map, and removal/retention policy.
- `/tmp/opencode/aura-upstream/app/src/main/kotlin/com/music/vivi/App.kt`: remaining YouTube, Spotify, Last.fm, proxy, and related startup integrations.
- `/tmp/opencode/aura-upstream/app/src/main/kotlin/com/music/vivi/ui/screens/NavigationBuilder.kt`: online, updater, integration, and recognition routes.
- `/tmp/opencode/aura-upstream/app/src/main/kotlin/com/music/vivi/ui/screens/settings/SettingsScreen.kt`: Settings still exposes updater and Listen Together entries.
- `/tmp/opencode/aura-upstream/app/src/main/kotlin/com/music/vivi/ui/screens/Screens.kt`: `MainScreens` still includes Listen Together.
- `/tmp/opencode/aura-upstream/app/src/main/kotlin/com/music/vivi/MainActivity.kt`: main navigation and top-level route callers.
- `/tmp/opencode/aura-upstream/app/src/main/kotlin/com/music/vivi/playback/MusicService.kt`: Media3 playback mixed with online-service hooks.
- `/tmp/opencode/aura-upstream/app/build.gradle.kts` and `/tmp/opencode/aura-upstream/settings.gradle.kts`: app dependencies and project modules.
- `/tmp/opencode/aura-upstream/app/src/main/AndroidManifest.xml`: permissions, components, and online intent filters.

## Important Context
- Latest build verification succeeded with `bash ./gradlew assembleDebug --no-configuration-cache --console=plain`; `git diff --check` passed.
- Latest observed Git state: clean working tree on `main`, ahead of `origin/main` by 3 commits.
- Online modules include `:innertube`, `:jiosaavn`, `:spotify`, `:lastfm`, `:kizzy`, `:shazamkit`, `:artistvideo`, `:Motionartwork`, and `:lyricsProvider`; detach app call sites before removing them.
- App-owned Ktor consumers include remote stream extraction, online lyrics, GitHub operations, Wikipedia, and Apple Music album descriptions; do not remove Ktor solely because feature modules are detached.
- MusicService persistence and local auto-backup must remain; distinguish OTA/update work from local backup.
- Upstream has Room catalog, persisted queue/player state, Media3 playback, M3U utilities, and lyrics storage, but lacks a complete device-local audio scanner/file playback path; M3U import does not resolve entries to local files.
- `INTERNET` and `ACCESS_NETWORK_STATE` are in the manifest; Last.fm API credentials are embedded in `app/build.gradle.kts`. A targeted audit found no Firebase Analytics/Crashlytics, Sentry, Amplitude, or PostHog SDK references.

messages.summary:
## Objective
- Build AURA Music as a GPL-3.0 local-only derivative of `vivizzz007/vivi-music`, preserving upstream history and remote.
- Audit upstream, implement and verify the app in buildable stages, and document removals, attribution, gaps, and test/build results.

## Requirements
- Document upstream architecture, DI, database, playback service, theme, SDK levels, UI, and requirement-by-requirement gaps.
- Rebrand as AURA Music with monochrome styling/assets while retaining upstream copyright notices and GPL-3.0 attribution.
- Remove or exclude streaming/scraping, presence, online Canvas artwork, telemetry/crash reporting, and OTA features; document removals.
- Support local files, scanning, folders, M3U import/export, local lyrics, persistent queue/position, and Home/Search/Library/Settings navigation.
- Retain relevant tests, add tests for new code, and build and commit each stage.

## Decisions
- Use `/tmp/opencode/aura-upstream` as the working clone; retain upstream history and `origin` (`https://github.com/vivizzz007/vivi-music.git`).
- Use local Git author identity `AURA Agent <aura-agent@users.noreply.github.com>`.

## Work State
### Completed
- Verified the upstream baseline build and committed the architecture/gap audit as `12fff80d docs(audit): document upstream architecture and AURA gaps`.
- Implemented AURA identity and monochrome branding; build passed and changes committed as `2eac54c8 chore(branding): rebrand app as AURA Music`.
- Removed automatic updater checks from launch and Settings entry, plus new-release worker scheduling; documented and committed as `0fbd7791 chore(offline): disable automatic update checks`.

### Active
- Detach online routes, settings, startup integrations, and playback-service hooks in buildable stages while preserving local playback, Room, WorkManager backup, notifications, and Compose drawing.
- Implement and test local-media scanning/playback, folders, playlists, lyrics, and navigation; finish removal/gap documentation.
- Trace navigation and Settings callers before removing online modules; `MainActivity.kt` still references Listen Together and recognition, and online screens retain route links.

### Blocked
- (none)

## Next Move
1. Remove online startup integrations from `App.kt` and detach online routes/settings entry points, tracing callers before deleting modules.
2. Remove service and UI hooks for streaming, Listen Together, Last.fm, Discord, SponsorBlock, Spotify Canvas, and remote artwork while preserving local playback.
3. Remove unused modules/dependencies only after app call sites are detached; reassess app-owned Ktor consumers individually.
4. Implement and test local-media requirements; complete documentation and verification.

## Relevant Files
- `/tmp/opencode/aura-upstream/docs/AURA_IMPLEMENTATION_LOG.md`: records completed stages and verification.
- `/tmp/opencode/aura-upstream/docs/AURA_UPSTREAM_AUDIT.md`: architecture, gaps, module map, and removal/retention policy.
- `/tmp/opencode/aura-upstream/app/src/main/kotlin/com/music/vivi/App.kt`: remaining YouTube, Spotify, Last.fm, proxy, and related startup integrations.
- `/tmp/opencode/aura-upstream/app/src/main/kotlin/com/music/vivi/ui/screens/NavigationBuilder.kt`: online, updater, integration, and recognition routes.
- `/tmp/opencode/aura-upstream/app/src/main/kotlin/com/music/vivi/ui/screens/settings/SettingsScreen.kt`: Settings entry points to inspect and detach.
- `/tmp/opencode/aura-upstream/app/src/main/kotlin/com/music/vivi/ui/screens/Screens.kt`: `MainScreens` includes Listen Together.
- `/tmp/opencode/aura-upstream/app/src/main/kotlin/com/music/vivi/MainActivity.kt`: main navigation and top-level route callers.
- `/tmp/opencode/aura-upstream/app/src/main/kotlin/com/music/vivi/playback/MusicService.kt`: Media3 playback mixed with online-service hooks.
- `/tmp/opencode/aura-upstream/app/build.gradle.kts` and `/tmp/opencode/aura-upstream/settings.gradle.kts`: app dependencies and project modules.
- `/tmp/opencode/aura-upstream/app/src/main/AndroidManifest.xml`: permissions, components, and online intent filters.

## Important Context
- Latest observed Git state: clean working tree on `main`, ahead of `origin/main` by 3 commits; latest commit is `0fbd7791 chore(offline): disable automatic update checks`.
- Latest build verification succeeded with `bash ./gradlew assembleDebug --no-configuration-cache --console=plain`; `git diff --check` passed.
- Online modules include `:innertube`, `:jiosaavn`, `:spotify`, `:lastfm`, `:kizzy`, `:shazamkit`, `:artistvideo`, `:Motionartwork`, and `:lyricsProvider`; detach app call sites before removing them.
- App-owned Ktor consumers include remote stream extraction, online lyrics, GitHub operations, Wikipedia, and Apple Music album descriptions; do not remove Ktor solely because feature modules are detached.
- MusicService persistence and local auto-backup must remain; distinguish OTA/update work from local backup.
- Upstream has Room catalog, persisted queue/player state, Media3 playback, M3U utilities, and lyrics storage, but lacks a complete device-local audio scanner/file playback path; M3U import does not resolve entries to local files.
- `INTERNET` and `ACCESS_NETWORK_STATE` are in the manifest; Last.fm API credentials are embedded in `app/build.gradle.kts`. A targeted audit found no Firebase Analytics/Crashlytics, Sentry, Amplitude, or PostHog SDK references.

## Objective
- Build AURA Music as a GPL-3.0 local-only derivative of `vivizzz007/vivi-music`, preserving upstream history and remote.
- Audit upstream, implement and verify the app in buildable stages, and document removals, attribution, gaps, and test/build results.

## Requirements
- Document upstream architecture, DI, database, playback service, theme, SDK levels, UI, and requirement-by-requirement gaps.
- Rebrand as AURA Music with monochrome styling/assets while retaining upstream copyright notices and GPL-3.0 attribution.
- Remove or exclude streaming/scraping, presence, online Canvas artwork, telemetry/crash reporting, and OTA features; document removals.
- Support local files, scanning, folders, M3U import/export, local lyrics, persistent queue/position, and Home/Search/Library/Settings navigation.
- Retain relevant tests, add tests for new code, and build and commit each stage.

## Decisions
- Use `/tmp/opencode/aura-upstream` as the working clone; retain upstream history and `origin` (`https://github.com/vivizzz007/vivi-music.git`).
- Use local Git author identity `AURA Agent <aura-agent@users.noreply.github.com>`.

## Work State
### Completed
- Verified the upstream baseline build and committed the architecture/gap audit as `12fff80d docs(audit): document upstream architecture and AURA gaps`.
- Implemented AURA identity and monochrome branding; build passed and changes committed as `2eac54c8 chore(branding): rebrand app as AURA Music`.
- Removed automatic updater checks from launch and Settings entry, plus new-release worker scheduling; documented and committed as `0fbd7791 chore(offline): disable automatic update checks`.

### Active
- Detach online startup integrations, navigation routes, settings entry points, and playback-service hooks in buildable stages while preserving local playback, Room, WorkManager backup, notifications, and Compose drawing.
- Implement and test local-media scanning/playback, folders, playlists, lyrics, and navigation; finish removal/gap documentation.
- Trace callers before removing online modules; `MainActivity.kt` still injects and initializes Listen Together, and online screens/routes and related menu hooks remain.
- Review remaining updater references/routes in `MainActivity.kt` and `NavigationBuilder.kt` after the automatic-check removal.

### Blocked
- (none)

## Next Move
1. Remove online startup integrations from `App.kt` and detach online routes/settings entry points, tracing callers before deleting modules.
2. Remove service and UI hooks for streaming, Listen Together, Last.fm, Discord, SponsorBlock, Spotify Canvas, and remote artwork while preserving local playback.
3. Remove unused modules/dependencies only after app call sites are detached; reassess app-owned Ktor consumers individually.
4. Implement and test local-media requirements; complete documentation and verification.

## Relevant Files
- `/tmp/opencode/aura-upstream/docs/AURA_IMPLEMENTATION_LOG.md`: records completed stages and verification.
- `/tmp/opencode/aura-upstream/docs/AURA_UPSTREAM_AUDIT.md`: architecture, gaps, module map, and removal/retention policy.
- `/tmp/opencode/aura-upstream/app/src/main/kotlin/com/music/vivi/App.kt`: remaining YouTube, Spotify, Last.fm, proxy, and related startup integrations.
- `/tmp/opencode/aura-upstream/app/src/main/kotlin/com/music/vivi/ui/screens/NavigationBuilder.kt`: online, integration, recognition, and updater routes.
- `/tmp/opencode/aura-upstream/app/src/main/kotlin/com/music/vivi/ui/screens/Screens.kt`: `MainScreens` still includes Listen Together.
- `/tmp/opencode/aura-upstream/app/src/main/kotlin/com/music/vivi/MainActivity.kt`: Listen Together manager setup, navigation/top-bar hooks, GitHub integration, and updater references.
- `/tmp/opencode/aura-upstream/app/src/main/kotlin/com/music/vivi/ui/screens/settings/SettingsScreen.kt`: Settings entry points to inspect and detach.

## Objective
- Build AURA Music as a GPL-3.0 local-only derivative of `vivizzz007/vivi-music`, preserving upstream history and remote.
- Audit upstream, implement and verify the app in buildable stages, and document removals, attribution, gaps, and test/build results.

## Requirements
- Document upstream architecture, DI, database, playback service, theme, SDK levels, UI, and requirement-by-requirement gaps.
- Rebrand as AURA Music with monochrome styling/assets while retaining upstream copyright notices and GPL-3.0 attribution.
- Remove or exclude streaming/scraping, presence, online Canvas artwork, telemetry/crash reporting, and OTA features; document removals.
- Support local files, scanning, folders, M3U import/export, local lyrics, persistent queue/position, and Home/Search/Library/Settings navigation.
- Retain relevant tests, add tests for new code, and build and commit each stage.

## Decisions
- Use `/tmp/opencode/aura-upstream` as the working clone; retain upstream history and remote `https://github.com/vivizzz007/vivi-music.git`.
- Use local Git author identity `AURA Agent <aura-agent@users.noreply.github.com>`.

## Work State
### Completed
- Verified upstream baseline build and committed architecture/gap audit as `12fff80d docs(audit): document upstream architecture and AURA gaps`.
- Implemented AURA identity and monochrome branding; build passed and changes committed as `2eac54c8 chore(branding): rebrand app as AURA Music`.
- Removed automatic updater checks from launch and Settings entry, plus new-release worker scheduling; documented and committed as `0fbd7791 chore(offline): disable automatic update checks`.

### Active
- Detach online startup integrations, navigation routes, settings entry points, and playback-service hooks in buildable stages while preserving local playback, Room, WorkManager backup, notifications, and Compose drawing.
- Implement and test local-media scanning/playback, folders, playlists, lyrics, and navigation; finish removal/gap documentation.
- Remove service and UI hooks for streaming, Listen Together, Last.fm, Discord, SponsorBlock, Spotify Canvas, and remote artwork; remove modules/dependencies only after app call sites are detached.
- Recent inspection identified Listen Together routes and entry points in `NavigationBuilder.kt`, `Screens.kt`, `SettingsScreen.kt`, `AppearanceSettings.kt`, and `MainActivity.kt`; no edits were made.

### Blocked
- (none)

## Next Move
1. Detach Listen Together navigation/settings/top-bar entry points and routes, tracing remaining UI/service callers before removing its manager and modules.
2. Remove remaining online startup integrations from `App.kt` and detach online playback/UI hooks while preserving local playback.
3. Build and test each stage, commit verified changes, and continue with local-media requirements and final documentation.

## Relevant Files
- `/tmp/opencode/aura-upstream/docs/AURA_IMPLEMENTATION_LOG.md`: records completed stages and verification.
- `/tmp/opencode/aura-upstream/docs/AURA_UPSTREAM_AUDIT.md`: architecture, gaps, module map, and removal/retention policy.
- `/tmp/opencode/aura-upstream/app/src/main/kotlin/com/music/vivi/App.kt`: remaining YouTube, Spotify, Last.fm, proxy, and related startup integrations.
- `/tmp/opencode/aura-upstream/app/src/main/kotlin/com/music/vivi/ui/screens/NavigationBuilder.kt`: online, integration, recognition, and updater routes.
- `/tmp/opencode/aura-upstream/app/src/main/kotlin/com/music/vivi/ui/screens/Screens.kt`: `MainScreens` still includes Listen Together.
- `/tmp/opencode/aura-upstream/app/src/main/kotlin/com/music/vivi/MainActivity.kt`: Listen Together manager setup, navigation/top-bar hooks, GitHub integration, and updater references.
- `/tmp/opencode/aura-upstream/app/src/main/kotlin/com/music/vivi/ui/screens/settings/SettingsScreen.kt`: Settings entry points to inspect and detach.
- `/tmp/opencode/aura-upstream/app/src/main/kotlin/com/music/vivi/ui/screens/settings/AppearanceSettings.kt`: Listen Together top-bar preference.
- `/tmp/opencode/aura-upstream/app/src/main/kotlin/com/music/vivi/playback/MusicService.kt`: Media3 playback mixed with online-service hooks.
- `/tmp/opencode/aura-upstream/app/build.gradle.kts` and `/tmp/opencode/aura-upstream/settings.gradle.kts`: app dependencies and project modules.
- `/tmp/opencode/aura-upstream/app/src/main/AndroidManifest.xml`: permissions, components, and online intent filters.

## Important Context
- Latest observed Git state: clean working tree on `main`, ahead of `origin/main` by 3 commits; latest commit is `0fbd7791 chore(offline): disable automatic update checks`.
- Latest build verification succeeded with `bash ./gradlew assembleDebug --no-configuration-cache --console=plain`; `git diff --check` passed.
- Online modules include `:innertube`, `:jiosaavn`, `:spotify`, `:lastfm`, `:kizzy`, `:shazamkit`, `:artistvideo`, `:Motionartwork`, and `:lyricsProvider`; detach app call sites before removing them.
- App-owned Ktor consumers include remote stream extraction, online lyrics, GitHub operations, Wikipedia, and Apple Music album descriptions; assess them individually.
- MusicService persistence and local auto-backup must remain; distinguish OTA/update work from local backup.
- Upstream has Room catalog, persisted queue/player state, Media3 playback, M3U utilities, and lyrics storage, but lacks a complete device-local audio scanner/file playback path; M3U import does not resolve entries to local files.
- `INTERNET` and `ACCESS_NETWORK_STATE` are in the manifest; Last.fm API credentials are embedded in `app/build.gradle.kts`. A targeted audit found no Firebase Analytics/Crashlytics, Sentry, Amplitude, or PostHog SDK references.

## Objective
- Build AURA Music as a GPL-3.0 local-only derivative of `vivizzz007/vivi-music`, preserving upstream history and remote.
- Audit upstream, implement and verify the app in buildable stages, and document removals, attribution, gaps, and test/build results.

## Requirements
- Document upstream architecture, DI, database, playback service, theme, SDK levels, UI, and requirement-by-requirement gaps.
- Rebrand as AURA Music with monochrome styling/assets while retaining upstream copyright notices and GPL-3.0 attribution.
- Remove or exclude streaming/scraping, presence, online Canvas artwork, telemetry/crash reporting, and OTA features; document removals.
- Support local files, scanning, folders, M3U import/export, local lyrics, persistent queue/position, and Home/Search/Library/Settings navigation.
- Retain relevant tests, add tests for new code, and build and commit each stage.

## Decisions
- Use `/tmp/opencode/aura-upstream` as the working clone; retain upstream history and remote `https://github.com/vivizzz007/vivi-music.git`.
- Use local Git author identity `AURA Agent <aura-agent@users.noreply.github.com>`.

## Work State
### Completed
- Verified upstream baseline build and committed architecture/gap audit as `12fff80d docs(audit): document upstream architecture and AURA gaps`.
- Implemented AURA identity and monochrome branding; build passed and changes committed as `2eac54c8 chore(branding): rebrand app as AURA Music`.
- Removed automatic updater checks from launch and Settings entry, plus new-release worker scheduling; documented and committed as `0fbd7791 chore(offline): disable automatic update checks`.

### Active
- Detach Listen Together navigation, settings, and top-bar entry points; trace remaining UI/service callers before removing its manager and modules.
- Remove remaining online startup integrations and detach online playback/UI hooks while preserving local playback.
- Implement and test local-media scanning/playback, folders, playlists, lyrics, and navigation; finish removal/gap documentation.
- Remove service and UI hooks for streaming, Listen Together, Last.fm, Discord, SponsorBlock, Spotify Canvas, and remote artwork; remove modules/dependencies only after app call sites are detached.

### Blocked
- (none)

## Next Move
1. Remove Listen Together from `Screens.MainScreens` and detach its navigation, settings, and top-bar entry points after tracing callers.
2. Build and test that stage, document it, and commit the verified changes.
3. Continue detaching online startup and playback/UI integrations, then implement the local-media requirements.

## Relevant Files
- `/tmp/opencode/aura-upstream/docs/AURA_IMPLEMENTATION_LOG.md`: records completed stages and verification.
- `/tmp/opencode/aura-upstream/docs/AURA_UPSTREAM_AUDIT.md`: architecture, gaps, module map, and removal/retention policy.
- `/tmp/opencode/aura-upstream/app/src/main/kotlin/com/music/vivi/ui/screens/Screens.kt`: `MainScreens` still includes Listen Together.
- `/tmp/opencode/aura-upstream/app/src/main/kotlin/com/music/vivi/ui/screens/NavigationBuilder.kt`: Listen Together and other online routes.
- `/tmp/opencode/aura-upstream/app/src/main/kotlin/com/music/vivi/MainActivity.kt`: manager setup and navigation/top-bar hooks.
- `/tmp/opencode/aura-upstream/app/src/main/kotlin/com/music/vivi/ui/screens/settings/SettingsScreen.kt`: Settings entry points to inspect and detach.
- `/tmp/opencode/aura-upstream/app/src/main/kotlin/com/music/vivi/ui/screens/settings/AppearanceSettings.kt`: Listen Together top-bar preference.
- `/tmp/opencode/aura-upstream/app/src/main/kotlin/com/music/vivi/App.kt`: remaining YouTube, Spotify, Last.fm, proxy, and related startup integrations.
- `/tmp/opencode/aura-upstream/app/src/main/kotlin/com/music/vivi/playback/MusicService.kt`: Media3 playback mixed with online-service hooks.
- `/tmp/opencode/aura-upstream/app/build.gradle.kts` and `/tmp/opencode/aura-upstream/settings.gradle.kts`: app dependencies and project modules.
- `/tmp/opencode/aura-upstream/app/src/main/AndroidManifest.xml`: permissions, components, and online intent filters.

## Important Context
- Latest observed Git state: clean working tree on `main`, ahead of `origin/main` by 3 commits; latest commit is `0fbd7791 chore(offline): disable automatic update checks`.
- Latest build verification succeeded with `bash ./gradlew assembleDebug --no-configuration-cache --console=plain`; `git diff --check` passed.
- Recent inspection of navigation, screens, activity, settings, and appearance settings found Listen Together still present; no edits were made.
- Online modules include `:innertube`, `:jiosaavn`, `:spotify`, `:lastfm`, `:kizzy`, `:shazamkit`, `:artistvideo`, `:Motionartwork`, and `:lyricsProvider`; detach app call sites before removing them.
- App-owned Ktor consumers include remote stream extraction, online lyrics, GitHub operations, Wikipedia, and Apple Music album descriptions; assess individually.
- MusicService persistence and local auto-backup must remain; distinguish OTA/update work from local backup.
- Upstream has Room catalog, persisted queue/player state, Media3 playback, M3U utilities, and lyrics storage, but lacks a complete device-local audio scanner/file playback path; M3U import does not resolve entries to local files.
- `INTERNET` and `ACCESS_NETWORK_STATE` are in the manifest; Last.fm API credentials are embedded in `app/build.gradle.kts`. A targeted audit found no Firebase Analytics/Crashlytics, Sentry, Amplitude, or PostHog SDK references.

## Recommended first-stage removal

Remove the app-owned Listen Together screen and its navigation/settings entry points, while retaining the underlying service and protocol code.

### Coordinated UI and navigation changes

- **`/tmp/opencode/aura-upstream/app/src/main/kotlin/com/music/vivi/ui/screens/Screens.kt`**  
  Remove `Screens.ListenTogether` and its membership in `MainScreens`.

- **`/tmp/opencode/aura-upstream/app/src/main/kotlin/com/music/vivi/ui/screens/NavigationBuilder.kt`**  
  Remove the `listen_together_from_topbar`, `listen_together/chat`, and `settings/integrations/listen_together` route declarations, together with their feature-specific callers.

- **`/tmp/opencode/aura-upstream/app/src/main/kotlin/com/music/vivi/MainActivity.kt`**  
  Remove the `Screens.ListenTogether` route/title and top-bar action logic. Remove the special-case layout exclusions for `listen_together/chat` as well. Keep the deep-link handling and manager wiring for now if invite-link joining is to remain supported.

- **`/tmp/opencode/aura-upstream/app/src/main/kotlin/com/music/vivi/ui/screens/settings/SettingsScreen.kt`**  
  Remove the settings shortcut that navigates to `Screens.ListenTogether.route`.

- **`/tmp/opencode/aura-upstream/app/src/main/kotlin/com/music/vivi/ui/screens/settings/AppearanceSettings.kt`** and **`/tmp/opencode/aura-upstream/app/src/main/kotlin/com/music/vivi/constants/PreferenceKeys.kt`**  
  Remove the `ListenTogetherInTopBarKey` appearance control and preference declaration, since they only support the top-bar entry point.

- **`/tmp/opencode/aura-upstream/app/src/main/kotlin/com/music/vivi/ui/screens/ListenTogetherScreen.kt`**  
  Remove the screen if no retained feature still uses it. Its links to integration settings and chat are callers of routes in the removal set.

### Keep in this stage

Retain the service and its wiring: `AppModule.kt`, `ListenTogetherManager.kt`, `ListenTogetherClient.kt`, `ListenTogetherActionReceiver.kt`, and `listentogether.proto`. This avoids coupling a UI/navigation cleanup to service or protocol removal.

### Separate scope decisions

- **Invite links:** `ListenTogetherScreen.kt` and `PlayerMenu.kt` emit invite links; the manifest filters route into `MainActivity` deep-link handling, which joins through `listenTogetherManager`. Decide separately whether joining via invite URL remains available. If it does, retain the manifest filters and deep-link path even after removing the screen.
- **Player and guest integrations:** `PlayerMenu.kt` and other player, lyrics, or artist UI references include feature entry points, guest restrictions, or suggestions. Keep those out of this minimal set until their behavior is explicitly decided.

209: /**
210:  * Shape of the volume ramp used while crossfading between two tracks.
211:  * [fadeOut] drives the outgoing (currently playing) track and [fadeIn] drives the
212:  * incoming (next) track, both as a function of normalized progress `t` in `[0, 1]`.
213:  */
214: enum class CrossfadeCurve {
215:     EQUAL_POWER,
216:     EASE_OUT_QUAD,
217:     EASE_OUT_CUBIC,
218:     SMOOTHSTEP;
219: 
220:     fun fadeOut(t: Float): Float =
221:         when (this) {
222:             EQUAL_POWER -> cos((t * Math.PI / 2.0)).toFloat()
223:             EASE_OUT_QUAD -> (1f - t) * (1f - t)
224:             EASE_OUT_CUBIC -> 1f - t * t * t
225:             SMOOTHSTEP -> 1f - (3f * t * t - 2f * t * t * t)
226:         }
227: 
228:     fun fadeIn(t: Float): Float =
229:         when (this) {
230:             SMOOTHSTEP -> 3f * t * t - 2f * t * t * t
231:             else -> sin((t * Math.PI / 2.0)).toFloat()
232:         }
233: }

## Objective
- Build AURA Music as a GPL-3.0 local-only derivative of `vivizzz007/vivi-music`, preserving upstream history and remote.
- Audit upstream, implement and verify the app in buildable stages, and document removals, attribution, gaps, and test/build results.

## Requirements
- Document upstream architecture, DI, database, playback service, theme, SDK levels, UI, and requirement-by-requirement gaps.
- Rebrand as AURA Music with monochrome styling/assets while retaining upstream copyright notices and GPL-3.0 attribution.
- Remove or exclude streaming/scraping, presence, online Canvas artwork, telemetry/crash reporting, and OTA features; document removals.
- Support local files, scanning, folders, M3U import/export, local lyrics, persistent queue/position, and Home/Search/Library/Settings navigation.
- Retain relevant tests, add tests for new code, and build and commit each stage.

## Decisions
- Use `/tmp/opencode/aura-upstream` as the working clone; retain upstream history and remote `https://github.com/vivizzz007/vivi-music.git`.
- Use local Git author identity `AURA Agent <aura-agent@users.noreply.github.com>`.
- Detach Listen Together UI/navigation/settings first; retain its service/protocol code until app callers are audited.

## Work State
### Completed
- Verified upstream baseline build and committed architecture/gap audit as `12fff80d docs(audit): document upstream architecture and AURA gaps`.
- Implemented AURA identity and monochrome branding; build passed and changes committed as `2eac54c8 chore(branding): rebrand app as AURA Music`.
- Removed automatic updater checks from launch and Settings entry, plus new-release worker scheduling; documented and committed as `0fbd7791 chore(offline): disable automatic update checks`.

### Active
- Detach Listen Together navigation, settings, and top-bar entry points; trace remaining UI/service callers before removing its manager and modules.
- Remove remaining online startup integrations and detach online playback/UI hooks while preserving local playback.
- Implement and test local-media scanning/playback, folders, playlists, lyrics, and navigation; finish removal/gap documentation.
- Remove service and UI hooks for streaming, Listen Together, Last.fm, Discord, SponsorBlock, Spotify Canvas, and remote artwork; remove modules/dependencies only after app call sites are detached.

### Blocked
- (none)

## Next Move
1. Remove `Screens.ListenTogether` and its `MainScreens` membership, then detach its navigation, settings, and top-bar entry points after tracing callers.
2. Build and test that stage, document it, and commit the verified changes.
3. Continue detaching online startup and playback/UI integrations, then implement the local-media requirements.

## Relevant Files
- `/tmp/opencode/aura-upstream/docs/AURA_IMPLEMENTATION_LOG.md`: records completed stages and verification.
- `/tmp/opencode/aura-upstream/docs/AURA_UPSTREAM_AUDIT.md`: architecture, gaps, module map, and removal/retention policy.
- `/tmp/opencode/aura-upstream/app/src/main/kotlin/com/music/vivi/ui/screens/Screens.kt`: `MainScreens` still includes Listen Together.
- `/tmp/opencode/aura-upstream/app/src/main/kotlin/com/music/vivi/ui/screens/NavigationBuilder.kt`: Listen Together and other online routes.
- `/tmp/opencode/aura-upstream/app/src/main/kotlin/com/music/vivi/MainActivity.kt`: manager setup and navigation/top-bar hooks.
- `/tmp/opencode/aura-upstream/app/src/main/kotlin/com/music/vivi/ui/screens/settings/SettingsScreen.kt`: Settings entry points to inspect and detach.
- `/tmp/opencode/aura-upstream/app/src/main/kotlin/com/music/vivi/ui/screens/settings/AppearanceSettings.kt`: Listen Together top-bar preference.
- `/tmp/opencode/aura-upstream/app/src/main/kotlin/com/music/vivi/App.kt`: remaining YouTube, Spotify, Last.fm, proxy, and related startup integrations.
- `/tmp/opencode/aura-upstream/app/src/main/kotlin/com/music/vivi/playback/MusicService.kt`: Media3 playback mixed with online-service hooks.
- `/tmp/opencode/aura-upstream/app/build.gradle.kts` and `/tmp/opencode/aura-upstream/settings.gradle.kts`: app dependencies and project modules.
- `/tmp/opencode/aura-upstream/app/src/main/AndroidManifest.xml`: permissions, components, and online intent filters.

## Important Context
- Latest observed Git state: clean working tree on `main`, ahead of `origin/main` by 3 commits; latest commit is `0fbd7791 chore(offline): disable automatic update checks`. No edits were made in the latest inspection.
- Latest build verification succeeded with `bash ./gradlew assembleDebug --no-configuration-cache --console=plain`; `git diff --check` passed.
- Listen Together references extend beyond navigation/settings: menus and player/lyrics/artist UI include guest restrictions and invite-link behavior. The initial cleanup should retain service/protocol code and separately decide whether deep-link invite joining remains.
- Online modules include `:innertube`, `:jiosaavn`, `:spotify`, `:lastfm`, `:kizzy`, `:shazamkit`, `:artistvideo`, `:Motionartwork`, and `:lyricsProvider`; detach app call sites before removing them.
- App-owned Ktor consumers include remote stream extraction, online lyrics, GitHub operations, Wikipedia, and Apple Music album descriptions; assess individually.
- MusicService persistence and local auto-backup must remain; distinguish OTA/update work from local backup.
- Upstream has Room catalog, persisted queue/player state, Media3 playback, M3U utilities, and lyrics storage, but lacks a complete device-local audio scanner/file playback path; M3U import does not resolve entries to local files.
- `INTERNET` and `ACCESS_NETWORK_STATE` are in the manifest; Last.fm API credentials are embedded in `app/build.gradle.kts`. A targeted audit found no Firebase Analytics/Crashlytics, Sentry, Amplitude, or PostHog SDK references.
- `rg` is unavailable in the environment; the attempted command returned `/bin/bash: line 1: rg: command not found`.

messages.summary:
## Objective
- Build AURA Music as a GPL-3.0 local-only derivative of `vivizzz007/vivi-music`, preserving upstream history and remote.
- Audit upstream, implement and verify the app in buildable stages, and document removals, attribution, gaps, and test/build results.

## Requirements
- Document upstream architecture, DI, database, playback service, theme, SDK levels, UI, and requirement-by-requirement gaps.
- Rebrand as AURA Music with monochrome styling/assets while retaining upstream copyright notices and GPL-3.0 attribution.
- Remove or exclude streaming/scraping, presence, online Canvas artwork, telemetry/crash reporting, and OTA features; document removals.
- Support local files, scanning, folders, M3U import/export, local lyrics, persistent queue/position, and Home/Search/Library/Settings navigation.
- Retain relevant tests, add tests for new code, and build and commit each stage.

## Decisions
- Work in `/tmp/opencode/aura-upstream`, retaining upstream history and remote `https://github.com/vivizzz007/vivi-music.git`.
- Use local Git author identity `AURA Agent <aura-agent@users.noreply.github.com>`.
- Detach Listen Together UI/navigation/settings first; retain its service/protocol code until app callers are audited.

## Work State
### Completed
- Verified upstream baseline build; committed architecture/gap audit as `12fff80d docs(audit): document upstream architecture and AURA gaps`.
- Implemented AURA identity and monochrome branding; build passed and committed as `2eac54c8 chore(branding): rebrand app as AURA Music`.
- Removed automatic updater checks from launch and Settings entry, plus new-release worker scheduling; committed as `0fbd7791 chore(offline): disable automatic update checks`.
- Detached Listen Together from `Screens.MainScreens`, navigation routes, Settings and Appearance entries, and the top-bar button/title logic; current changes are uncommitted and not yet verified.

### Active
- Build and verify the Listen Together UI/navigation detachment, document and commit the stage.
- Continue detaching online startup and playback/UI integrations, then implement and test the local-media requirements.
- Finish documenting feature removals and remaining gaps.

### Blocked
- (none)

## Next Move
1. Run `git diff --check` and `bash ./gradlew assembleDebug --no-configuration-cache --console=plain` in `/tmp/opencode/aura-upstream`; resolve any build errors.
2. Record and commit the verified Listen Together UI-detachment stage.
3. Continue auditing/removing online integrations and implement local-media scanning/playback, folders, playlists, lyrics, and navigation.

## Relevant Files
- `/tmp/opencode/aura-upstream/docs/AURA_IMPLEMENTATION_LOG.md`: records completed stages and verification.
- `/tmp/opencode/aura-upstream/docs/AURA_UPSTREAM_AUDIT.md`: architecture, gaps, module map, and removal/retention policy.
- `/tmp/opencode/aura-upstream/app/src/main/kotlin/com/music/vivi/MainActivity.kt`: manager setup/deep-link hooks remain; top-bar entry points were detached.
- `/tmp/opencode/aura-upstream/app/src/main/kotlin/com/music/vivi/ui/screens/NavigationBuilder.kt`: Listen Together routes were removed; other online routes remain.
- `/tmp/opencode/aura-upstream/app/src/main/kotlin/com/music/vivi/ui/screens/Screens.kt`: main navigation screen list.
- `/tmp/opencode/aura-upstream/app/src/main/kotlin/com/music/vivi/ui/screens/settings/SettingsScreen.kt`: Settings entry was removed.
- `/tmp/opencode/aura-upstream/app/src/main/kotlin/com/music/vivi/ui/screens/settings/AppearanceSettings.kt`: top-bar preference entry was removed.
- `/tmp/opencode/aura-upstream/app/src/main/kotlin/com/music/vivi/App.kt`: remaining YouTube, Spotify, Last.fm, proxy, and related startup integrations.
- `/tmp/opencode/aura-upstream/app/src/main/kotlin/com/music/vivi/playback/MusicService.kt`: Media3 playback mixed with online-service hooks.
- `/tmp/opencode/aura-upstream/app/build.gradle.kts` and `/tmp/opencode/aura-upstream/settings.gradle.kts`: app dependencies and project modules.
- `/tmp/opencode/aura-upstream/app/src/main/AndroidManifest.xml`: permissions, components, and online intent filters.

## Important Context
- Latest known committed state was clean on `main`, three commits ahead of `origin/main`; Listen Together detachment edits are now uncommitted. No build has yet run on these edits.
- `ListenTogetherScreen.kt` and `settings/integrations/ListenTogetherSettings.kt` remain as source files but their app navigation/settings entry points were removed; manager initialization, deep-link joining, and other service/UI callers remain for later audit.
- Online modules include `:innertube`, `:jiosaavn`, `:spotify`, `:lastfm`, `:kizzy`, `:shazamkit`, `:artistvideo`, `:Motionartwork`, and `:lyricsProvider`; detach app call sites before removing them.
- App-owned Ktor consumers include remote stream extraction, online lyrics, GitHub operations, Wikipedia, and Apple Music album descriptions; assess individually.
- MusicService persistence and local auto-backup must remain; distinguish OTA/update work from local backup.
- Upstream has Room catalog, persisted queue/player state, Media3 playback, M3U utilities, and lyrics storage, but lacks a complete device-local audio scanner/file playback path; M3U import does not resolve entries to local files.
- `INTERNET` and `ACCESS_NETWORK_STATE` are in the manifest; Last.fm API credentials are embedded in `app/build.gradle.kts`. A targeted audit found no Firebase Analytics/Crashlytics, Sentry, Amplitude, or PostHog SDK references.
- `rg` is unavailable (`/bin/bash: rg: command not found`).

messages.summary:
## Objective
- Build AURA Music as a GPL-3.0 local-only derivative of `vivizzz007/vivi-music`, preserving upstream history and remote.
- Audit upstream, implement and verify the app in buildable stages, and document removals, attribution, gaps, and test/build results.

## Requirements
- Document upstream architecture, DI, database, playback service, theme, SDK levels, UI, and requirement-by-requirement gaps.
- Rebrand as AURA Music with monochrome styling/assets while retaining upstream copyright notices and GPL-3.0 attribution.
- Remove or exclude streaming/scraping, presence, online Canvas artwork, telemetry/crash reporting, and OTA features; document removals.
- Support local files, scanning, folders, M3U import/export, local lyrics, persistent queue/position, and Home/Search/Library/Settings navigation.
- Retain relevant tests, add tests for new code, and build and commit each stage.

## Decisions
- Work in `/tmp/opencode/aura-upstream`, retaining upstream history and remote `https://github.com/vivizzz007/vivi-music.git`.
- Use local Git author identity `AURA Agent <aura-agent@users.noreply.github.com>`.
- Detach Listen Together UI/navigation/settings first; retain its service/protocol code until app callers are audited.

## Work State
### Completed
- Verified upstream baseline build; committed architecture/gap audit as `12fff80d docs(audit): document upstream architecture and AURA gaps`.
- Implemented AURA identity and monochrome branding; build passed and committed as `2eac54c8 chore(branding): rebrand app as AURA Music`.
- Removed automatic updater checks from launch and Settings entry, plus new-release worker scheduling; committed as `0fbd7791 chore(offline): disable automatic update checks`.
- Detached Listen Together from main navigation screens/routes, Settings and Appearance entries, and top-bar button/title logic; `git diff --check` passed and `assembleDebug` succeeded.

### Active
- Document and commit the verified Listen Together UI/navigation detachment.
- Continue auditing/removing online integrations and implement/test local-media scanning/playback, folders, playlists, lyrics, and navigation.
- Finish documenting feature removals and remaining gaps.

### Blocked
- (none)

## Next Move
1. Update `docs/AURA_IMPLEMENTATION_LOG.md` with Listen Together detachment and successful build verification, then commit the stage.
2. Continue auditing/removing online integrations and implementing local-media requirements.

## Relevant Files
- `/tmp/opencode/aura-upstream/docs/AURA_IMPLEMENTATION_LOG.md`: records completed stages and verification.

1: # AURA Music: upstream architecture and gap audit
2: 
3: Audit basis: upstream `vivizzz007/vivi-music` at `b10bf919` (`ci: remove nightly telegram workflow`), reviewed 2026-11-03. The repository is GPL-3.0. This document distinguishes the code that exists at that revision from the requested AURA Music local-only product scope.
4: 
5: ## Build and project configuration
6: 
7: - Root Gradle project name: `vivimusic`; Android application module: `:app`.
8: - The app uses Kotlin, Jetpack Compose, Hilt, Room/KSP, DataStore, Media3, and Protocol Buffers.
9: - Android namespace: `com.music.vivi`; application ID: `com.vivi.vivimusic`.
10: - `minSdk = 26`, `compileSdk = 37`, `targetSdk = 37`; Java and Kotlin JVM target 21.
11: - Build flavors include `foss`/`gms` and universal/ABI variants. The `foss` flavor disables Cast availability; the GMS flavor enables it.
12: - `app/build.gradle.kts` contains embedded Last.fm API key and secret values. These are upstream credentials and must not be copied into an offline AURA build.
13: - The upstream baseline was verified with `bash ./gradlew assembleDebug --no-configuration-cache --console=plain` (757 actionable tasks; 120 executed, 637 up-to-date). The wrapper file is not executable in this checkout, hence the explicit `bash` invocation.
14: 
15: ## Module map
16: 
17: | Module | Upstream role | AURA disposition |
18: | --- | --- | --- |
19: | `:app` | Android UI, app lifecycle, dependency injection, Room, Media3 service, widgets and integrations | Retain and rework for AURA local playback |
20: | `:innertube` | YouTube Music/Innertube networking and extraction | Remove from AURA runtime/build |
21: | `:jiosaavn` | JioSaavn search/streaming integration | Remove from AURA runtime/build |
22: | `:spotify` | Spotify API/Canvas integration | Remove from AURA runtime/build |
23: | `:lastfm` | Last.fm integration/scrobbling | Remove from AURA runtime/build |
24: | `:kizzy` | Discord rich-presence integration | Remove from AURA runtime/build |
25: | `:shazamkit` | ShazamKit integration | Remove from AURA runtime/build |
26: | `:artistvideo` | Artist-video feature | Remove from AURA runtime/build |
27: | `:Motionartwork` | Motion artwork/Canvas provider | Remove from AURA runtime/build |
28: | `:lyricsProvider` | Online lyrics providers/scraping | Remove from AURA runtime/build; retain only sidecar/local lyrics support if needed |
29: 
30: The exact dependency edges and unused code should be rechecked as each module is detached; deleting source modules before Gradle references and UI entry points are removed risks breaking compilation.
31: 
32: ## Architecture findings
33: 
34: ### Dependency injection
35: 
36: The app is Hilt-based. `app/src/main/kotlin/com/music/vivi/di/AppModule.kt` supplies application-level dependencies, including cache-related objects. Feature and persistence services are injected into ViewModels and the playback service. AURA should keep Hilt and bind local catalog/scanner and local-file access abstractions rather than online providers.
37: 
38: ### Database and persistence
39: 
40: `app/src/main/kotlin/com/music/vivi/db/MusicDatabase.kt` and `DatabaseDao.kt` define the Room database and queries. Upstream already has catalog-oriented song/album/artist/playlist data and database migrations. Playback queue/player state is persisted through the existing preference/state layer. The upstream database is designed primarily around remote catalog IDs and metadata; local URI, stable file identity, folder membership, and scan state are not established as a complete local-library model. Prefer additive schema changes with migrations, not destructive recreation.
41: 
42: M3U import/export exists in `BackupRestoreViewModel.kt` and `utils/PlaylistExporter.kt`, but it is oriented around playlist/catalog metadata and does not provide complete robust resolution of local filesystem entries into playable tracks. AURA needs path/URI-aware import/export and missing-file handling.
43: 
44: ### Playback
45: 
46: `playback/MusicService.kt` uses Media3 and persists playback state; `MediaLibrarySessionCallback.kt` exposes a media library/session. Existing media item construction (`extensions/MediaItemExt.kt`) assumes upstream media identities and can participate in remote stream resolution. AURA must ensure that queue items use local content URIs and that the service resolves only locally authorized media, with notification/background playback and restart restoration retained.
47: 
48: No local-device media scanner or end-to-end local-file playback path was found in the audited app source. Local permission handling, MediaStore indexing, folder browsing and selection, and `.lrc` sidecar discovery are gaps.
49: 
50: ### UI, navigation, and theme
51: 
52: The interface is a large Jetpack Compose application with player, library, search, settings, playlist, online integration, and updater routes. `ui/screens/NavigationBuilder.kt` includes online integrations. The theme is defined in `ui/theme/Theme.kt`, including Material You/dynamic color behavior. AURA requires its own monochrome palette/assets and a pared-down primary navigation for Home, Search, Library and Settings. Search should only search the indexed local catalog.
53: 
54: Canvas is overloaded in upstream source to refer both to the online animated artwork feature and to Compose drawing primitives. Removing animated online Canvas artwork must not remove Compose `Canvas` uses for sliders, lyric rendering, or other local UI drawing.
55: 
56: ## Requirement-by-requirement gap analysis
57: 
58: | Requirement | Status at upstream revision | Evidence / work required |
59: | --- | --- | --- |
60: | GPL-3.0 derivative with upstream history and remote preserved | Exists as foundation | Repository has upstream history and `origin`; retain LICENSE and relevant copyright notices, document AURA modifications and attribution. |
61: | AURA Music name, monochrome identity and assets | Missing | Project/app branding remains Vivi Music; update app labels, icons, splash/metadata, theme and documentation without removing upstream notices. |
62: | Local-only operation; no network audio/metadata acquisition | Missing | Innertube, JioSaavn, Spotify and lyrics provider integrations are included. Remove dependencies/routes and ensure local player has no network fallback. |
63: | Local device audio scanning/indexing | Missing | No complete MediaStore scanner was found. Implement permission-aware scan, refresh and catalog persistence. |
64: | Folder browsing | Missing | Build a local folder view backed by indexed local URIs/paths. |
65: | Local file playback | Missing | Existing Media3 session/player is reusable, but local content URI construction/resolution is not a full app path. |
66: | M3U import/export for local tracks | Partial | Import/export utilities exist, but local paths, URI permissions, unavailable items and local queue mapping need implementation and tests. |
67: | Local `.lrc` lyrics | Missing | Existing lyrics are provider/online oriented; implement same-directory sidecar lookup and timed/plain text parsing. |
68: | Persistent queue and playback position | Partial / present | Existing database/preferences and service persist player state. Verify restart restoration specifically for local content URIs and update/add regression tests. |
69: | Home, Search, Library, Settings navigation | Partial | Equivalent navigation and settings exist among larger online-oriented surfaces; simplify and rewire search/library to local data only. |
70: | Remove Discord presence | Present upstream; remove | `:kizzy` and associated preferences/service/UI must not be included. |
71: | Remove animated Canvas/artwork online features | Present upstream; remove | `:Motionartwork`, Spotify Canvas, artwork fetching and related settings/routes; retain ordinary Compose drawing Canvas. |
72: | Remove analytics and crash telemetry | No targeted analytics/crash SDK found in inspected app source | No Firebase Analytics/Crashlytics, Sentry, Amplitude or PostHog symbols were found by the initial targeted search. Recheck all dependencies, manifest providers and build plugins before claiming removal. |
73: | Remove OTA/updater | Present upstream; remove | Updater workers, download/install flows, release checks, update routes/notifications and update-specific permissions should be removed. |
74: | Remove hard-coded online credentials | Present upstream; remove | Last.fm values in `app/build.gradle.kts` must be deleted along with the provider integration. |
75: | Tests for local behavior and retained behavior | Missing for new functionality | Keep applicable upstream tests; add scanner, M3U, lyrics, URI playback/persistence tests and run available test/build tasks per stage. |
76: 
77: ## Removal and retention policy
78: 
79: Remove networking and online service integrations, not useful local Android infrastructure. Retain the Media3 playback service/session, Room and migrations, queue state, local playlist management, notification/background playback, widgets only if they work wholly from local data, and Compose drawing primitives. Explicitly document removed features and do not leave reachable UI routes or hidden background work for the removed services.
80: 
81: ## Staged implementation and verification
82: 
83: Changes are intended to be split into small buildable commits: (1) audit/branding and app identity; (2) offline scope and online feature detachment; (3) local catalog/scanning and folder UI; (4) local playback and persistent queue; (5) local playlists and lyrics; (6) final navigation/theme/docs and full requirement review. Each stage should run its narrow tests and compile check before committing. The baseline build is not evidence that the AURA modifications compile.

<subagent sessionID="ses_e5fe3c780ffe3ML0WNzKypvS8S" state="completed">
## Recommended removal boundary

Use a **detach first, delete second** approach. The goal is to remove online routes, callers, lifecycle hooks, and dependency edges without disturbing local playback, persistence, or UI drawing infrastructure.

### 1. Detach user-facing entry points

Remove integration routes, navigation items, settings, menus, and deep links for YouTube/Innertube, Spotify/Canvas, Last.fm, JioSaavn, Discord/Kizzy, Shazam, artist videos, online lyrics, Wikipedia/Apple Music, and updater screens.

Treat this as a first pass, not complete removal: the existing Listen Together work, for example, removed UI entry points but left source, initialization, and caller paths. Audit each feature’s remaining callers before deleting its implementation.

### 2. Remove runtime and background paths

Disconnect app-startup initialization, playback-service hooks, listeners, workers, and other background work for the detached features. In particular:

- Remove YouTube/JioSaavn stream resolution, proxy use, and remote player-config fetching. `PlayerConfigStore` is a separate network path from the main stream resolver.
- Remove Shazam recognition and its microphone flow.
- Remove Discord/Kizzy presence and related service or manager initialization.
- Remove online lyrics-provider orchestration, replacing it with local sidecar lookup if local `.lrc` lyrics are in scope.
- Remove updater workers and manual update/download/install flows. Automatic checks and startup release-notification scheduling have already been disabled, but updater implementation and manual UI remain.
- Remove remote artwork and artist-video fetching.

Keep the Media3 playback service/session, queue persistence, notifications, and background playback. Also keep ordinary Compose `Canvas` drawing used for local UI and lyrics; removing animated online artwork does not justify removing those primitives.

### 3. Remove Gradle edges, then feature source

The nine integration modules are still included in `settings.gradle.kts` and directly depended on by the app. Once call sites and runtime hooks are detached, remove the corresponding project includes and app dependencies, then remove feature source that is no longer referenced.

Review remaining network-capable libraries and code paths as part of this step—such as Coil’s network integration, Ktor, Jsoup, and Media3 OkHttp—rather than removing them solely because they can access the network. The goal is to eliminate reachable online behavior and unnecessary dependencies, not useful local infrastructure.

Also remove the embedded Last.fm build credentials from `app/build.gradle.kts`. They should not be carried into an offline build.

### 4. Reassess manifest permissions and components

Remove permissions and manifest components only after checking their remaining purpose. `INTERNET`, network-state, local-network, and microphone permissions are candidates for removal as online integrations are detached. Preserve permissions and components still needed for local playback—for example, media-playback foreground service, wake lock, boot restoration, and notifications where applicable.

The audit found no targeted Firebase Analytics/Crashlytics, Sentry, Amplitude, PostHog, Mixpanel, Datadog, or Bugsnag evidence. That is not proof of zero network activity; confirm by checking remaining dependencies, manifest entries, and runtime call paths. A local crash handler alone is not evidence of remote telemetry.

## Suggested staged checks

Run a focused check after each detachment stage, then a broader build after the dependency cleanup:

1. **Entry-point detachment:** compile the app and confirm removed routes, settings, menus, and deep links are no longer reachable.
2. **Runtime cleanup:** confirm startup, service, and worker paths no longer initialize or invoke detached features; verify local playback, queue restoration, notifications, and restart behavior remain intact.
3. **Dependency cleanup:** inspect the project list and app runtime dependency graph; confirm the integration modules and obsolete libraries are no longer pulled into the app.
4. **Manifest cleanup:** inspect the merged manifest for removed permissions and components, while checking that local playback requirements remain.
5. **Offline regressions:** test local file playback, queue and position persistence, playlists, and local lyrics as applicable; run the app’s available unit and lint checks.

Likely targeted Gradle tasks for the universal FOSS debug variant are `:app:testFossUniversalDebugUnitTest`, `:app:lintFossUniversalDebug`, and `:app:assembleFossUniversalDebug`. Confirm the exact task names against the project’s generated variants. `git diff --check` is also useful at each stage.

The known successful baseline—`bash ./gradlew assembleDebug --no-configuration-cache --console=plain`—predates these proposed removals. It confirms the earlier checkout built; it does **not** validate future edits.

## Objective
- Build AURA Music as a GPL-3.0 local-only derivative of `vivizzz007/vivi-music`, preserving upstream history and remote.
- Audit upstream, implement and verify the app in buildable stages, and document removals, attribution, gaps, and test/build results.

## Requirements
- Document upstream architecture, DI, database, playback service, theme, SDK levels, UI, and requirement-by-requirement gaps.
- Rebrand as AURA Music with monochrome styling/assets while retaining upstream copyright notices and GPL-3.0 attribution.
- Remove or exclude streaming/scraping, presence, online Canvas artwork, telemetry/crash reporting, and OTA features; document removals.
- Support local files, scanning, folders, M3U import/export, local lyrics, persistent queue/position, and Home/Search/Library/Settings navigation.
- Retain relevant tests, add tests for new code, and build and commit each stage.

## Decisions
- Work in `/tmp/opencode/aura-upstream`, retaining upstream history and remote `https://github.com/vivizzz007/vivi-music.git`.
- Use local Git author identity `AURA Agent <aura-agent@users.noreply.github.com>`.
- Detach Listen Together UI/navigation first; retain its service/protocol code until app callers are audited.

## Work State
### Completed
- Verified upstream baseline build; committed architecture/gap audit as `12fff80d docs(audit): document upstream architecture and AURA gaps`.
- Implemented AURA identity and monochrome branding; build passed and committed as `2eac54c8 chore(branding): rebrand app as AURA Music`.
- Removed automatic updater checks from launch and Settings entry, plus new-release worker scheduling; committed as `0fbd7791 chore(offline): disable automatic update checks`.
- Detached Listen Together from main navigation screens/routes, Settings and Appearance entries, and top-bar button/title logic; documented and verified with `assembleDebug` and `git diff --check`; committed as `a940b056 chore(offline): detach Listen Together UI`.
- Audited online integration edges and identified a detach-first approach: remove UI and runtime callers before deleting modules/dependencies.

### Active
- Continue auditing and removing online integrations, startup/background paths, and permissions while preserving local playback and infrastructure.
- Implement and test local-media scanning/playback, folders, playlists, lyrics, and navigation.
- Finish documenting feature removals and remaining gaps.

### Blocked
- (none)

## Next Move
1. Audit remaining online integration callers, starting with app lifecycle hooks in `App.kt`, playback hooks, routes/settings, and manifest permissions; detach runtime behavior before deleting modules.
2. Implement local catalog scanning and folder navigation, with tests and a buildable commit.
3. Continue local playback, persistent queue, playlists/M3U, and lyrics; update the implementation log and final gap/removal audit.

## Relevant Files
- `/tmp/opencode/aura-upstream/docs/AURA_IMPLEMENTATION_LOG.md`: records completed stages and verification.
- `/tmp/opencode/aura-upstream/docs/AURA_UPSTREAM_AUDIT.md`: architecture, gaps, and removal/retention policy.
- `/tmp/opencode/aura-upstream/app/src/main/kotlin/com/music/vivi/App.kt`: remaining third-party integrations and lifecycle hooks.
- `/tmp/opencode/aura-upstream/app/src/main/kotlin/com/music/vivi/playback/MusicService.kt`: Media3 playback mixed with online-service hooks.
- `/tmp/opencode/aura-upstream/app/src/main/kotlin/com/music/vivi/ui/screens/NavigationBuilder.kt`: remaining online routes.
- `/tmp/opencode/aura-upstream/app/src/main/kotlin/com/music/vivi/MainActivity.kt`: manager initialization and deep-link hooks remain.
- `/tmp/opencode/aura-upstream/app/build.gradle.kts`: app dependencies and online integration modules.
- `/tmp/opencode/aura-upstream/settings.gradle.kts`: included online modules.
- `/tmp/opencode/aura-upstream/app/src/main/AndroidManifest.xml`: permissions, components, and online intent filters.

## Important Context
- Latest committed state is clean on `main`, four commits ahead of `origin/main`.
- `bash ./gradlew assembleDebug --no-configuration-cache --console=plain` succeeded after the Listen Together UI detachment; `git diff --check` passed.
- `ListenTogetherScreen.kt` and `settings/integrations/ListenTogetherSettings.kt` remain, as do manager initialization, deep-link joining, and other service/UI callers; audit these before deleting implementation code.
- Online modules include `:innertube`, `:jiosaavn`, `:spotify`, `:lastfm`, `:kizzy`, `:shazamkit`, `:artistvideo`, `:Motionartwork`, and `:lyricsProvider`.
- App-owned Ktor consumers include remote stream extraction, online lyrics, GitHub operations, Wikipedia, and Apple Music album descriptions; assess individually.
- MusicService persistence and local auto-backup must remain; distinguish OTA/update work from local backup.
- Upstream has Room catalog, persisted queue/player state, Media3 playback, M3U utilities, and lyrics storage, but lacks a complete device-local audio scanner/file playback path; M3U import does not resolve entries to local files.
- `INTERNET` and `ACCESS_NETWORK_STATE` are in the manifest; Last.fm API credentials are embedded in `app/build.gradle.kts`. A targeted audit found no Firebase Analytics/Crashlytics, Sentry, Amplitude, or PostHog SDK references.
- `rg` is unavailable (`/bin/bash: rg: command not found`).
