<?xml version="1.0" encoding="utf-8"?>
<manifest xmlns:android="http://schemas.android.com/apk/res/android"
    xmlns:tools="http://schemas.android.com/tools">

    <uses-permission android:name="android.permission.INTERNET" />
    <uses-permission android:name="android.permission.POST_NOTIFICATIONS" />
    <uses-permission android:name="android.permission.ACCESS_NETWORK_STATE" />
    <uses-permission android:name="android.permission.RECEIVE_BOOT_COMPLETED" />
    <uses-permission android:name="android.permission.WAKE_LOCK" />
    <uses-permission android:name="android.permission.FOREGROUND_SERVICE" />
    <uses-permission android:name="android.permission.FOREGROUND_SERVICE_MEDIA_PLAYBACK" />
    <uses-permission android:name="android.permission.FOREGROUND_SERVICE_DATA_SYNC" />
    <uses-permission android:name="android.permission.RECORD_AUDIO" />
    <uses-permission android:name="android.permission.ACCESS_LOCAL_NETWORK" />
    <!--    bluetooth connect-->
    <uses-permission android:name="android.permission.BLUETOOTH_CONNECT" />
    <!-- For Android 11 (API 30) and below -->
    <uses-permission android:name="android.permission.BLUETOOTH" android:maxSdkVersion="30" />
    <!-- Optional: If you also need to scan for Bluetooth devices -->
    <uses-permission android:name="android.permission.BLUETOOTH_ADMIN" android:maxSdkVersion="30" />

    <!-- Microphone feature for music recognition (not required) -->
    <uses-feature android:name="android.hardware.microphone" android:required="false" />


    <!-- Storage permissions for auto backup to Downloads/vivimusic/ -->
    <uses-permission android:name="android.permission.WRITE_EXTERNAL_STORAGE" android:maxSdkVersion="28" />
    <uses-permission android:name="android.permission.READ_EXTERNAL_STORAGE" android:maxSdkVersion="32" />

    <!-- Android TV -->
    <uses-feature android:name="android.software.leanback" android:required="false" />
    <uses-feature android:name="android.hardware.touchscreen" android:required="false" />

    <queries>
        <intent>
            <action android:name="android.media.action.DISPLAY_AUDIO_EFFECT_CONTROL_PANEL" />
        </intent>
    </queries>
    <application
        android:name=".App"
        android:allowBackup="true"
        android:appCategory="audio"
        android:banner="@mipmap/tv_banner"
        android:dataExtractionRules="@xml/data_extraction_rules"
        android:enableOnBackInvokedCallback="true"
        android:fullBackupContent="@xml/backup_rules"
        android:icon="@mipmap/ic_launcher"
        android:label="@string/app_name"
        android:networkSecurityConfig="@xml/network_security_config"
        android:roundIcon="@mipmap/ic_launcher_round"
        android:supportsRtl="true"
        android:theme="@style/Theme.AuraMusic"
        tools:targetApi="tiramisu">
        <uses-library
            android:name="org.apache.http.legacy"
            android:required="false" />

messages.summary:
## Objective
- Build AURA Music as a GPL-3.0 local-only derivative of `vivizzz007/vivi-music`, preserving upstream history and remote.
- Audit upstream, implement and verify the app in buildable stages, and document removals, attribution, gaps, and test/build results.

## Requirements
- Document upstream architecture, DI, database, playback service, theme, SDK levels, UI, and requirement-by-requirement gaps.
- Rebrand as AURA Music with monochrome styling/assets while retaining upstream copyright notices and GPL-3.0 attribution.
- Remove or exclude streaming/scraping, presence, online Canvas artwork, telemetry/crash reporting, and OTA features; document removals.
- Support local files, scanning, folders, M3U import/export, local lyrics, persistent queue/position, and Home/Search/Library/Settings navigation.
- Retain relevant tests, add tests for new code, and build and commit each stage.

## Decisions
- Work in `/tmp/opencode/aura-upstream`, retaining upstream history and remote `https://github.com/vivizzz007/vivi-music.git`.
- Use local Git author identity `AURA Agent <aura-agent@users.noreply.github.com>`.
- Detach Listen Together UI/navigation first; retain its service/protocol code until app callers are audited.

## Work State
### Completed
- Verified upstream baseline build; committed architecture/gap audit as `12fff80d docs(audit): document upstream architecture and AURA gaps`.
- Implemented AURA identity and monochrome branding; build passed and committed as `2eac54c8 chore(branding): rebrand app as AURA Music`.
- Removed automatic updater checks from launch and Settings entry, plus new-release worker scheduling; committed as `0fbd7791 chore(offline): disable automatic update checks`.
- Detached Listen Together from main navigation screens/routes, Settings and Appearance entries, and top-bar button/title logic; verified with `assembleDebug` and `git diff --check`; committed as `a940b056 chore(offline): detach Listen Together UI`.

### Active
- Continue detaching online runtime callers and auditing background paths and permissions before deleting modules/dependencies.
- Implement and test local-media scanning/playback, folders, playlists/M3U, lyrics, and navigation.
- Finish documenting feature removals and remaining gaps.

### Blocked
- (none)

## Next Move
1. Remove remaining Listen Together runtime callers from `MainActivity.kt` and `MusicService.kt`, then audit related manifest components and `PlayerConnection.kt`.
2. Continue auditing other online hooks in `App.kt`, playback, routes/settings, and manifest permissions.
3. Implement local catalog scanning and folder navigation with tests, a build, and a commit.

## Relevant Files
- `/tmp/opencode/aura-upstream/docs/AURA_IMPLEMENTATION_LOG.md`: records completed stages and verification.
- `/tmp/opencode/aura-upstream/docs/AURA_UPSTREAM_AUDIT.md`: architecture, gaps, and removal/retention policy.
- `/tmp/opencode/aura-upstream/app/src/main/kotlin/com/music/vivi/App.kt`: third-party initialization and lifecycle settings.
- `/tmp/opencode/aura-upstream/app/src/main/kotlin/com/music/vivi/MainActivity.kt`: remaining Listen Together initialization/deep-link handling and GitHub hooks.
- `/tmp/opencode/aura-upstream/app/src/main/kotlin/com/music/vivi/playback/MusicService.kt`: Media3 playback mixed with online-service and Listen Together hooks.
- `/tmp/opencode/aura-upstream/app/src/main/kotlin/com/music/vivi/playback/PlayerConnection.kt`: remaining Listen Together sync bypass.
- `/tmp/opencode/aura-upstream/app/src/main/AndroidManifest.xml`: network, microphone, storage permissions, online intent filters, and Listen Together receiver.
- `/tmp/opencode/aura-upstream/app/src/main/kotlin/com/music/vivi/ui/screens/NavigationBuilder.kt`: remaining online routes.

## Important Context
- Latest committed state is clean on `main`, four commits ahead of `origin/main`; no files were changed in the latest audit.
- `App.kt` still initializes InnerTube, cipher extraction, Last.fm, proxy and account settings; it also observes YouTube/Spotify/Last.fm session preferences.
- `MainActivity.kt` still initializes and connects `ListenTogetherManager`, provides it through a CompositionLocal, and handles Listen Together invite deep links.
- `MusicService.kt` still injects `ListenTogetherManager` and disables crossfade while in a room; `PlayerConnection.kt` retains sync-related behavior.
- Manifest still declares `INTERNET`, `ACCESS_NETWORK_STATE`, `RECORD_AUDIO`, local-network access, Listen Together invite filters, YouTube filters, and a Listen Together action receiver.
- Online modules include `:innertube`, `:jiosaavn`, `:spotify`, `:lastfm`, `:kizzy`, `:shazamkit`, `:artistvideo`, `:Motionartwork`, and `:lyricsProvider`; detach runtime/UI callers before removing modules.
- App-owned Ktor consumers include remote stream extraction, online lyrics, GitHub operations, Wikipedia, and Apple Music album descriptions; assess individually.
- MusicService persistence and local auto-backup must remain; distinguish OTA/update work from local backup.
- Upstream has Room catalog, persisted queue/player state, Media3 playback, M3U utilities, and lyrics storage, but lacks a complete device-local audio scanner/file playback path; M3U import does not resolve entries to local files.
- `INTERNET` and `ACCESS_NETWORK_STATE` are declared; Last.fm API credentials are embedded in `app/build.gradle.kts`. A targeted audit found no Firebase Analytics/Crashlytics, Sentry, Amplitude, or PostHog SDK references.
- `rg` is unavailable (`/bin/bash: rg: command not found`).

## Objective
- Build AURA Music as a GPL-3.0 local-only derivative of `vivizzz007/vivi-music`, preserving upstream history and remote.
- Audit upstream, implement and verify the app in buildable stages, and document removals, attribution, gaps, and test/build results.

## Requirements
- Document upstream architecture, DI, database, playback service, theme, SDK levels, UI, and requirement-by-requirement gaps.
- Rebrand as AURA Music with monochrome styling/assets while retaining upstream copyright notices and GPL-3.0 attribution.
- Remove or exclude streaming/scraping, presence, online Canvas artwork, telemetry/crash reporting, and OTA features; document removals.
- Support local files, scanning, folders, M3U import/export, local lyrics, persistent queue/position, and Home/Search/Library/Settings navigation.
- Retain relevant tests, add tests for new code, and build and commit each stage.

## Decisions
- Work in `/tmp/opencode/aura-upstream`, retaining upstream history and remote `https://github.com/vivizzz007/vivi-music.git`.
- Use local Git author identity `AURA Agent <aura-agent@users.noreply.github.com>`.
- Detach Listen Together UI/navigation first; retain its service/protocol code until app callers are audited.

## Work State
### Completed
- Verified upstream baseline build; committed architecture/gap audit as `12fff80d docs(audit): document upstream architecture and AURA gaps`.
- Implemented AURA identity and monochrome branding; build passed and committed as `2eac54c8 chore(branding): rebrand app as AURA Music`.
- Removed automatic updater checks from launch and Settings entry, plus new-release worker scheduling; committed as `0fbd7791 chore(offline): disable automatic update checks`.
- Detached Listen Together from main navigation screens/routes, Settings and Appearance entries, and top-bar button/title logic; verified with `assembleDebug` and `git diff --check`; committed as `a940b056 chore(offline): detach Listen Together UI`.

### Active
- Remove remaining Listen Together runtime callers and audit related manifest components and `PlayerConnection.kt`.
- Audit other online hooks in app startup, playback, routes/settings, and manifest permissions before removing modules/dependencies.
- Implement and test local-media scanning/playback, folders, playlists/M3U, lyrics, and navigation.
- Finish documenting feature removals and remaining gaps.

### Blocked
- (none)

## Next Move
1. Remove remaining Listen Together initialization, deep-link handling, crossfade coupling, and playback-control guards.
2. Audit online runtime hooks, manifest filters/permissions, app-owned Ktor consumers, and module callers; remove or document them.
3. Implement local catalog scanning and folder navigation with tests, a build, and a commit.

## Relevant Files
- `/tmp/opencode/aura-upstream/docs/AURA_IMPLEMENTATION_LOG.md`: completed stages and verification.
- `/tmp/opencode/aura-upstream/docs/AURA_UPSTREAM_AUDIT.md`: architecture, gaps, and removal/retention policy.
- `/tmp/opencode/aura-upstream/app/src/main/kotlin/com/music/vivi/MainActivity.kt`: remaining Listen Together initialization, deep-link handling, and GitHub hooks.
- `/tmp/opencode/aura-upstream/app/src/main/kotlin/com/music/vivi/playback/MusicService.kt`: playback and online-service hooks, including Listen Together crossfade coupling.
- `/tmp/opencode/aura-upstream/app/src/main/kotlin/com/music/vivi/playback/PlayerConnection.kt`: Listen Together playback-control guards.
- `/tmp/opencode/aura-upstream/app/src/main/AndroidManifest.xml`: network, microphone, storage permissions, online intent filters, and Listen Together receiver.
- `/tmp/opencode/aura-upstream/app/src/main/kotlin/com/music/vivi/App.kt`: third-party initialization and lifecycle settings.
- `/tmp/opencode/aura-upstream/app/src/main/kotlin/com/music/vivi/ui/screens/NavigationBuilder.kt`: remaining online routes.

## Important Context
- Latest repository state is clean on `main`, four commits ahead of `origin/main`; remote remains `https://github.com/vivizzz007/vivi-music.git`.
- `MainActivity.kt` still injects/initializes `ListenTogetherManager`, connects it to `PlayerConnection`, provides it through a CompositionLocal, and handles invite deep links; it also retains GitHub star prompts.
- `MusicService.kt` injects `ListenTogetherManager` and combines room state with crossfade settings; `PlayerConnection.kt` retains guest playback blocking and internal-sync bypass logic.
- Manifest still declares `INTERNET`, `ACCESS_NETWORK_STATE`, `RECORD_AUDIO`, local-network access, Listen Together and YouTube intent filters, GitHub OAuth callback, and a Listen Together action receiver.
- `App.kt` still initializes InnerTube, cipher extraction, Last.fm, proxy and account settings, and observes YouTube/Spotify/Last.fm session preferences.
- Online modules include `:innertube`, `:jiosaavn`, `:spotify`, `:lastfm`, `:kizzy`, `:shazamkit`, `:artistvideo`, `:Motionartwork`, and `:lyricsProvider`; detach callers before removing modules.
- App-owned Ktor consumers include remote stream extraction, online lyrics, GitHub operations, Wikipedia, and Apple Music album descriptions; assess individually.
- MusicService persistence and local auto-backup must remain; distinguish OTA/update work from local backup.
- Upstream has Room catalog, persisted queue/player state, Media3 playback, M3U utilities, and lyrics storage, but lacks a complete device-local audio scanner/file playback path; M3U import does not resolve entries to local files.
- `INTERNET` and `ACCESS_NETWORK_STATE` are declared; Last.fm API credentials are embedded in `app/build.gradle.kts`. A targeted audit found no Firebase Analytics/Crashlytics, Sentry, Amplitude, or PostHog SDK references.
- `rg` is unavailable (`/bin/bash: rg: command not found`).

## Objective
- Build AURA Music as a GPL-3.0 local-only derivative of `vivizzz007/vivi-music`, preserving upstream history and remote.
- Audit upstream, implement and verify the app in buildable stages, and document removals, attribution, gaps, and test/build results.

## Requirements
- Document upstream architecture, DI, database, playback service, theme, SDK levels, UI, and requirement-by-requirement gaps.
- Rebrand as AURA Music with monochrome styling/assets while retaining upstream copyright notices and GPL-3.0 attribution.
- Remove or exclude streaming/scraping, presence, online Canvas artwork, telemetry/crash reporting, and OTA features; document removals.
- Support local files, scanning, folders, M3U import/export, local lyrics, persistent queue/position, and Home/Search/Library/Settings navigation.
- Retain relevant tests, add tests for new code, and build and commit each stage.

## Decisions
- Work in `/tmp/opencode/aura-upstream`, retaining upstream history and remote `https://github.com/vivizzz007/vivi-music.git`.
- Use local Git author identity `AURA Agent <aura-agent@users.noreply.github.com>`.
- Detach Listen Together UI/navigation first; retain its service/protocol code until app callers are audited.

## Work State
### Completed
- Verified upstream baseline build; committed architecture/gap audit as `12fff80d docs(audit): document upstream architecture and AURA gaps`.
- Implemented AURA identity and monochrome branding; build passed and committed as `2eac54c8 chore(branding): rebrand app as AURA Music`.
- Removed automatic updater checks from launch and Settings entry, plus new-release worker scheduling; committed as `0fbd7791 chore(offline): disable automatic update checks`.
- Detached Listen Together from main navigation screens/routes, Settings and Appearance entries, and top-bar button/title logic; verified with `assembleDebug` and `git diff --check`; committed as `a940b056 chore(offline): detach Listen Together UI`.

### Active
- Remove remaining Listen Together runtime callers and audit related manifest components and `PlayerConnection.kt`.
- Audit other online hooks in app startup, playback, routes/settings, manifest permissions, app-owned Ktor consumers, and module callers before removing modules/dependencies.
- Implement and test local-media scanning/playback, folders, playlists/M3U, lyrics, and navigation.
- Finish documenting feature removals and remaining gaps.

### Blocked
- (none)

## Next Move
1. Remove remaining Listen Together initialization, deep-link handling, crossfade coupling, and playback-control guards.
2. Audit online runtime hooks, manifest filters/permissions, app-owned Ktor consumers, and module callers; remove or document them.
3. Implement local catalog scanning and folder navigation with tests, a build, and a commit.

## Relevant Files
- `/tmp/opencode/aura-upstream/docs/AURA_IMPLEMENTATION_LOG.md`: completed stages and verification.
- `/tmp/opencode/aura-upstream/docs/AURA_UPSTREAM_AUDIT.md`: architecture, gaps, and removal/retention policy.
- `/tmp/opencode/aura-upstream/app/src/main/kotlin/com/music/vivi/MainActivity.kt`: remaining Listen Together initialization, deep-link handling, and GitHub hooks.
- `/tmp/opencode/aura-upstream/app/src/main/kotlin/com/music/vivi/playback/MusicService.kt`: playback and online-service hooks, including Listen Together crossfade coupling.
- `/tmp/opencode/aura-upstream/app/src/main/kotlin/com/music/vivi/playback/PlayerConnection.kt`: Listen Together playback-control guards.
- `/tmp/opencode/aura-upstream/app/src/main/AndroidManifest.xml`: network, microphone, storage permissions, online intent filters, and Listen Together receiver.
- `/tmp/opencode/aura-upstream/app/src/main/kotlin/com/music/vivi/App.kt`: third-party initialization and lifecycle settings.
- `/tmp/opencode/aura-upstream/app/src/main/kotlin/com/music/vivi/ui/screens/NavigationBuilder.kt`: remaining online routes.

## Important Context
- Repository is clean on `main`, four commits ahead of `origin/main`; remote remains `https://github.com/vivizzz007/vivi-music.git`.
- `MainActivity.kt` still injects/initializes `ListenTogetherManager`, connects it to `PlayerConnection`, provides it through a CompositionLocal, and handles invite deep links; it also retains GitHub star prompts.
- `MusicService.kt` injects `ListenTogetherManager` and combines room state with crossfade settings; `PlayerConnection.kt` retains guest playback blocking and internal-sync bypass logic.
- Manifest still declares `INTERNET`, `ACCESS_NETWORK_STATE`, `RECORD_AUDIO`, local-network access, Listen Together and YouTube intent filters, GitHub OAuth callback, and a Listen Together action receiver.
- `App.kt` still initializes InnerTube, cipher extraction, Last.fm, proxy and account settings, and observes YouTube/Spotify/Last.fm session preferences.
- Online modules include `:innertube`, `:jiosaavn`, `:spotify`, `:lastfm`, `:kizzy`, `:shazamkit`, `:artistvideo`, `:Motionartwork`, and `:lyricsProvider`; detach callers before removing modules.
- App-owned Ktor consumers include remote stream extraction, online lyrics, GitHub operations, Wikipedia, and Apple Music album descriptions; assess individually.
- MusicService persistence and local auto-backup must remain; distinguish OTA/update work from local backup.
- Upstream has Room catalog, persisted queue/player state, Media3 playback, M3U utilities, and lyrics storage, but lacks a complete device-local audio scanner/file playback path; M3U import does not resolve entries to local files.
- `INTERNET` and `ACCESS_NETWORK_STATE` are declared; Last.fm API credentials are embedded in `app/build.gradle.kts`. A targeted audit found no Firebase Analytics/Crashlytics, Sentry, Amplitude, or PostHog SDK references.
- `rg` is unavailable (`/bin/bash: rg: command not found`).

messages.summary:
## Objective
- Build AURA Music as a GPL-3.0 local-only derivative of `vivizzz007/vivi-music`, preserving upstream history and remote.
- Audit upstream, implement and verify the app in buildable stages, and document removals, attribution, gaps, and test/build results.

## Requirements
- Document upstream architecture, DI, database, playback service, theme, SDK levels, UI, and requirement-by-requirement gaps.
- Rebrand as AURA Music with monochrome styling/assets while retaining upstream copyright notices and GPL-3.0 attribution.
- Remove or exclude streaming/scraping, presence, online Canvas artwork, telemetry/crash reporting, and OTA features; document removals.
- Support local files, scanning, folders, M3U import/export, local lyrics, persistent queue/position, and Home/Search/Library/Settings navigation.
- Retain relevant tests, add tests for new code, and build and commit each stage.

## Decisions
- Work in `/tmp/opencode/aura-upstream`, retaining upstream history and remote `https://github.com/vivizzz007/vivi-music.git`.
- Use local Git author identity `AURA Agent <aura-agent@users.noreply.github.com>`.
- Detach Listen Together UI/navigation first; retain its service/protocol code until app callers are audited.

## Work State
### Completed
- Verified upstream baseline build; committed architecture/gap audit as `12fff80d docs(audit): document upstream architecture and AURA gaps`.
- Implemented AURA identity and monochrome branding; build passed and committed as `2eac54c8 chore(branding): rebrand app as AURA Music`.
- Removed automatic updater checks from launch and Settings entry, plus new-release worker scheduling; committed as `0fbd7791 chore(offline): disable automatic update checks`.
- Detached Listen Together from main navigation screens/routes, Settings and Appearance entries, and top-bar button/title logic; verified with `assembleDebug` and `git diff --check`; committed as `a940b056 chore(offline): detach Listen Together UI`.

### Active
- Remove remaining Listen Together initialization, deep-link handling, crossfade coupling, playback-control guards, and UI/menu/player callers.
- Audit online runtime hooks, manifest components/permissions, app-owned Ktor consumers, and module callers before removing modules/dependencies or documenting retained items.
- Implement and test local-media scanning/playback, folders, playlists/M3U, lyrics, and navigation.
- Finish documenting feature removals and remaining gaps.

### Blocked
- (none)

## Next Move
1. Audit and remove remaining Listen Together callers, including in `MainActivity.kt`, `MusicService.kt`, `PlayerConnection.kt`, menus, and player UI.
2. Audit startup, playback, routes/settings, manifest, app-owned Ktor consumers, and module callers; remove or document them.
3. Implement local catalog scanning and folder navigation with tests, a build, and a commit.

## Relevant Files
- `/tmp/opencode/aura-upstream/docs/AURA_IMPLEMENTATION_LOG.md`: completed stages and verification.
- `/tmp/opencode/aura-upstream/docs/AURA_UPSTREAM_AUDIT.md`: architecture, gaps, and removal/retention policy.
- `/tmp/opencode/aura-upstream/app/src/main/kotlin/com/music/vivi/MainActivity.kt`: remaining Listen Together setup/deep links and GitHub hooks.
- `/tmp/opencode/aura-upstream/app/src/main/kotlin/com/music/vivi/playback/MusicService.kt`: playback hooks and Listen Together crossfade coupling.
- `/tmp/opencode/aura-upstream/app/src/main/kotlin/com/music/vivi/playback/PlayerConnection.kt`: Listen Together playback-control guards.
- `/tmp/opencode/aura-upstream/app/src/main/AndroidManifest.xml`: network, storage, and microphone permissions; online intent filters and receiver.
- `/tmp/opencode/aura-upstream/app/src/main/kotlin/com/music/vivi/App.kt`: third-party initialization and online session settings.
- `/tmp/opencode/aura-upstream/app/src/main/kotlin/com/music/vivi/ui/screens/NavigationBuilder.kt`: remaining online routes.

## Important Context
- Repository is clean on `main`, four commits ahead of `origin/main`; remote remains `https://github.com/vivizzz007/vivi-music.git`.
- Recent search found many additional Listen Together references in menus and player UI, beyond the service and activity integrations.
- `App.kt` still initializes InnerTube, cipher extraction, Last.fm, proxy and account settings, and observes YouTube/Spotify/Last.fm session preferences.
- Online modules include `:innertube`, `:jiosaavn`, `:spotify`, `:lastfm`, `:kizzy`, `:shazamkit`, `:artistvideo`, `:Motionartwork`, and `:lyricsProvider`; detach callers before removing modules.
- App-owned Ktor consumers include remote stream extraction, online lyrics, GitHub operations, Wikipedia, and Apple Music album descriptions; assess individually.
- MusicService persistence and local auto-backup must remain; distinguish OTA/update work from local backup.
- Upstream has Room catalog, persisted queue/player state, Media3 playback, M3U utilities, and lyrics storage, but lacks a complete device-local audio scanner/file playback path; M3U import does not resolve entries to local files.
- `INTERNET` and `ACCESS_NETWORK_STATE` are declared; Last.fm API credentials are embedded in `app/build.gradle.kts`. A targeted audit found no Firebase Analytics/Crashlytics, Sentry, Amplitude, or PostHog SDK references.
- `rg` is unavailable (`/bin/bash: rg: command not found`).

1: # AURA Music: upstream architecture and gap audit
2: 
3: Audit basis: upstream `vivizzz007/vivi-music` at `b10bf919` (`ci: remove nightly telegram workflow`), reviewed 2026-11-03. The repository is GPL-3.0. This document distinguishes the code that exists at that revision from the requested AURA Music local-only product scope.
4: 
5: ## Build and project configuration
6: 
7: - Root Gradle project name: `vivimusic`; Android application module: `:app`.
8: - The app uses Kotlin, Jetpack Compose, Hilt, Room/KSP, DataStore, Media3, and Protocol Buffers.
9: - Android namespace: `com.music.vivi`; application ID: `com.vivi.vivimusic`.
10: - `minSdk = 26`, `compileSdk = 37`, `targetSdk = 37`; Java and Kotlin JVM target 21.
11: - Build flavors include `foss`/`gms` and universal/ABI variants. The `foss` flavor disables Cast availability; the GMS flavor enables it.
12: - `app/build.gradle.kts` contains embedded Last.fm API key and secret values. These are upstream credentials and must not be copied into an offline AURA build.
13: - The upstream baseline was verified with `bash ./gradlew assembleDebug --no-configuration-cache --console=plain` (757 actionable tasks; 120 executed, 637 up-to-date). The wrapper file is not executable in this checkout, hence the explicit `bash` invocation.
14: 
15: ## Module map
16: 
17: | Module | Upstream role | AURA disposition |
18: | --- | --- | --- |
19: | `:app` | Android UI, app lifecycle, dependency injection, Room, Media3 service, widgets and integrations | Retain and rework for AURA local playback |
20: | `:innertube` | YouTube Music/Innertube networking and extraction | Remove from AURA runtime/build |
21: | `:jiosaavn` | JioSaavn search/streaming integration | Remove from AURA runtime/build |
22: | `:spotify` | Spotify API/Canvas integration | Remove from AURA runtime/build |
23: | `:lastfm` | Last.fm integration/scrobbling | Remove from AURA runtime/build |
24: | `:kizzy` | Discord rich-presence integration | Remove from AURA runtime/build |
25: | `:shazamkit` | ShazamKit integration | Remove from AURA runtime/build |
26: | `:artistvideo` | Artist-video feature | Remove from AURA runtime/build |
27: | `:Motionartwork` | Motion artwork/Canvas provider | Remove from AURA runtime/build |
28: | `:lyricsProvider` | Online lyrics providers/scraping | Remove from AURA runtime/build; retain only sidecar/local lyrics support if needed |
29: 
30: The exact dependency edges and unused code should be rechecked as each module is detached; deleting source modules before Gradle references and UI entry points are removed risks breaking compilation.
31: 
32: ## Architecture findings
33: 
34: ### Dependency injection
35: 
36: The app is Hilt-based. `app/src/main/kotlin/com/music/vivi/di/AppModule.kt` supplies application-level dependencies, including cache-related objects. Feature and persistence services are injected into ViewModels and the playback service. AURA should keep Hilt and bind local catalog/scanner and local-file access abstractions rather than online providers.
37: 
38: ### Database and persistence
39: 
40: `app/src/main/kotlin/com/music/vivi/db/MusicDatabase.kt` and `DatabaseDao.kt` define the Room database and queries. Upstream already has catalog-oriented song/album/artist/playlist data and database migrations. Playback queue/player state is persisted through the existing preference/state layer. The upstream database is designed primarily around remote catalog IDs and metadata; local URI, stable file identity, folder membership, and scan state are not established as a complete local-library model. Prefer additive schema changes with migrations, not destructive recreation.
41: 
42: M3U import/export exists in `BackupRestoreViewModel.kt` and `utils/PlaylistExporter.kt`, but it is oriented around playlist/catalog metadata and does not provide complete robust resolution of local filesystem entries into playable tracks. AURA needs path/URI-aware import/export and missing-file handling.
43: 
44: ### Playback
45: 
46: `playback/MusicService.kt` uses Media3 and persists playback state; `MediaLibrarySessionCallback.kt` exposes a media library/session. Existing media item construction (`extensions/MediaItemExt.kt`) assumes upstream media identities and can participate in remote stream resolution. AURA must ensure that queue items use local content URIs and that the service resolves only locally authorized media, with notification/background playback and restart restoration retained.
47: 
48: No local-device media scanner or end-to-end local-file playback path was found in the audited app source. Local permission handling, MediaStore indexing, folder browsing and selection, and `.lrc` sidecar discovery are gaps.
49: 
50: ### UI, navigation, and theme
51: 
52: The interface is a large Jetpack Compose application with player, library, search, settings, playlist, online integration, and updater routes. `ui/screens/NavigationBuilder.kt` includes online integrations. The theme is defined in `ui/theme/Theme.kt`, including Material You/dynamic color behavior. AURA requires its own monochrome palette/assets and a pared-down primary navigation for Home, Search, Library and Settings. Search should only search the indexed local catalog.
53: 
54: Canvas is overloaded in upstream source to refer both to the online animated artwork feature and to Compose drawing primitives. Removing animated online Canvas artwork must not remove Compose `Canvas` uses for sliders, lyric rendering, or other local UI drawing.
55: 
56: ## Requirement-by-requirement gap analysis
57: 
58: | Requirement | Status at upstream revision | Evidence / work required |
59: | --- | --- | --- |
60: | GPL-3.0 derivative with upstream history and remote preserved | Exists as foundation | Repository has upstream history and `origin`; retain LICENSE and relevant copyright notices, document AURA modifications and attribution. |
61: | AURA Music name, monochrome identity and assets | Missing | Project/app branding remains Vivi Music; update app labels, icons, splash/metadata, theme and documentation without removing upstream notices. |
62: | Local-only operation; no network audio/metadata acquisition | Missing | Innertube, JioSaavn, Spotify and lyrics provider integrations are included. Remove dependencies/routes and ensure local player has no network fallback. |
63: | Local device audio scanning/indexing | Missing | No complete MediaStore scanner was found. Implement permission-aware scan, refresh and catalog persistence. |
64: | Folder browsing | Missing | Build a local folder view backed by indexed local URIs/paths. |
65: | Local file playback | Missing | Existing Media3 session/player is reusable, but local content URI construction/resolution is not a full app path. |
66: | M3U import/export for local tracks | Partial | Import/export utilities exist, but local paths, URI permissions, unavailable items and local queue mapping need implementation and tests. |
67: | Local `.lrc` lyrics | Missing | Existing lyrics are provider/online oriented; implement same-directory sidecar lookup and timed/plain text parsing. |
68: | Persistent queue and playback position | Partial / present | Existing database/preferences and service persist player state. Verify restart restoration specifically for local content URIs and update/add regression tests. |
69: | Home, Search, Library, Settings navigation | Partial | Equivalent navigation and settings exist among larger online-oriented surfaces; simplify and rewire search/library to local data only. |
70: | Remove Discord presence | Present upstream; remove | `:kizzy` and associated preferences/service/UI must not be included. |
71: | Remove animated Canvas/artwork online features | Present upstream; remove | `:Motionartwork`, Spotify Canvas, artwork fetching and related settings/routes; retain ordinary Compose drawing Canvas. |
72: | Remove analytics and crash telemetry | No targeted analytics/crash SDK found in inspected app source | No Firebase Analytics/Crashlytics, Sentry, Amplitude or PostHog symbols were found by the initial targeted search. Recheck all dependencies, manifest providers and build plugins before claiming removal. |
73: | Remove OTA/updater | Present upstream; remove | Updater workers, download/install flows, release checks, update routes/notifications and update-specific permissions should be removed. |
74: | Remove hard-coded online credentials | Present upstream; remove | Last.fm values in `app/build.gradle.kts` must be deleted along with the provider integration. |
75: | Tests for local behavior and retained behavior | Missing for new functionality | Keep applicable upstream tests; add scanner, M3U, lyrics, URI playback/persistence tests and run available test/build tasks per stage. |
76: 
77: ## Removal and retention policy
78: 
79: Remove networking and online service integrations, not useful local Android infrastructure. Retain the Media3 playback service/session, Room and migrations, queue state, local playlist management, notification/background playback, widgets only if they work wholly from local data, and Compose drawing primitives. Explicitly document removed features and do not leave reachable UI routes or hidden background work for the removed services.
80: 
81: ## Staged implementation and verification
82: 
83: Changes are intended to be split into small buildable commits: (1) audit/branding and app identity; (2) offline scope and online feature detachment; (3) local catalog/scanning and folder UI; (4) local playback and persistent queue; (5) local playlists and lyrics; (6) final navigation/theme/docs and full requirement review. Each stage should run its narrow tests and compile check before committing. The baseline build is not evidence that the AURA modifications compile.

## Objective
- Build AURA Music as a GPL-3.0 local-only derivative of `vivizzz007/vivi-music`, preserving upstream history and remote.
- Audit upstream, implement and verify the app in buildable stages, and document removals, attribution, gaps, and test/build results.

## Requirements
- Document upstream architecture, DI, database, playback service, theme, SDK levels, UI, and requirement-by-requirement gaps.
- Rebrand as AURA Music with monochrome styling/assets while retaining upstream copyright notices and GPL-3.0 attribution.
- Remove or exclude streaming/scraping, presence, online Canvas artwork, telemetry/crash reporting, and OTA features; document removals.
- Support local files, scanning, folders, M3U import/export, local lyrics, persistent queue/position, and Home/Search/Library/Settings navigation.
- Retain relevant tests, add tests for new code, and build and commit each stage.

## Decisions
- Work in `/tmp/opencode/aura-upstream`, retaining upstream history and remote `https://github.com/vivizzz007/vivi-music.git`.
- Use local Git author identity `AURA Agent <aura-agent@users.noreply.github.com>`.
- Detach Listen Together UI/navigation first; retain its service/protocol code until app callers are audited.

## Work State
### Completed
- Verified upstream baseline build; committed architecture/gap audit as `12fff80d docs(audit): document upstream architecture and AURA gaps`.
- Implemented AURA identity and monochrome branding; build passed and committed as `2eac54c8 chore(branding): rebrand app as AURA Music`.
- Removed automatic updater checks from launch and Settings entry, plus new-release worker scheduling; committed as `0fbd7791 chore(offline): disable automatic update checks`.
- Detached Listen Together from main navigation screens/routes, Settings and Appearance entries, and top-bar button/title logic; verified with `assembleDebug` and `git diff --check`; committed as `a940b056 chore(offline): detach Listen Together UI`.

### Active
- Remove remaining Listen Together initialization, deep-link handling, crossfade coupling, playback-control guards, and UI/menu/player callers.
- Audit online runtime hooks, manifest components/permissions, app-owned Ktor consumers, and module callers before removing modules/dependencies or documenting retained items.
- Implement and test local-media scanning/playback, folders, playlists/M3U, lyrics, and navigation.
- Finish documenting feature removals and remaining gaps.

### Blocked
- (none)

## Next Move
1. Audit and remove remaining Listen Together callers in `MainActivity.kt`, `MusicService.kt`, `PlayerConnection.kt`, menus, and player UI.
2. Audit startup, playback, routes/settings, manifest, app-owned Ktor consumers, and module callers; remove or document them.
3. Implement and test local catalog scanning and folder navigation; build, update documentation, and commit.

## Relevant Files
- `/tmp/opencode/aura-upstream/docs/AURA_IMPLEMENTATION_LOG.md`: staged changes and verification; Stage 3 commit line still says pending despite commit `a940b056`.
- `/tmp/opencode/aura-upstream/docs/AURA_UPSTREAM_AUDIT.md`: architecture, gaps, and removal/retention policy.
- `/tmp/opencode/aura-upstream/app/src/main/kotlin/com/music/vivi/MainActivity.kt`: remaining Listen Together setup/deep links and GitHub hooks.
- `/tmp/opencode/aura-upstream/app/src/main/kotlin/com/music/vivi/playback/MusicService.kt`: playback hooks and Listen Together crossfade coupling.
- `/tmp/opencode/aura-upstream/app/src/main/kotlin/com/music/vivi/playback/PlayerConnection.kt`: Listen Together playback-control guards.
- `/tmp/opencode/aura-upstream/app/src/main/AndroidManifest.xml`: network, storage, and microphone permissions; online intent filters and receiver.
- `/tmp/opencode/aura-upstream/app/src/main/kotlin/com/music/vivi/App.kt`: third-party initialization and online session settings.
- `/tmp/opencode/aura-upstream/app/src/main/kotlin/com/music/vivi/ui/screens/NavigationBuilder.kt`: remaining online routes.

## Important Context
- Repository is clean on `main`, four commits ahead of `origin/main`; remote remains `https://github.com/vivizzz007/vivi-music.git`.
- Recent search found many additional Listen Together references in menus and player UI beyond the service and activity integrations.
- `App.kt` still initializes InnerTube, cipher extraction, Last.fm, proxy and account settings, and observes YouTube/Spotify/Last.fm session preferences.
- Online modules include `:innertube`, `:jiosaavn`, `:spotify`, `:lastfm`, `:kizzy`, `:shazamkit`, `:artistvideo`, `:Motionartwork`, and `:lyricsProvider`; detach callers before removing modules.
- App-owned Ktor consumers include remote stream extraction, online lyrics, GitHub operations, Wikipedia, and Apple Music album descriptions; assess individually.
- MusicService persistence and local auto-backup must remain; distinguish OTA/update work from local backup.
- Upstream has Room catalog, persisted queue/player state, Media3 playback, M3U utilities, and lyrics storage, but lacks a complete device-local audio scanner/file playback path; M3U import does not resolve entries to local files.
- `INTERNET` and `ACCESS_NETWORK_STATE` are declared; Last.fm API credentials are embedded in `app/build.gradle.kts`. A targeted audit found no Firebase Analytics/Crashlytics, Sentry, Amplitude, or PostHog SDK references.
- `rg` is unavailable (`/bin/bash: rg: command not found`).

@OptIn(ExperimentalCoroutinesApi::class)
class PlayerConnection(
    context: Context,
    binder: MusicBinder,
    val database: MusicDatabase,
    scope: CoroutineScope,
) : Player.Listener {
    private companion object {
        private const val TAG = "PlayerConnection"
        private const val PLAYER_INIT_TIMEOUT_MS = 5000L // 5 second timeout for player initialization
    }

    val service = binder.service
    private val playerReadinessFlow = service.isPlayerReady
    
    /**
     * Safe player accessor checks readiness & handles errors.
     * Should be used by all player access within this class.
     */
    private fun getPlayerSafe(): ExoPlayer {
        return try {
            if (!playerReadinessFlow.value) {
                Timber.tag(TAG).w("Player accessed before service initialization complete; returning best-effort reference")
            }
            service.player
        } catch (e: UninitializedPropertyAccessException) {
            Timber.tag(TAG).e(e, "Fatal: player property accessed but not initialized")
            throw IllegalStateException("MusicService.player not initialized; possible race condition in service startup", e)
        }
    }

    /**
     * Public accessor for player. Throws if player not ready.
     * Callers should check [isPlayerInitialized] before calling, or handle exceptions.
     */
    val player: ExoPlayer
        get() = getPlayerSafe()

    /** Tracks whether player initialization completed successfully */
    private val isPlayerInitialized = MutableStateFlow(service.isPlayerReady.value)

    val playbackState: MutableStateFlow<Int>
    private val playWhenReady: MutableStateFlow<Boolean>
    val isPlaying: kotlinx.coroutines.flow.StateFlow<Boolean>
    
    init {
        Timber.tag(TAG).d("PlayerConnection init: playerReady=${playerReadinessFlow.value}")
        
        // Initialize with player state or safe defaults if player not ready
        val initialState = try {
            val initialPlayer = getPlayerSafe()
            Triple(initialPlayer.playbackState, initialPlayer.playWhenReady, 
                   initialPlayer.playWhenReady && initialPlayer.playbackState != STATE_ENDED)
        } catch (e: Exception) {
            Timber.tag(TAG).e(e, "Error during PlayerConnection initialization, using defaults")
            Triple(Player.STATE_IDLE, false, false)
        }
        
        playbackState = MutableStateFlow(initialState.first)
        playWhenReady = MutableStateFlow(initialState.second)
        isPlaying = combine(playbackState, playWhenReady) { state, ready ->
            ready && state != STATE_ENDED
        }.stateIn(
            scope,
            SharingStarted.Lazily,
            initialState.third
        )
        
        // Track service readiness changes in background.
        scope.launch {
            playerReadinessFlow.collect { ready ->
                isPlayerInitialized.value = ready
                if (ready) {
                    Timber.tag(TAG).d("Service player initialization detected by PlayerConnection")
                }
            }
        }
        
        Timber.tag(TAG).d("PlayerConnection state flows initialized successfully")
    }
    
    // Effective playing state, considers Cast when active
    val isEffectivelyPlaying = combine(
        isPlaying,
        service.castConnectionHandler?.isCasting ?: MutableStateFlow(false),
        service.castConnectionHandler?.castIsPlaying ?: MutableStateFlow(false)
    ) { localPlaying, isCasting, castPlaying ->
        if (isCasting) castPlaying else localPlaying
    }.stateIn(
        scope,
        SharingStarted.Lazily,
        player.playbackState != STATE_ENDED && player.playWhenReady
    )
    
    val mediaMetadata = MutableStateFlow(player.currentMetadata)
    val currentSong =
        mediaMetadata.flatMapLatest {
            database.song(it?.id)
        }
    val currentLyrics = mediaMetadata.flatMapLatest { mediaMetadata ->
        database.lyrics(mediaMetadata?.id)
    }
    val currentFormat =
        mediaMetadata.flatMapLatest { mediaMetadata ->
            database.format(mediaMetadata?.id)
        }

    val radioChips = service.radioChips
    val queueTitle = MutableStateFlow<String?>(null)
    val queueWindows = MutableStateFlow<List<Timeline.Window>>(emptyList())
    val currentMediaItemIndex = MutableStateFlow(-1)
    val currentWindowIndex = MutableStateFlow(-1)

    val shuffleModeEnabled = MutableStateFlow(false)
    val repeatMode = MutableStateFlow(REPEAT_MODE_OFF)

    val canSkipPrevious = MutableStateFlow(true)
    val canSkipNext = MutableStateFlow(true)

    val error = MutableStateFlow<PlaybackException?>(null)
    val isMuted = service.isMuted

    val waitingForNetworkConnection = service.waitingForNetworkConnection
    
    // Callback to check if playback changes should be blocked (e.g., Listen Together guest)
    var shouldBlockPlaybackChanges: (() -> Boolean)? = null
    
    // Flag to allow internal sync operations to bypass blocking (set by ListenTogetherManager)
    @Volatile
    var allowInternalSync: Boolean = false

    var onSkipPrevious: (() -> Unit)? = null
    var onSkipNext: (() -> Unit)? = null

    private var attachedPlayer: Player? = null

    init {
        try {
            // Observe player changes (e.g. crossfade swap)
            scope.launch {
                service.playerFlow.collect { newPlayer ->
                    if (newPlayer != null && newPlayer != attachedPlayer) {
                        updateAttachedPlayer(newPlayer)
                    }
                }
            }
            
            // Initial setup if flow hasn't emitted yet but service is ready
            if (attachedPlayer == null && service.isPlayerReady.value) {
                 updateAttachedPlayer(player)
            }

            Timber.tag(TAG).d("PlayerConnection flow observer registered")
        } catch (e: Exception) {
            Timber.tag(TAG).e(e, "Failed to initialize PlayerConnection listener or state")
            // Propagate the error so MainActivity can retry
            throw e
        }
    }

    private fun updateAttachedPlayer(newPlayer: Player) {
        attachedPlayer?.removeListener(this)
        attachedPlayer = newPlayer
        newPlayer.addListener(this)
        
        // Refresh all state from new player
        playbackState.value = newPlayer.playbackState
        playWhenReady.value = newPlayer.playWhenReady
        mediaMetadata.value = newPlayer.currentMetadata
        queueTitle.value = service.queueTitle
        queueWindows.value = newPlayer.getQueueWindows()
        currentWindowIndex.value = newPlayer.getCurrentQueueIndex()
        currentMediaItemIndex.value = newPlayer.currentMediaItemIndex
        shuffleModeEnabled.value = newPlayer.shuffleModeEnabled
        repeatMode.value = newPlayer.repeatMode
        
        Timber.tag(TAG).d("Attached to new player instance: $newPlayer")
    }

    fun playQueue(queue: Queue) {
        // Block if Listen Together guest (unless internal sync)
        if (!allowInternalSync && shouldBlockPlaybackChanges?.invoke() == true) {
            Timber.tag(TAG).d("playQueue blocked - Listen Together guest")
            return
        }
        if (!playerReadinessFlow.value) {
            Timber.tag(TAG).w("playQueue called before player ready; delegating to service")
        }
        try {
            service.playQueue(queue)
        } catch (e: Exception) {
            Timber.tag(TAG).e(e, "Error in playQueue")
            throw e
        }
    }

    fun selectRadioChip(chip: RadioChip) {
        service.applyRadioChip(chip)
    }

    fun startRadioSeamlessly() {
        // Block if Listen Together guest
        if (shouldBlockPlaybackChanges?.invoke() == true) {
            Timber.tag("PlayerConnection").d("startRadioSeamlessly blocked - Listen Together guest")
            return
        }
        if (!playerReadinessFlow.value) {

        }
        try {
            service.startRadioSeamlessly()
        } catch (e: Exception) {
            Timber.tag(TAG).e(e, "Error in startRadioSeamlessly")
            throw e
        }
    }

messages.summary:
## Objective
- Build AURA Music as a GPL-3.0 local-only derivative of `vivizzz007/vivi-music`, preserving upstream history and remote.
- Audit upstream, implement and verify the app in buildable stages, and document removals, attribution, gaps, and test/build results.

## Requirements
- Document upstream architecture, DI, database, playback service, theme, SDK levels, UI, and requirement-by-requirement gaps.
- Rebrand as AURA Music with monochrome styling/assets while retaining upstream copyright notices and GPL-3.0 attribution.
- Remove or exclude streaming/scraping, presence, online Canvas artwork, telemetry/crash reporting, and OTA features; document removals.
- Support local files, scanning, folders, M3U import/export, local lyrics, persistent queue/position, and Home/Search/Library/Settings navigation.
- Retain relevant tests, add tests for new code, and build and commit each stage.

## Decisions
- Work in `/tmp/opencode/aura-upstream`, retaining upstream history and remote `https://github.com/vivizzz007/vivi-music.git`.
- Use local Git author identity `AURA Agent <aura-agent@users.noreply.github.com>`.
- Detach Listen Together UI/navigation first; retain its service/protocol code until app callers are audited.

## Work State
### Completed
- Verified upstream baseline build; committed architecture/gap audit as `12fff80d docs(audit): document upstream architecture and AURA gaps`.
- Implemented AURA identity and monochrome branding; build passed and committed as `2eac54c8 chore(branding): rebrand app as AURA Music`.
- Removed automatic updater checks from launch and Settings entry, plus new-release worker scheduling; committed as `0fbd7791 chore(offline): disable automatic update checks`.
- Detached Listen Together from main navigation screens/routes, Settings and Appearance entries, and top-bar button/title logic; verified with `assembleDebug` and `git diff --check`; committed as `a940b056 chore(offline): detach Listen Together UI`.

### Active
- Remove remaining Listen Together initialization, deep-link handling, crossfade coupling, playback-control guards, and UI/menu/player callers.
- Audit online runtime hooks, manifest components/permissions, app-owned Ktor consumers, and module callers before removing modules/dependencies or documenting retained items.
- Implement and test local-media scanning/playback, folders, playlists/M3U, lyrics, and navigation.
- Finish documenting feature removals and remaining gaps.

### Blocked
- (none)

## Next Move
1. Audit and remove remaining Listen Together callers in `MainActivity.kt`, `MusicService.kt`, `PlayerConnection.kt`, menus, and player UI.
2. Audit startup, playback, routes/settings, manifest, app-owned Ktor consumers, and module callers; remove or document them.
3. Implement and test local catalog scanning and folder navigation; build, update documentation, and commit.

## Relevant Files
- `/tmp/opencode/aura-upstream/docs/AURA_IMPLEMENTATION_LOG.md`: staged changes and verification; Stage 3 commit line still says pending despite commit `a940b056`.
- `/tmp/opencode/aura-upstream/docs/AURA_UPSTREAM_AUDIT.md`: architecture, gaps, and removal/retention policy.
- `/tmp/opencode/aura-upstream/app/src/main/kotlin/com/music/vivi/MainActivity.kt`: remaining Listen Together setup/deep links and GitHub hooks.
- `/tmp/opencode/aura-upstream/app/src/main/kotlin/com/music/vivi/playback/MusicService.kt`: playback hooks and Listen Together crossfade coupling.
- `/tmp/opencode/aura-upstream/app/src/main/kotlin/com/music/vivi/playback/PlayerConnection.kt`: Listen Together playback-control guards.
- `/tmp/opencode/aura-upstream/app/src/main/AndroidManifest.xml`: network, storage, and microphone permissions; online intent filters and receiver.
- `/tmp/opencode/aura-upstream/app/src/main/kotlin/com/music/vivi/App.kt`: third-party initialization and online session settings.
- `/tmp/opencode/aura-upstream/app/src/main/kotlin/com/music/vivi/ui/screens/NavigationBuilder.kt`: remaining online routes.

## Important Context
- Repository is clean on `main`, four commits ahead of `origin/main`; remote remains `https://github.com/vivizzz007/vivi-music.git`.
- Recent source searches found additional Listen Together references in `MainActivity.kt`, `MusicService.kt`, `PlayerConnection.kt`, player/queue UI, and menus; no further changes were made in this audit.
- `App.kt` still initializes InnerTube, cipher extraction, Last.fm, proxy and account settings, and observes YouTube/Spotify/Last.fm session preferences.
- Online modules include `:innertube`, `:jiosaavn`, `:spotify`, `:lastfm`, `:kizzy`, `:shazamkit`, `:artistvideo`, `:Motionartwork`, and `:lyricsProvider`; detach callers before removing modules.
- App-owned Ktor consumers include remote stream extraction, online lyrics, GitHub operations, Wikipedia, and Apple Music album descriptions; assess individually.
- MusicService persistence and local auto-backup must remain; distinguish OTA/update work from local backup.
- Upstream has Room catalog, persisted queue/player state, Media3 playback, M3U utilities, and lyrics storage, but lacks a complete device-local audio scanner/file playback path; M3U import does not resolve entries to local files.
- `INTERNET` and `ACCESS_NETWORK_STATE` are declared; Last.fm API credentials are embedded in `app/build.gradle.kts`. A targeted audit found no Firebase Analytics/Crashlytics, Sentry, Amplitude, or PostHog SDK references.
- `rg` is unavailable (`/bin/bash: rg: command not found`).

## Objective
- Build AURA Music as a GPL-3.0 local-only derivative of `vivizzz007/vivi-music`, preserving upstream history and remote.
- Audit upstream, implement and verify the app in buildable stages, and document removals, attribution, gaps, and test/build results.

## Requirements
- Document upstream architecture, DI, database, playback service, theme, SDK levels, UI, and requirement-by-requirement gaps.
- Rebrand as AURA Music with monochrome styling/assets while retaining upstream copyright notices and GPL-3.0 attribution.
- Remove or exclude streaming/scraping, presence, online Canvas artwork, telemetry/crash reporting, and OTA features; document removals.
- Support local files, scanning, folders, M3U import/export, local lyrics, persistent queue/position, and Home/Search/Library/Settings navigation.
- Retain relevant tests, add tests for new code, and build and commit each stage.

## Decisions
- Work in `/tmp/opencode/aura-upstream`, retaining upstream history and remote `https://github.com/vivizzz007/vivi-music.git`.
- Use local Git author identity `AURA Agent <aura-agent@users.noreply.github.com>`.
- Detach Listen Together UI/navigation first; retain its service/protocol code until app callers are audited.

## Work State
### Completed
- Verified upstream baseline build; committed architecture/gap audit as `12fff80d docs(audit): document upstream architecture and AURA gaps`.
- Implemented AURA identity and monochrome branding; build passed and committed as `2eac54c8 chore(branding): rebrand app as AURA Music`.
- Removed automatic updater checks from launch and Settings entry, plus new-release worker scheduling; committed as `0fbd7791 chore(offline): disable automatic update checks`.
- Detached Listen Together from main navigation screens/routes, Settings and Appearance entries, and top-bar button/title logic; verified with `assembleDebug` and `git diff --check`; committed as `a940b056 chore(offline): detach Listen Together UI`.

### Active
- Remove remaining Listen Together initialization, deep-link handling, crossfade coupling, playback-control guards, and UI/menu/player callers.
- Audit online runtime hooks, manifest components/permissions, app-owned Ktor consumers, and module callers before removing modules/dependencies or documenting retained items.
- Implement and test local-media scanning/playback, folders, playlists/M3U, lyrics, and navigation.
- Finish documenting feature removals and remaining gaps.

### Blocked
- (none)

## Next Move
1. Remove remaining Listen Together playback guards and UI/menu/player callers, including references in `PlayerConnection.kt`, player screens, and menus.
2. Audit startup, playback, routes/settings, manifest, app-owned Ktor consumers, and module callers; remove or document them.
3. Implement and test local catalog scanning and folder navigation; build, update documentation, and commit.

## Relevant Files
- `/tmp/opencode/aura-upstream/docs/AURA_IMPLEMENTATION_LOG.md`: staged changes and verification; Stage 3 commit line still says pending despite commit `a940b056`.
- `/tmp/opencode/aura-upstream/docs/AURA_UPSTREAM_AUDIT.md`: architecture, gaps, and removal/retention policy.
- `/tmp/opencode/aura-upstream/app/src/main/kotlin/com/music/vivi/MainActivity.kt`: remaining Listen Together setup/deep links and GitHub hooks.
- `/tmp/opencode/aura-upstream/app/src/main/kotlin/com/music/vivi/playback/MusicService.kt`: playback hooks and Listen Together crossfade coupling.
- `/tmp/opencode/aura-upstream/app/src/main/kotlin/com/music/vivi/playback/PlayerConnection.kt`: Listen Together playback-control guards.
- `/tmp/opencode/aura-upstream/app/src/main/AndroidManifest.xml`: network, storage, and microphone permissions; online intent filters and receiver.
- `/tmp/opencode/aura-upstream/app/src/main/kotlin/com/music/vivi/App.kt`: third-party initialization and online session settings.
- `/tmp/opencode/aura-upstream/app/src/main/kotlin/com/music/vivi/ui/screens/NavigationBuilder.kt`: remaining online routes.

## Important Context
- Repository is clean on `main`, four commits ahead of `origin/main`; remote remains `https://github.com/vivizzz007/vivi-music.git`.
- Latest inspection found Listen Together guest restrictions and UI callers across player, thumbnail, mini-player, queue, lyrics, artist screens, and menus; no edits were made during that inspection.
- `MainActivity.kt` still injects `ListenTogetherManager`, and `PlayerConnection.kt` still has `shouldBlockPlaybackChanges` and `allowInternalSync`.
- `App.kt` still initializes InnerTube, cipher extraction, Last.fm, proxy and account settings, and observes YouTube/Spotify/Last.fm session preferences.
- Online modules include `:innertube`, `:jiosaavn`, `:spotify`, `:lastfm`, `:kizzy`, `:shazamkit`, `:artistvideo`, `:Motionartwork`, and `:lyricsProvider`; detach callers before removing modules.
- App-owned Ktor consumers include remote stream extraction, online lyrics, GitHub operations, Wikipedia, and Apple Music album descriptions; assess individually.
- MusicService persistence and local auto-backup must remain; distinguish OTA/update work from local backup.
- Upstream has Room catalog, persisted queue/player state, Media3 playback, M3U utilities, and lyrics storage, but lacks a complete device-local audio scanner/file playback path; M3U import does not resolve entries to local files.
- `INTERNET` and `ACCESS_NETWORK_STATE` are declared; Last.fm API credentials are embedded in `app/build.gradle.kts`. A targeted audit found no Firebase Analytics/Crashlytics, Sentry, Amplitude, or PostHog SDK references.
- `rg` is unavailable (`/bin/bash: rg: command not found`).

## Objective
- Build AURA Music as a GPL-3.0 local-only derivative of `vivizzz007/vivi-music`, preserving upstream history and remote.
- Audit upstream, implement and verify the app in buildable stages, and document removals, attribution, gaps, and test/build results.

## Requirements
- Document upstream architecture, DI, database, playback service, theme, SDK levels, UI, and requirement-by-requirement gaps.
- Rebrand as AURA Music with monochrome styling/assets while retaining upstream copyright notices and GPL-3.0 attribution.
- Remove or exclude streaming/scraping, presence, online Canvas artwork, telemetry/crash reporting, and OTA features; document removals.
- Support local files, scanning, folders, M3U import/export, local lyrics, persistent queue/position, and Home/Search/Library/Settings navigation.
- Retain relevant tests, add tests for new code, and build and commit each stage.

## Decisions
- Work in `/tmp/opencode/aura-upstream`, retaining upstream history and remote `https://github.com/vivizzz007/vivi-music.git`.
- Use local Git author identity `AURA Agent <aura-agent@users.noreply.github.com>`.
- Detach Listen Together UI/navigation first; retain its service/protocol code until app callers are audited.

## Work State
### Completed
- Verified upstream baseline build; committed architecture/gap audit as `12fff80d docs(audit): document upstream architecture and AURA gaps`.
- Implemented AURA identity and monochrome branding; build passed and committed as `2eac54c8 chore(branding): rebrand app as AURA Music`.
- Removed automatic updater checks from launch and Settings entry, plus new-release worker scheduling; committed as `0fbd7791 chore(offline): disable automatic update checks`.
- Detached Listen Together from main navigation screens/routes, Settings and Appearance entries, and top-bar button/title logic; verified with `assembleDebug` and `git diff --check`; committed as `a940b056 chore(offline): detach Listen Together UI`.

### Active
- Remove remaining Listen Together initialization, deep-link handling, crossfade coupling, playback-control guards, and UI/menu/player callers.
- Audit online runtime hooks, manifest components/permissions, app-owned Ktor consumers, and module callers before removing modules/dependencies or documenting retained items.
- Implement and test local-media scanning/playback, folders, playlists/M3U, lyrics, and navigation.
- Finish documenting feature removals and remaining gaps.

### Blocked
- (none)

## Next Move
1. Remove remaining Listen Together playback guards and UI/menu/player callers, including references in `PlayerConnection.kt`, player screens, and menus.
2. Audit startup, playback, routes/settings, manifest, app-owned Ktor consumers, and module callers; remove or document them.
3. Implement and test local catalog scanning and folder navigation; build, update documentation, and commit.

## Relevant Files
- `/tmp/opencode/aura-upstream/docs/AURA_IMPLEMENTATION_LOG.md`: staged changes and verification; Stage 3 commit line still says pending despite commit `a940b056`.
- `/tmp/opencode/aura-upstream/docs/AURA_UPSTREAM_AUDIT.md`: architecture, gaps, and removal/retention policy.
- `/tmp/opencode/aura-upstream/app/src/main/kotlin/com/music/vivi/playback/PlayerConnection.kt`: remaining Listen Together playback-control guards.
- `/tmp/opencode/aura-upstream/app/src/main/kotlin/com/music/vivi/MainActivity.kt`: remaining Listen Together setup/deep links and GitHub hooks.
- `/tmp/opencode/aura-upstream/app/src/main/kotlin/com/music/vivi/playback/MusicService.kt`: playback hooks and Listen Together crossfade coupling.

messages.summary:
## Objective
- Build AURA Music as a GPL-3.0 local-only derivative of `vivizzz007/vivi-music`, preserving upstream history and remote.
- Audit upstream, implement and verify the app in buildable stages, and document removals, attribution, gaps, and test/build results.

## Requirements
- Document upstream architecture, DI, database, playback service, theme, SDK levels, UI, and requirement-by-requirement gaps.
- Rebrand as AURA Music with monochrome styling/assets while retaining upstream copyright notices and GPL-3.0 attribution.
- Remove or exclude streaming/scraping, presence, online Canvas artwork, telemetry/crash reporting, and OTA features; document removals.
- Support local files, scanning, folders, M3U import/export, local lyrics, persistent queue/position, and Home/Search/Library/Settings navigation.
- Retain relevant tests, add tests for new code, and build and commit each stage.

## Decisions
- Work in `/tmp/opencode/aura-upstream`, retaining upstream history and remote `https://github.com/vivizzz007/vivi-music.git`.
- Use local Git author identity `AURA Agent <aura-agent@users.noreply.github.com>`.
- Detach Listen Together UI/navigation first; retain its service/protocol code until app callers are audited.

## Work State
### Completed
- Verified upstream baseline build; committed architecture/gap audit as `12fff80d docs(audit): document upstream architecture and AURA gaps`.
- Implemented AURA identity and monochrome branding; build passed and committed as `2eac54c8 chore(branding): rebrand app as AURA Music`.
- Removed automatic updater checks from launch and Settings entry, plus new-release worker scheduling; committed as `0fbd7791 chore(offline): disable automatic update checks`.
- Detached Listen Together from main navigation screens/routes, Settings and Appearance entries, and top-bar button/title logic; verified with `assembleDebug` and `git diff --check`; committed as `a940b056 chore(offline): detach Listen Together UI`.

### Active
- Remove remaining Listen Together initialization, deep-link handling, crossfade coupling, playback-control guards, and UI/menu/player callers.
- Audit online runtime hooks, manifest components/permissions, app-owned Ktor consumers, and module callers before removing modules/dependencies or documenting retained items.
- Implement and test local-media scanning/playback, folders, playlists/M3U, lyrics, and navigation.
- Finish documenting feature removals and remaining gaps; update the implementation log’s Stage 3 commit line, which still says pending.

### Blocked
- (none)

## Next Move
1. Remove remaining Listen Together playback guards and UI/menu/player callers, including references in `PlayerConnection.kt`, player screens, and menus.
2. Audit startup, playback, routes/settings, manifest, app-owned Ktor consumers, and module callers; remove or document them.
3. Implement and test local catalog scanning and folder navigation; build, update documentation, and commit.

## Relevant Files
- `/tmp/opencode/aura-upstream/docs/AURA_IMPLEMENTATION_LOG.md`: staged changes and verification; Stage 3 commit line is stale.
- `/tmp/opencode/aura-upstream/docs/AURA_UPSTREAM_AUDIT.md`: architecture, gaps, and removal/retention policy.
- `/tmp/opencode/aura-upstream/app/src/main/kotlin/com/music/vivi/playback/PlayerConnection.kt`: remaining Listen Together playback-control guards.
- `/tmp/opencode/aura-upstream/app/src/main/kotlin/com/music/vivi/MainActivity.kt`: remaining Listen Together setup/deep links and GitHub hooks.
- `/tmp/opencode/aura-upstream/app/src/main/kotlin/com/music/vivi/playback/MusicService.kt`: playback hooks and Listen Together crossfade coupling.
- `/tmp/opencode/aura-upstream/app/src/main/kotlin/com/music/vivi/App.kt`: third-party initialization and online session settings.
- `/tmp/opencode/aura-upstream/app/src/main/AndroidManifest.xml`: network, storage, and microphone permissions; online intent filters and receiver.
- `/tmp/opencode/aura-upstream/app/src/main/kotlin/com/music/vivi/ui/screens/NavigationBuilder.kt`: remaining online routes.

## Important Context
- Repository is clean on `main`, four commits ahead of `origin/main`; remote remains `https://github.com/vivizzz007/vivi-music.git`. Recent inspection made no changes.
- Online modules include `:innertube`, `:jiosaavn`, `:spotify`, `:lastfm`, `:kizzy`, `:shazamkit`, `:artistvideo`, `:Motionartwork`, and `:lyricsProvider`; detach callers before removing modules.
- App-owned Ktor consumers include remote stream extraction, online lyrics, GitHub operations, Wikipedia, and Apple Music album descriptions; assess individually.
- MusicService persistence and local auto-backup must remain; distinguish OTA/update work from local backup.
- Upstream has Room catalog, persisted queue/player state, Media3 playback, M3U utilities, and lyrics storage, but lacks a complete device-local audio scanner/file playback path; M3U import does not resolve entries to local files.
- `INTERNET` and `ACCESS_NETWORK_STATE` are declared; Last.fm API credentials are embedded in `app/build.gradle.kts`. A targeted audit found no Firebase Analytics/Crashlytics, Sentry, Amplitude, or PostHog SDK references.
- `rg` is unavailable (`/bin/bash: rg: command not found`).

@OptIn(ExperimentalCoroutinesApi::class)
class PlayerConnection(
    context: Context,
    binder: MusicBinder,
    val database: MusicDatabase,
    scope: CoroutineScope,
) : Player.Listener {
    private companion object {
        private const val TAG = "PlayerConnection"
        private const val PLAYER_INIT_TIMEOUT_MS = 5000L // 5 second timeout for player initialization
    }

    val service = binder.service
    private val playerReadinessFlow = service.isPlayerReady
    
    /**
     * Safe player accessor checks readiness & handles errors.
     * Should be used by all player access within this class.
     */
    private fun getPlayerSafe(): ExoPlayer {
        return try {
            if (!playerReadinessFlow.value) {
                Timber.tag(TAG).w("Player accessed before service initialization complete; returning best-effort reference")
            }
            service.player
        } catch (e: UninitializedPropertyAccessException) {
            Timber.tag(TAG).e(e, "Fatal: player property accessed but not initialized")
            throw IllegalStateException("MusicService.player not initialized; possible race condition in service startup", e)
        }
    }

    /**
     * Public accessor for player. Throws if player not ready.
     * Callers should check [isPlayerInitialized] before calling, or handle exceptions.
     */
    val player: ExoPlayer
        get() = getPlayerSafe()

    /** Tracks whether player initialization completed successfully */
    private val isPlayerInitialized = MutableStateFlow(service.isPlayerReady.value)

    val playbackState: MutableStateFlow<Int>
    private val playWhenReady: MutableStateFlow<Boolean>
    val isPlaying: kotlinx.coroutines.flow.StateFlow<Boolean>
    
    init {
        Timber.tag(TAG).d("PlayerConnection init: playerReady=${playerReadinessFlow.value}")
        
        // Initialize with player state or safe defaults if player not ready
        val initialState = try {
            val initialPlayer = getPlayerSafe()
            Triple(initialPlayer.playbackState, initialPlayer.playWhenReady, 
                   initialPlayer.playWhenReady && initialPlayer.playbackState != STATE_ENDED)
        } catch (e: Exception) {
            Timber.tag(TAG).e(e, "Error during PlayerConnection initialization, using defaults")
            Triple(Player.STATE_IDLE, false, false)
        }
        
        playbackState = MutableStateFlow(initialState.first)
        playWhenReady = MutableStateFlow(initialState.second)
        isPlaying = combine(playbackState, playWhenReady) { state, ready ->
            ready && state != STATE_ENDED
        }.stateIn(
            scope,
            SharingStarted.Lazily,
            initialState.third
        )
        
        // Track service readiness changes in background.
        scope.launch {
            playerReadinessFlow.collect { ready ->
                isPlayerInitialized.value = ready
                if (ready) {
                    Timber.tag(TAG).d("Service player initialization detected by PlayerConnection")
                }
            }
        }
        
        Timber.tag(TAG).d("PlayerConnection state flows initialized successfully")
    }
    
    // Effective playing state, considers Cast when active
    val isEffectivelyPlaying = combine(
        isPlaying,
        service.castConnectionHandler?.isCasting ?: MutableStateFlow(false),
        service.castConnectionHandler?.castIsPlaying ?: MutableStateFlow(false)
    ) { localPlaying, isCasting, castPlaying ->
        if (isCasting) castPlaying else localPlaying
    }.stateIn(
        scope,
        SharingStarted.Lazily,
        player.playbackState != STATE_ENDED && player.playWhenReady
    )
    
    val mediaMetadata = MutableStateFlow(player.currentMetadata)
    val currentSong =
        mediaMetadata.flatMapLatest {
            database.song(it?.id)
        }
    val currentLyrics = mediaMetadata.flatMapLatest { mediaMetadata ->
        database.lyrics(mediaMetadata?.id)
    }
    val currentFormat =
        mediaMetadata.flatMapLatest { mediaMetadata ->
            database.format(mediaMetadata?.id)
        }

    val radioChips = service.radioChips
    val queueTitle = MutableStateFlow<String?>(null)
    val queueWindows = MutableStateFlow<List<Timeline.Window>>(emptyList())
    val currentMediaItemIndex = MutableStateFlow(-1)
    val currentWindowIndex = MutableStateFlow(-1)

    val shuffleModeEnabled = MutableStateFlow(false)
    val repeatMode = MutableStateFlow(REPEAT_MODE_OFF)

    val canSkipPrevious = MutableStateFlow(true)
    val canSkipNext = MutableStateFlow(true)

    val error = MutableStateFlow<PlaybackException?>(null)
    val isMuted = service.isMuted

    val waitingForNetworkConnection = service.waitingForNetworkConnection
    
    // Callback to check if playback changes should be blocked (e.g., Listen Together guest)
    var shouldBlockPlaybackChanges: (() -> Boolean)? = null
    
    // Flag to allow internal sync operations to bypass blocking (set by ListenTogetherManager)
    @Volatile
    var allowInternalSync: Boolean = false

    var onSkipPrevious: (() -> Unit)? = null
    var onSkipNext: (() -> Unit)? = null

    private var attachedPlayer: Player? = null

    init {
        try {
            // Observe player changes (e.g. crossfade swap)
            scope.launch {
                service.playerFlow.collect { newPlayer ->
                    if (newPlayer != null && newPlayer != attachedPlayer) {
                        updateAttachedPlayer(newPlayer)
                    }
                }
            }
            
            // Initial setup if flow hasn't emitted yet but service is ready
            if (attachedPlayer == null && service.isPlayerReady.value) {
                 updateAttachedPlayer(player)
            }

            Timber.tag(TAG).d("PlayerConnection flow observer registered")
        } catch (e: Exception) {
            Timber.tag(TAG).e(e, "Failed to initialize PlayerConnection listener or state")
            // Propagate the error so MainActivity can retry
            throw e
        }
    }

    private fun updateAttachedPlayer(newPlayer: Player) {
        attachedPlayer?.removeListener(this)
        attachedPlayer = newPlayer
        newPlayer.addListener(this)
        
        // Refresh all state from new player
        playbackState.value = newPlayer.playbackState
        playWhenReady.value = newPlayer.playWhenReady
        mediaMetadata.value = newPlayer.currentMetadata
        queueTitle.value = service.queueTitle
        queueWindows.value = newPlayer.getQueueWindows()
        currentWindowIndex.value = newPlayer.getCurrentQueueIndex()
        currentMediaItemIndex.value = newPlayer.currentMediaItemIndex
        shuffleModeEnabled.value = newPlayer.shuffleModeEnabled
        repeatMode.value = newPlayer.repeatMode
        
        Timber.tag(TAG).d("Attached to new player instance: $newPlayer")
    }

    fun playQueue(queue: Queue) {
        // Block if Listen Together guest (unless internal sync)
        if (!allowInternalSync && shouldBlockPlaybackChanges?.invoke() == true) {
            Timber.tag(TAG).d("playQueue blocked - Listen Together guest")
            return
        }
        if (!playerReadinessFlow.value) {
            Timber.tag(TAG).w("playQueue called before player ready; delegating to service")
        }
        try {
            service.playQueue(queue)
        } catch (e: Exception) {
            Timber.tag(TAG).e(e, "Error in playQueue")
            throw e
        }
    }

    fun selectRadioChip(chip: RadioChip) {
        service.applyRadioChip(chip)
