messages.summary:
## Objective
- Build AURA Music as a GPL-3.0 local-only derivative of `vivizzz007/vivi-music`, preserving upstream history and remote.
- Audit upstream, implement and verify the app in buildable stages, and document removals, attribution, gaps, and test/build results.

## Requirements
- Document upstream architecture, DI, database, playback service, theme, SDK levels, UI, and requirement-by-requirement gaps.
- Rebrand as AURA Music with monochrome styling/assets while retaining upstream copyright notices and GPL-3.0 attribution.
- Remove or exclude streaming/scraping, presence, online Canvas artwork, telemetry/crash reporting, and OTA features; document removals.
- Support local files, scanning, folders, M3U import/export, local lyrics, persistent queue/position, and Home/Search/Library/Settings navigation.
- Retain relevant tests, add tests for new code, and build and commit each stage.

## Decisions
- Work in `/tmp/opencode/aura-upstream`, retaining upstream history and remote `https://github.com/vivizzz007/vivi-music.git`.
- Use local Git author identity `AURA Agent <aura-agent@users.noreply.github.com>`.
- Detach Listen Together UI/navigation first; retain its service/protocol code until app callers are audited.

## Work State
### Completed
- Verified upstream baseline build; documented architecture and gaps; committed as `12fff80d docs(audit): document upstream architecture and AURA gaps`.
- Implemented AURA identity and monochrome branding; build passed and committed as `2eac54c8 chore(branding): rebrand app as AURA Music`.
- Disabled automatic updater checks on launch/Settings and new-release worker scheduling; committed as `0fbd7791 chore(offline): disable automatic update checks`.
- Detached Listen Together from main navigation screens/routes, Settings and Appearance entries, and top-bar logic; verified with `assembleDebug` and `git diff --check`; committed as `a940b056 chore(offline): detach Listen Together UI`.

### Active
- Removed 10 Listen Together playback-control guard blocks from `PlayerConnection.kt`; this change is uncommitted and not yet built or verified.
- Remove remaining Listen Together initialization, deep-link handling, crossfade coupling, and runtime UI/menu/player callers.
- Audit online runtime hooks, manifest components/permissions, app-owned Ktor consumers, and module callers before removing modules/dependencies or documenting retained items.
- Implement and test local-media scanning/playback, folders, playlists/M3U, lyrics, and navigation.
- Finish documenting feature removals and remaining gaps; update the implementation log’s Stage 3 commit line, which still says pending.

### Blocked
- (none)

## Next Move
1. Continue removing Listen Together initialization and coupling in `MainActivity.kt` and `MusicService.kt`; audit remaining player/menu callers.
2. Build and verify the uncommitted changes, then audit startup, routes/settings, manifest, app-owned Ktor consumers, and module callers.
3. Implement and test local catalog scanning and folder navigation; update documentation and commit each completed stage.

## Relevant Files
- `/tmp/opencode/aura-upstream/docs/AURA_IMPLEMENTATION_LOG.md`: staged changes and verification; Stage 3 commit line is stale.
- `/tmp/opencode/aura-upstream/docs/AURA_UPSTREAM_AUDIT.md`: architecture, gaps, and removal/retention policy.
- `/tmp/opencode/aura-upstream/app/src/main/kotlin/com/music/vivi/playback/PlayerConnection.kt`: uncommitted removal of Listen Together playback guards.
- `/tmp/opencode/aura-upstream/app/src/main/kotlin/com/music/vivi/MainActivity.kt`: remaining manager setup, deep-link handling, and online hooks.
- `/tmp/opencode/aura-upstream/app/src/main/kotlin/com/music/vivi/playback/MusicService.kt`: remaining manager injection and crossfade coupling.
- `/tmp/opencode/aura-upstream/app/src/main/AndroidManifest.xml`: network, storage, and microphone permissions; online intent filters and receiver.
- `/tmp/opencode/aura-upstream/app/src/main/kotlin/com/music/vivi/ui/screens/NavigationBuilder.kt`: online routes to audit.

## Important Context
- Repository is on `main`, four commits ahead of `origin/main`; remote remains `https://github.com/vivizzz007/vivi-music.git`. Current `PlayerConnection.kt` edits are uncommitted.
- Online modules include `:innertube`, `:jiosaavn`, `:spotify`, `:lastfm`, `:kizzy`, `:shazamkit`, `:artistvideo`, `:Motionartwork`, and `:lyricsProvider`; detach callers before removing modules.
- App-owned Ktor consumers include remote stream extraction, online lyrics, GitHub operations, Wikipedia, and Apple Music album descriptions; assess individually.
- Preserve MusicService persistence and local auto-backup; distinguish OTA/update work from local backup.
- Upstream has Room catalog, persisted queue/player state, Media3 playback, M3U utilities, and lyrics storage, but lacks a complete device-local audio scanner/file playback path; M3U import does not resolve entries to local files.
- `INTERNET` and `ACCESS_NETWORK_STATE` are declared; Last.fm API credentials are embedded in `app/build.gradle.kts`. A targeted audit found no Firebase Analytics/Crashlytics, Sentry, Amplitude, or PostHog SDK references.
- `rg` is unavailable (`/bin/bash: rg: command not found`).

messages.summary:
## Objective
- Build AURA Music as a GPL-3.0 local-only derivative of `vivizzz007/vivi-music`, preserving upstream history and remote.
- Audit upstream, implement and verify the app in buildable stages, and document removals, attribution, gaps, and test/build results.

## Requirements
- Document upstream architecture, DI, database, playback service, theme, SDK levels, UI, and requirement-by-requirement gaps.
- Rebrand as AURA Music with monochrome styling/assets while retaining upstream copyright notices and GPL-3.0 attribution.
- Remove or exclude streaming/scraping, presence, online Canvas artwork, telemetry/crash reporting, and OTA features; document removals.
- Support local files, scanning, folders, M3U import/export, local lyrics, persistent queue/position, and Home/Search/Library/Settings navigation.
- Retain relevant tests, add tests for new code, and build and commit each stage.

## Decisions
- Work in `/tmp/opencode/aura-upstream`, retaining upstream history and remote `https://github.com/vivizzz007/vivi-music.git`.
- Use local Git author identity `AURA Agent <aura-agent@users.noreply.github.com>`.
- Detach Listen Together UI/navigation first; retain its service/protocol code until app callers are audited.

## Work State
### Completed
- Verified upstream baseline build; documented architecture and gaps; committed as `12fff80d docs(audit): document upstream architecture and AURA gaps`.
- Implemented AURA identity and monochrome branding; build passed and committed as `2eac54c8 chore(branding): rebrand app as AURA Music`.
- Disabled automatic updater checks on launch/Settings and new-release worker scheduling; committed as `0fbd7791 chore(offline): disable automatic update checks`.
- Detached Listen Together from main navigation screens/routes, Settings and Appearance entries, and top-bar logic; verified with `assembleDebug` and `git diff --check`; committed as `a940b056 chore(offline): detach Listen Together UI`.
- Removed 10 Listen Together playback-control guard blocks from `PlayerConnection.kt`.

### Active
- Uncommitted edits remove Listen Together manager injection, initialization, player wiring, Compose provision, and deep-link handling from `MainActivity.kt`, and remove its crossfade coupling and injection from `MusicService.kt`.
- Audit and remove remaining Listen Together player/menu/UI callers; changes have not yet been built or verified.
- Audit online runtime hooks, manifest components/permissions, app-owned Ktor consumers, and module callers before removing modules/dependencies or documenting retained items.
- Implement and test local-media scanning/playback, folders, playlists/M3U, lyrics, and navigation.
- Finish documenting feature removals and remaining gaps; update the implementation log’s Stage 3 commit line, which still says pending.

### Blocked
- (none)

## Next Move
1. Remove remaining Listen Together player callbacks and runtime UI/menu callers; the callback fields are still referenced by `ListenTogetherManager.kt`.
2. Build and verify the uncommitted changes, then audit startup, routes/settings, manifest, app-owned Ktor consumers, and module callers.
3. Implement and test local catalog scanning and folder navigation; update documentation and commit each completed stage.

## Relevant Files
- `/tmp/opencode/aura-upstream/docs/AURA_IMPLEMENTATION_LOG.md`: staged changes and verification; Stage 3 commit line is stale.
- `/tmp/opencode/aura-upstream/docs/AURA_UPSTREAM_AUDIT.md`: architecture, gaps, and removal/retention policy.
- `/tmp/opencode/aura-upstream/app/src/main/kotlin/com/music/vivi/MainActivity.kt`: uncommitted removal of manager wiring and Listen Together deep links.
- `/tmp/opencode/aura-upstream/app/src/main/kotlin/com/music/vivi/playback/MusicService.kt`: uncommitted removal of manager injection and crossfade coupling.
- `/tmp/opencode/aura-upstream/app/src/main/kotlin/com/music/vivi/playback/PlayerConnection.kt`: uncommitted removal of playback guards; Listen Together callback fields/invocations remain.
- `/tmp/opencode/aura-upstream/app/src/main/kotlin/com/music/vivi/listentogether/ListenTogetherManager.kt`: remaining consumer of player callbacks.
- `/tmp/opencode/aura-upstream/app/src/main/AndroidManifest.xml`: network, storage, and microphone permissions; online intent filters and receiver.
- `/tmp/opencode/aura-upstream/app/src/main/kotlin/com/music/vivi/ui/screens/NavigationBuilder.kt`: online routes to audit.

## Important Context
- Repository is on `main`, four commits ahead of `origin/main`; current `PlayerConnection.kt`, `MainActivity.kt`, and `MusicService.kt` edits are uncommitted. Remote remains `https://github.com/vivizzz007/vivi-music.git`.
- Online modules include `:innertube`, `:jiosaavn`, `:spotify`, `:lastfm`, `:kizzy`, `:shazamkit`, `:artistvideo`, `:Motionartwork`, and `:lyricsProvider`; detach callers before removing modules.
- App-owned Ktor consumers include remote stream extraction, online lyrics, GitHub operations, Wikipedia, and Apple Music album descriptions; assess individually.
- Preserve MusicService persistence and local auto-backup; distinguish OTA/update work from local backup.
- Upstream has Room catalog, persisted queue/player state, Media3 playback, M3U utilities, and lyrics storage, but lacks a complete device-local audio scanner/file playback path; M3U import does not resolve entries to local files.
- `INTERNET` and `ACCESS_NETWORK_STATE` are declared; Last.fm API credentials are embedded in `app/build.gradle.kts`. A targeted audit found no Firebase Analytics/Crashlytics, Sentry, Amplitude, or PostHog SDK references.
- `rg` is unavailable (`/bin/bash: rg: command not found`).

923:                                             "selfpromo" -> R.string.sponsorblock_skipped_selfpromo

925:                                             "intro" -> R.string.sponsorblock_skipped_intro
926:                                             "outro" -> R.string.sponsorblock_skipped_outro

929:                                         Toast.makeText(this@MusicService, getString(messageRes), Toast.LENGTH_SHORT).show()

## Objective
- Build AURA Music as a GPL-3.0, local-only derivative of `vivizzz007/vivi-music`, preserving upstream history and remote.
- Audit upstream, implement and verify the app in buildable stages, and document removals, attribution, gaps, and test/build results.

## Requirements
- Document upstream architecture, DI, database, playback service, theme, SDK levels, UI, and requirement-by-requirement gaps.
- Rebrand as AURA Music with monochrome styling/assets while retaining upstream copyright notices and GPL-3.0 attribution.
- Remove or exclude streaming/scraping, presence, online Canvas artwork, telemetry/crash reporting, and OTA features; document removals.
- Support local files, scanning, folders, M3U import/export, local lyrics, persistent queue/position, and Home/Search/Library/Settings navigation.
- Retain relevant tests, add tests for new code, and build and commit each stage.

## Decisions
- Work in `/tmp/opencode/aura-upstream`, retaining upstream history and remote `https://github.com/vivizzz007/vivi-music.git`.
- Use local Git author identity `AURA Agent <aura-agent@users.noreply.github.com>`.
- Detach Listen Together UI/navigation first; retain its service/protocol code until app callers are audited.

## Work State
### Completed
- Verified upstream baseline build; documented architecture and gaps; committed as `12fff80d docs(audit): document upstream architecture and AURA gaps`.
- Implemented AURA identity and monochrome branding; build passed and committed as `2eac54c8 chore(branding): rebrand app as AURA Music`.
- Disabled automatic updater checks on launch/Settings and new-release worker scheduling; committed as `0fbd7791 chore(offline): disable automatic update checks`.
- Detached Listen Together from main navigation screens/routes, Settings and Appearance entries, and top-bar logic; verified with `assembleDebug` and `git diff --check`; committed as `a940b056 chore(offline): detach Listen Together UI`.
- Removed 10 Listen Together playback-control guard blocks from `PlayerConnection.kt`.

### Active
- Uncommitted Listen Together removal edits in `MainActivity.kt`, `MusicService.kt`, and `PlayerConnection.kt`; remove remaining player callbacks and runtime UI/menu callers, then build and verify.
- Audit startup, routes/settings, manifest components/permissions, app-owned Ktor consumers, and module callers before removing modules/dependencies or documenting retained items.
- Implement and test local-media scanning/playback, folders, playlists/M3U, lyrics, and navigation.
- Finish documenting feature removals and remaining gaps; update the implementation log’s Stage 3 commit line, which still says pending.

### Blocked
- (none)

## Next Move
1. Remove remaining Listen Together player callbacks and runtime UI/menu callers; callback fields/invocations remain in `PlayerConnection.kt`, and grep found references in menu files.
2. Build and verify the uncommitted changes, then audit startup, routes/settings, manifest, app-owned Ktor consumers, and module callers.
3. Implement and test local catalog scanning and folder navigation; update documentation and commit each completed stage.

## Relevant Files
- `/tmp/opencode/aura-upstream/docs/AURA_IMPLEMENTATION_LOG.md`: staged changes and verification; Stage 3 commit line is stale.
- `/tmp/opencode/aura-upstream/docs/AURA_UPSTREAM_AUDIT.md`: architecture, gaps, and removal/retention policy.
- `/tmp/opencode/aura-upstream/app/src/main/kotlin/com/music/vivi/MainActivity.kt`: uncommitted removal of manager wiring and Listen Together deep links.
- `/tmp/opencode/aura-upstream/app/src/main/kotlin/com/music/vivi/playback/MusicService.kt`: uncommitted removal of manager injection and crossfade coupling.
- `/tmp/opencode/aura-upstream/app/src/main/kotlin/com/music/vivi/playback/PlayerConnection.kt`: uncommitted guard removals; callback fields/invocations remain.
- `/tmp/opencode/aura-upstream/app/src/main/kotlin/com/music/vivi/listentogether/ListenTogetherManager.kt`: remaining consumer of player callbacks.
- `/tmp/opencode/aura-upstream/app/src/main/AndroidManifest.xml`: network, storage, and microphone permissions; online intent filters and receiver.
- `/tmp/opencode/aura-upstream/app/src/main/kotlin/com/music/vivi/ui/screens/NavigationBuilder.kt`: online routes to audit.

## Important Context
- Repository is on `main`, four commits ahead of `origin/main`; `MainActivity.kt`, `MusicService.kt`, and `PlayerConnection.kt` have uncommitted edits. Remote remains `https://github.com/vivizzz007/vivi-music.git`.
- Online modules include `:innertube`, `:jiosaavn`, `:spotify`, `:lastfm`, `:kizzy`, `:shazamkit`, `:artistvideo`, `:Motionartwork`, and `:lyricsProvider`; detach callers before removing modules.
- App-owned Ktor consumers include remote stream extraction, online lyrics, GitHub operations, Wikipedia, and Apple Music album descriptions; assess individually.
- Preserve MusicService persistence and local auto-backup; distinguish OTA/update work from local backup.
- Upstream has Room catalog, persisted queue/player state, Media3 playback, M3U utilities, and lyrics storage, but lacks a complete device-local audio scanner/file playback path; M3U import does not resolve entries to local files.
- `INTERNET` and `ACCESS_NETWORK_STATE` are declared; Last.fm API credentials are embedded in `app/build.gradle.kts`. A targeted audit found no Firebase Analytics/Crashlytics, Sentry, Amplitude, or PostHog SDK references.
- `rg` is unavailable (`/bin/bash: rg: command not found`).

messages.summary:
## Objective
- Build AURA Music as a GPL-3.0, local-only derivative of `vivizzz007/vivi-music`, preserving upstream history and remote.
- Audit upstream, implement and verify the app in buildable stages, and document removals, attribution, gaps, and test/build results.

## Requirements
- Document upstream architecture, DI, database, playback service, theme, SDK levels, UI, and requirement-by-requirement gaps.
- Rebrand as AURA Music with monochrome styling/assets while retaining upstream copyright notices and GPL-3.0 attribution.
- Remove or exclude streaming/scraping, presence, online Canvas artwork, telemetry/crash reporting, and OTA features; document removals.
- Support local files, scanning, folders, M3U import/export, local lyrics, persistent queue/position, and Home/Search/Library/Settings navigation.
- Retain relevant tests, add tests for new code, and build and commit each stage.

## Decisions
- Work in `/tmp/opencode/aura-upstream`, retaining upstream history and remote `https://github.com/vivizzz007/vivi-music.git`.
- Use local Git author identity `AURA Agent <aura-agent@users.noreply.github.com>`.
- Detach Listen Together UI/navigation first; retain its service/protocol code until app callers are audited.

## Work State
### Completed
- Verified upstream baseline build; documented architecture and gaps; committed as `12fff80d docs(audit): document upstream architecture and AURA gaps`.
- Implemented AURA identity and monochrome branding; build passed and committed as `2eac54c8 chore(branding): rebrand app as AURA Music`.
- Disabled automatic updater checks on launch/Settings and new-release worker scheduling; committed as `0fbd7791 chore(offline): disable automatic update checks`.
- Detached Listen Together from main navigation screens/routes, Settings and Appearance entries, and top-bar logic; verified with `assembleDebug` and `git diff --check`; committed as `a940b056 chore(offline): detach Listen Together UI`.

### Active
- Uncommitted Listen Together removal edits in `MainActivity.kt`, `MusicService.kt`, and `PlayerConnection.kt`; main activity/service manager wiring and player guest-blocking guards were removed.
- Audit and remove remaining Listen Together player/menu callers; `PlayerConnection.kt` still has callbacks referenced by `ListenTogetherManager.kt`, and player/menu/screen files retain many manager-dependent UI branches.
- Audit startup, routes/settings, manifest components/permissions, app-owned Ktor consumers, and module callers before removing modules/dependencies or documenting retained items.
- Implement and test local-media scanning/playback, folders, playlists/M3U, lyrics, and navigation.
- Finish documenting feature removals and remaining gaps; update the implementation log’s Stage 3 commit line, which still says pending.

### Blocked
- (none)

## Next Move
1. Continue auditing/removing Listen Together runtime UI/menu references and callback coupling without breaking retained protocol/module code.
2. Build and verify the uncommitted changes, then audit startup, routes/settings, manifest, app-owned Ktor consumers, and module callers.
3. Implement and test local catalog scanning and folder navigation; update documentation and commit each completed stage.

## Relevant Files
- `/tmp/opencode/aura-upstream/docs/AURA_IMPLEMENTATION_LOG.md`: staged changes and verification; Stage 3 commit line is stale.
- `/tmp/opencode/aura-upstream/docs/AURA_UPSTREAM_AUDIT.md`: architecture, gaps, and removal/retention policy.
- `/tmp/opencode/aura-upstream/app/src/main/kotlin/com/music/vivi/MainActivity.kt`: uncommitted manager-wiring and Listen Together deep-link removal.
- `/tmp/opencode/aura-upstream/app/src/main/kotlin/com/music/vivi/playback/MusicService.kt`: uncommitted manager-injection and crossfade-coupling removal.
- `/tmp/opencode/aura-upstream/app/src/main/kotlin/com/music/vivi/playback/PlayerConnection.kt`: uncommitted guest-guard removal; callback fields/invocations remain.
- `/tmp/opencode/aura-upstream/app/src/main/kotlin/com/music/vivi/listentogether/ListenTogetherManager.kt`: retained consumer of player callbacks and sync code.
- `/tmp/opencode/aura-upstream/app/src/main/kotlin/com/music/vivi/ui/menu/PlayerMenu.kt`: remaining Listen Together dialog/menu UI.
- `/tmp/opencode/aura-upstream/app/src/main/AndroidManifest.xml`: network, storage, and microphone permissions; online intent filters and receiver.
- `/tmp/opencode/aura-upstream/app/src/main/kotlin/com/music/vivi/ui/screens/NavigationBuilder.kt`: online routes to audit.

## Important Context
- Repository is on `main`, four commits ahead of `origin/main`; `MainActivity.kt`, `MusicService.kt`, and `PlayerConnection.kt` have uncommitted edits. Remote remains `https://github.com/vivizzz007/vivi-music.git`.
- Online modules include `:innertube`, `:jiosaavn`, `:spotify`, `:lastfm`, `:kizzy`, `:shazamkit`, `:artistvideo`, `:Motionartwork`, and `:lyricsProvider`; detach callers before removing modules.
- App-owned Ktor consumers include remote stream extraction, online lyrics, GitHub operations, Wikipedia, and Apple Music album descriptions; assess individually.
- Preserve MusicService persistence and local auto-backup; distinguish OTA/update work from local backup.
- Upstream has Room catalog, persisted queue/player state, Media3 playback, M3U utilities, and lyrics storage, but lacks a complete device-local audio scanner/file playback path; M3U import does not resolve entries to local files.
- `INTERNET` and `ACCESS_NETWORK_STATE` are declared; Last.fm API credentials are embedded in `app/build.gradle.kts`. A targeted audit found no Firebase Analytics/Crashlytics, Sentry, Amplitude, or PostHog SDK references.
- `PlayerConnection` callback fields (`onSkipPrevious`, `onSkipNext`, `onRestartSong`, `shouldBlockPlaybackChanges`) are referenced by `ListenTogetherManager.kt`; they cannot be deleted independently while retaining that manager code.
- `rg` is unavailable (`/bin/bash: rg: command not found`).

messages.summary:
## Objective
- Build AURA Music as a GPL-3.0, local-only derivative of `vivizzz007/vivi-music`, preserving upstream history and remote.
- Audit, implement, verify, and document the app’s offline features, removals, attribution, gaps, and build/test results.

## Requirements
- Document upstream architecture and requirement-by-requirement gaps.
- Rebrand as AURA Music with monochrome styling while retaining upstream copyright notices and GPL-3.0 attribution.
- Remove or exclude streaming/scraping, presence, online Canvas artwork, telemetry/crash reporting, and OTA features; document removals.
- Support local files, scanning, folders, M3U import/export, local lyrics, persistent queue/position, and Home/Search/Library/Settings navigation.
- Retain relevant tests, add tests for new code, and build and commit each stage.

## Decisions
- Work in `/tmp/opencode/aura-upstream`, retaining upstream history and remote `https://github.com/vivizzz007/vivi-music.git`.
- Use local Git author identity `AURA Agent <aura-agent@users.noreply.github.com>`.
- Detach Listen Together UI/navigation first; retain its service/protocol code until app callers are audited.

## Work State
### Completed
- Verified upstream baseline build; documented architecture and gaps; committed `12fff80d docs(audit): document upstream architecture and AURA gaps`.
- Implemented AURA identity and monochrome branding; build passed and committed `2eac54c8 chore(branding): rebrand app as AURA Music`.
- Disabled automatic updater checks and new-release worker scheduling; committed `0fbd7791 chore(offline): disable automatic update checks`.
- Detached Listen Together from main navigation screens/routes, Settings and Appearance entries, and top-bar logic; verified with `assembleDebug` and `git diff --check`; committed `a940b056 chore(offline): detach Listen Together UI`.

### Active
- Remove remaining Listen Together player/menu UI branches and callback coupling; uncommitted changes already remove manager wiring from `MainActivity.kt` and `MusicService.kt`, and guest playback guards from `PlayerConnection.kt`.
- Audit startup, routes/settings, manifest components/permissions, app-owned Ktor consumers, and module callers before removing modules/dependencies or documenting retained items.
- Implement and test local-media scanning/playback, folders, playlists/M3U, lyrics, and navigation.
- Finish documenting feature removals and remaining gaps; update the implementation log’s Stage 3 commit line, which still says pending.

### Blocked
- `(none)`

## Next Move
1. Continue auditing/removing Listen Together runtime UI/menu references and callback coupling without breaking retained protocol/module code.
2. Build and verify the uncommitted edits; `./gradlew assembleDebug` was attempted but returned `/bin/bash: line 1: ./gradlew: Permission denied`.
3. Audit startup, routes/settings, manifest, app-owned Ktor consumers, and module callers; then implement and test the local catalog and folder flow.

## Relevant Files
- `/tmp/opencode/aura-upstream/docs/AURA_IMPLEMENTATION_LOG.md`: staged changes and verification; Stage 3 commit line is stale.
- `/tmp/opencode/aura-upstream/docs/AURA_UPSTREAM_AUDIT.md`: architecture, gaps, and removal/retention policy.
- `/tmp/opencode/aura-upstream/app/src/main/kotlin/com/music/vivi/MainActivity.kt`: uncommitted Listen Together manager-wiring and deep-link removal.
- `/tmp/opencode/aura-upstream/app/src/main/kotlin/com/music/vivi/playback/MusicService.kt`: uncommitted manager-injection and crossfade-coupling removal.
- `/tmp/opencode/aura-upstream/app/src/main/kotlin/com/music/vivi/playback/PlayerConnection.kt`: uncommitted guest-guard removal; callback fields/invocations remain.
- `/tmp/opencode/aura-upstream/app/src/main/kotlin/com/music/vivi/ui/menu/PlayerMenu.kt`: remaining Listen Together dialog/menu UI.
- `/tmp/opencode/aura-upstream/app/src/main/kotlin/com/music/vivi/ui/menu/OldPlayerMenu.kt`: remaining Listen Together menu UI.
- `/tmp/opencode/aura-upstream/app/src/main/kotlin/com/music/vivi/listentogether/ListenTogetherManager.kt`: retained consumer of player callbacks and sync code.
- `/tmp/opencode/aura-upstream/app/src/main/AndroidManifest.xml`: network, storage, and microphone permissions; online intent filters and receiver.
- `/tmp/opencode/aura-upstream/app/src/main/kotlin/com/music/vivi/ui/screens/NavigationBuilder.kt`: online routes to audit.

## Important Context
- Repository is on `main`, four commits ahead of `origin/main`; `MainActivity.kt`, `MusicService.kt`, and `PlayerConnection.kt` have uncommitted edits. Remote remains `https://github.com/vivizzz007/vivi-music.git`.
- `PlayerConnection` callback fields (`onSkipPrevious`, `onSkipNext`, `onRestartSong`) remain referenced by `ListenTogetherManager.kt`; they cannot be deleted independently while retaining that manager code.
- Listen Together guest-state branches remain throughout player, queue, menu, artist, and lyrics UI; `LocalListenTogetherManager` is still declared in `MainActivity.kt`.
- Online modules include `:innertube`, `:jiosaavn`, `:spotify`, `:lastfm`, `:kizzy`, `:shazamkit`, `:artistvideo`, `:Motionartwork`, and `:lyricsProvider`; detach callers before removing modules.
- App-owned Ktor consumers include remote stream extraction, online lyrics, GitHub operations, Wikipedia, and Apple Music album descriptions; assess individually.
- Preserve MusicService persistence and local auto-backup; distinguish OTA/update work from local backup.
- Upstream has Room catalog, persisted queue/player state, Media3 playback, M3U utilities, and lyrics storage, but lacks a complete device-local audio scanner/file playback path; M3U import does not resolve entries to local files.
- `INTERNET` and `ACCESS_NETWORK_STATE` are declared; Last.fm API credentials are embedded in `app/build.gradle.kts`. A targeted audit found no Firebase Analytics/Crashlytics, Sentry, Amplitude, or PostHog SDK references.
- `rg` is unavailable (`/bin/bash: rg: command not found`).

messages.summary:
## Objective
- Build AURA Music as a GPL-3.0 local-only derivative of `vivizzz007/vivi-music`, preserving upstream history and remote.
- Audit, implement, verify, and document offline features, removals, attribution, remaining gaps, and build/test results.

## Requirements
- Document upstream architecture and requirement-by-requirement gaps.
- Rebrand as AURA Music with monochrome styling while retaining upstream copyright notices and GPL-3.0 attribution.
- Remove or exclude streaming/scraping, presence, online Canvas artwork, telemetry/crash reporting, and OTA features; document removals.
- Support local files, scanning, folders, M3U import/export, local lyrics, persistent queue/position, and Home/Search/Library/Settings navigation.
- Retain relevant tests, add tests for new code, and build and commit each stage.

## Decisions
- Work in `/tmp/opencode/aura-upstream`, retaining upstream history and remote `https://github.com/vivizzz007/vivi-music.git`.
- Use local Git author identity `AURA Agent <aura-agent@users.noreply.github.com>`.
- Detach Listen Together UI/navigation first; retain protocol/module code until app callers are audited.

## Work State
### Completed
- Verified upstream baseline build; documented architecture and gaps; committed `12fff80d docs(audit): document upstream architecture and AURA gaps`.
- Implemented AURA identity and monochrome branding; build passed and committed `2eac54c8 chore(branding): rebrand app as AURA Music`.
- Disabled automatic updater checks and new-release worker scheduling; committed `0fbd7791 chore(offline): disable automatic update checks`.
- Detached Listen Together from navigation, Settings, Appearance, top-bar logic, and routes; verified and committed `a940b056 chore(offline): detach Listen Together UI`.

2: 
3: Audit basis: upstream `vivizzz007/vivi-music` at `b10bf919` (`ci: remove nightly telegram workflow`), reviewed 2026-11-03. The repository is GPL-3.0. This document distinguishes the code that exists at that revision from the requested AURA Music local-only product scope.

5: ## Build and project configuration
6: 
7: - Root Gradle project name: `vivimusic`; Android application module: `:app`.
8: - The app uses Kotlin, Jetpack Compose, Hilt, Room/KSP, DataStore, Media3, and Protocol Buffers.
9: - Android namespace: `com.music.vivi`; application ID: `com.vivi.vivimusic`.

32: ## Architecture findings
33: 
34: ### Dependency injection
35: 
36: The app is Hilt-based. `app/src/main/kotlin/com/music/vivi/di/AppModule.kt` supplies application-level dependencies, including cache-related objects. Feature and persistence services are injected into ViewModels and the playback service. AURA should keep Hilt and bind local catalog/scanner and local-file access abstractions rather than online providers.
37: 
38: ### Database and persistence
39: 
40: `app/src/main/kotlin/com/music/vivi/db/MusicDatabase.kt` and `DatabaseDao.kt` define the Room database and queries. Upstream already has catalog-oriented song/album/artist/playlist data and database migrations. Playback queue/player state is persisted through the existing preference/state layer. The upstream database is designed primarily around remote catalog IDs and metadata; local URI, stable file identity, folder membership, and scan state are not established as a complete local-library model. Prefer additive schema changes with migrations, not destructive recreation.
41: 
42: M3U import/export exists in `BackupRestoreViewModel.kt` and `utils/PlaylistExporter.kt`, but it is oriented around playlist/catalog metadata and does not provide complete robust resolution of local filesystem entries into playable tracks. AURA needs path/URI-aware import/export and missing-file handling.
43: 
44: ### Playback
45: 
46: `playback/MusicService.kt` uses Media3 and persists playback state; `MediaLibrarySessionCallback.kt` exposes a media library/session. Existing media item construction (`extensions/MediaItemExt.kt`) assumes upstream media identities and can participate in remote stream resolution. AURA must ensure that queue items use local content URIs and that the service resolves only locally authorized media, with notification/background playback and restart restoration retained.
47: 
48: No local-device media scanner or end-to-end local-file playback path was found in the audited app source. Local permission handling, MediaStore indexing, folder browsing and selection, and `.lrc` sidecar discovery are gaps.
49: 
50: ### UI, navigation, and theme
51: 
52: The interface is a large Jetpack Compose application with player, library, search, settings, playlist, online integration, and updater routes. `ui/screens/NavigationBuilder.kt` includes online integrations. The theme is defined in `ui/theme/Theme.kt`, including Material You/dynamic color behavior. AURA requires its own monochrome palette/assets and a pared-down primary navigation for Home, Search, Library and Settings. Search should only search the indexed local catalog.
53: 
54: Canvas is overloaded in upstream source to refer both to the online animated artwork feature and to Compose drawing primitives. Removing animated online Canvas artwork must not remove Compose `Canvas` uses for sliders, lyric rendering, or other local UI drawing.
55:

62: | Local-only operation; no network audio/metadata acquisition | Missing | Innertube, JioSaavn, Spotify and lyrics provider integrations are included. Remove dependencies/routes and ensure local player has no network fallback. |

## Objective
- Build AURA Music as a GPL-3.0 local-only derivative of `vivizzz007/vivi-music`, preserving upstream history and remote.
- Audit, implement, verify, and document offline features, removals, attribution, remaining gaps, and build/test results.

## Requirements
- Document upstream architecture and requirement-by-requirement gaps.
- Rebrand as AURA Music with monochrome styling while retaining upstream copyright notices and GPL-3.0 attribution.
- Remove or exclude streaming/scraping, presence, online Canvas artwork, telemetry/crash reporting, and OTA features; document removals.
- Support local files, scanning, folders, M3U import/export, local lyrics, persistent queue/position, and Home/Search/Library/Settings navigation.
- Retain relevant tests, add tests for new code, and build and commit each stage.

## Decisions
- Work in `/tmp/opencode/aura-upstream`, retaining upstream history and remote `https://github.com/vivizzz007/vivi-music.git`.
- Use local Git author identity `AURA Agent <aura-agent@users.noreply.github.com>`.
- Detach Listen Together UI/navigation first; retain protocol/module code until app callers are audited.

## Work State
### Completed
- Verified upstream baseline build; documented architecture and gaps; committed `12fff80d docs(audit): document upstream architecture and AURA gaps`.
- Implemented AURA identity and monochrome branding; build passed and committed `2eac54c8 chore(branding): rebrand app as AURA Music`.
- Disabled automatic updater checks and new-release worker scheduling; committed `0fbd7791 chore(offline): disable automatic update checks`.
- Detached Listen Together from navigation, Settings, Appearance, top-bar logic, and routes; verified and committed `a940b056 chore(offline): detach Listen Together UI`.
- Removed additional Listen Together menu/player coupling in five files; `assembleDebug` succeeded on the uncommitted changes and `git diff --check` passed.

### Active
- Finish auditing remaining Listen Together callers and remove safe-to-remove coupling; update Stage 3 implementation-log details and commit the current changes.
- Audit startup, routes/settings, manifest components/permissions, app-owned Ktor consumers, and module callers before removing modules/dependencies or documenting retained items.
- Implement and test local-media scanning/playback, folders, playlists/M3U, lyrics, and navigation.
- Finish documenting feature removals and remaining gaps.

### Blocked
- (none)

## Next Move
1. Continue the Listen Together caller audit; clean any resulting imports/coupling and update `docs/AURA_IMPLEMENTATION_LOG.md`.
2. Commit the verified current five-file changes as a buildable stage.
3. Audit startup, manifest, routes, network consumers, and online module callers, then proceed with local catalog/scanning work.

## Relevant Files
- `/tmp/opencode/aura-upstream/docs/AURA_IMPLEMENTATION_LOG.md`: staged changes and verification; Stage 3 commit line remains pending.
- `/tmp/opencode/aura-upstream/docs/AURA_UPSTREAM_AUDIT.md`: architecture, gaps, and removal/retention policy.
- `/tmp/opencode/aura-upstream/app/src/main/kotlin/com/music/vivi/MainActivity.kt`: manager wiring and deep-link handling removed; `LocalListenTogetherManager` declaration remains.
- `/tmp/opencode/aura-upstream/app/src/main/kotlin/com/music/vivi/playback/MusicService.kt`: manager injection and crossfade coupling removed.
- `/tmp/opencode/aura-upstream/app/src/main/kotlin/com/music/vivi/playback/PlayerConnection.kt`: guest playback guards removed; callbacks still have manager references.
- `/tmp/opencode/aura-upstream/app/src/main/kotlin/com/music/vivi/ui/menu/PlayerMenu.kt`: Listen Together dialog/menu removal.
- `/tmp/opencode/aura-upstream/app/src/main/kotlin/com/music/vivi/ui/menu/OldPlayerMenu.kt`: Listen Together menu and guest-only controls removed.
- `/tmp/opencode/aura-upstream/app/src/main/AndroidManifest.xml`: network, storage, and microphone permissions; online intent filters and receiver need audit.
- `/tmp/opencode/aura-upstream/app/src/main/kotlin/com/music/vivi/ui/screens/NavigationBuilder.kt`: online routes to audit.

## Important Context
- Repository is on `main`, four commits ahead of `origin/main`; five files have uncommitted changes.
- Latest `bash ./gradlew assembleDebug --no-configuration-cache --console=plain` succeeded in 1m24s; an earlier run timed out at 120s. `git diff --check` passed.
- A Listen Together search found remaining references across app code, including `ListenTogetherActionReceiver` in the manifest and guest-state checks in menus; `PlayerConnection` callback fields remain referenced by `ListenTogetherManager.kt`.
- Online modules include `:innertube`, `:jiosaavn`, `:spotify`, `:lastfm`, `:kizzy`, `:shazamkit`, `:artistvideo`, `:Motionartwork`, and `:lyricsProvider`; detach callers before removing modules.
- App-owned Ktor consumers include remote stream extraction, online lyrics, GitHub operations, Wikipedia, and Apple Music album descriptions; assess individually.
- Preserve MusicService persistence and local auto-backup; distinguish OTA/update work from local backup.
- Upstream has Room catalog, persisted queue/player state, Media3 playback, M3U utilities, and lyrics storage, but lacks a complete device-local audio scanner/file playback path; M3U import does not resolve entries to local files.
- `INTERNET` and `ACCESS_NETWORK_STATE` are declared; Last.fm API credentials are embedded in `app/build.gradle.kts`. A targeted audit found no Firebase Analytics/Crashlytics, Sentry, Amplitude, or PostHog SDK references.
- `rg` is unavailable (`/bin/bash: rg: command not found`).

## Objective
- Build AURA Music as a GPL-3.0 local-only derivative of `vivizzz007/vivi-music`, preserving upstream history and remote.
- Audit, implement, verify, and document offline features, removals, attribution, remaining gaps, and build/test results.

## Requirements
- Document upstream architecture and requirement-by-requirement gaps.
- Rebrand as AURA Music with monochrome styling while retaining upstream copyright notices and GPL-3.0 attribution.
- Remove or exclude streaming/scraping, presence, online Canvas artwork, telemetry/crash reporting, and OTA features; document removals.
- Support local files, scanning, folders, M3U import/export, local lyrics, persistent queue/position, and Home/Search/Library/Settings navigation.
- Retain relevant tests, add tests for new code, and build and commit each stage.

## Decisions
- Work in `/tmp/opencode/aura-upstream`, retaining upstream history and remote `https://github.com/vivizzz007/vivi-music.git`.
- Use local Git author identity `AURA Agent <aura-agent@users.noreply.github.com>`.
- Detach Listen Together UI/navigation first; audit remaining callers before removing protocol/module code.

## Work State
### Completed
- Verified upstream baseline build; documented architecture and gaps; committed `12fff80d docs(audit): document upstream architecture and AURA gaps`.
- Implemented AURA identity and monochrome branding; build passed and committed `2eac54c8 chore(branding): rebrand app as AURA Music`.
- Disabled automatic updater checks and new-release worker scheduling; committed `0fbd7791 chore(offline): disable automatic update checks`.
- Detached Listen Together from navigation, Settings, Appearance, top-bar logic, and routes; committed `a940b056 chore(offline): detach Listen Together UI`.
- Removed additional Listen Together menu/player coupling in five files; `assembleDebug` succeeded on the uncommitted changes and `git diff --check` passed.

### Active
- Continue auditing Listen Together callers; remove safe-to-remove coupling, update Stage 3 implementation-log details, and commit the current changes.
- Audit startup, routes/settings, manifest components/permissions, app-owned Ktor consumers, and module callers before removing modules/dependencies or documenting retained items.
- Implement and test local-media scanning/playback, folders, playlists/M3U, lyrics, and navigation.
- Finish documenting feature removals and remaining gaps.

### Blocked
- (none)

## Next Move
1. Continue auditing remaining Listen Together callers, including guest-state checks in `Player.kt` and `ArtistMenu.kt`, plus the manifest invite-link entry.
2. Update `docs/AURA_IMPLEMENTATION_LOG.md`, verify, and commit the current five-file changes.
3. Audit startup, manifest, routes, network consumers, and online module callers before proceeding with local catalog/scanning work.

## Relevant Files
- `/tmp/opencode/aura-upstream/docs/AURA_IMPLEMENTATION_LOG.md`: staged changes and verification; Stage 3 commit line remains pending.
- `/tmp/opencode/aura-upstream/docs/AURA_UPSTREAM_AUDIT.md`: architecture, gaps, and removal/retention policy.
- `/tmp/opencode/aura-upstream/app/src/main/kotlin/com/music/vivi/MainActivity.kt`: manager declaration and remaining startup/deep-link paths to audit.
- `/tmp/opencode/aura-upstream/app/src/main/kotlin/com/music/vivi/playback/MusicService.kt`: Listen Together service coupling was partly removed.
- `/tmp/opencode/aura-upstream/app/src/main/kotlin/com/music/vivi/playback/PlayerConnection.kt`: callbacks still have manager references.
- `/tmp/opencode/aura-upstream/app/src/main/kotlin/com/music/vivi/ui/player/Player.kt`: remaining guest-state controls and manager references.
- `/tmp/opencode/aura-upstream/app/src/main/kotlin/com/music/vivi/ui/menu/ArtistMenu.kt`: remaining guest-state checks.
- `/tmp/opencode/aura-upstream/app/src/main/kotlin/com/music/vivi/ui/menu/PlayerMenu.kt`: Listen Together menu/dialog removal.
- `/tmp/opencode/aura-upstream/app/src/main/kotlin/com/music/vivi/ui/menu/OldPlayerMenu.kt`: Listen Together menu and guest-only controls removal.
- `/tmp/opencode/aura-upstream/app/src/main/AndroidManifest.xml`: permissions and Listen Together invite-link intent filter to audit.
- `/tmp/opencode/aura-upstream/app/src/main/kotlin/com/music/vivi/ui/screens/NavigationBuilder.kt`: online routes to audit.

## Important Context
- Repository is on `main`, four commits ahead of `origin/main`; five files have uncommitted changes.
- Latest `bash ./gradlew assembleDebug --no-configuration-cache --console=plain` succeeded; `git diff --check` passed.
- A broader Listen Together search found many remaining app references; output was truncated. `Player.kt` has guest controls; `ArtistMenu.kt` has guest checks; the manifest still has an HTTPS invite-link intent filter.
- Online modules include `:innertube`, `:jiosaavn`, `:spotify`, `:lastfm`, `:kizzy`, `:shazamkit`, `:artistvideo`, `:Motionartwork`, and `:lyricsProvider`; detach callers before removing modules.
- App-owned Ktor consumers include remote stream extraction, online lyrics, GitHub operations, Wikipedia, and Apple Music album descriptions; assess individually.
- Preserve MusicService persistence and local auto-backup; distinguish OTA/update work from local backup.
- Upstream has Room catalog, persisted queue/player state, Media3 playback, M3U utilities, and lyrics storage, but lacks a complete device-local audio scanner/file playback path; M3U import does not resolve entries to local files.
- `INTERNET` and `ACCESS_NETWORK_STATE` are declared; Last.fm API credentials are embedded in `app/build.gradle.kts`. A targeted audit found no Firebase Analytics/Crashlytics, Sentry, Amplitude, or PostHog SDK references.
- `rg` is unavailable (`/bin/bash: rg: command not found`).

messages.summary:
## Objective
- Build AURA Music as a GPL-3.0 local-only derivative of `vivizzz007/vivi-music`, preserving upstream history and remote.
- Audit, implement, verify, and document offline features, removals, attribution, remaining gaps, and build/test results.

## Requirements
- Document upstream architecture and requirement-by-requirement gaps.
- Rebrand as AURA Music with monochrome styling while retaining upstream copyright notices and GPL-3.0 attribution.
- Remove or exclude streaming/scraping, presence, online Canvas artwork, telemetry/crash reporting, and OTA features; document removals.
- Support local files, scanning, folders, M3U import/export, local lyrics, persistent queue/position, and Home/Search/Library/Settings navigation.
- Retain relevant tests, add tests for new code, and build and commit each stage.

## Decisions
- Work in `/tmp/opencode/aura-upstream`, retaining upstream history and remote `https://github.com/vivizzz007/vivi-music.git`.
- Use local Git author identity `AURA Agent <aura-agent@users.noreply.github.com>`.
- Detach Listen Together UI/navigation first; audit remaining callers before removing protocol/module code.

## Work State
### Completed
- Verified upstream baseline build; documented architecture and gaps; committed `12fff80d docs(audit): document upstream architecture and AURA gaps`.
- Implemented AURA identity and monochrome branding; build passed and committed `2eac54c8 chore(branding): rebrand app as AURA Music`.
- Disabled automatic updater checks and new-release worker scheduling; committed `0fbd7791 chore(offline): disable automatic update checks`.
- Detached Listen Together from navigation, Settings, Appearance, top-bar logic, and routes; committed `a940b056 chore(offline): detach Listen Together UI`.

### Active
- Remove remaining Listen Together player/menu/deep-link coupling and update Stage 3 implementation-log details; changes are uncommitted.
- Audit startup, manifest components/permissions, app-owned Ktor consumers, and online module callers before removing modules/dependencies or documenting retained items.
- Implement and test local-media scanning/playback, folders, playlists/M3U, lyrics, and navigation.
- Finish documenting feature removals and remaining gaps.

### Blocked
- Current `Player.kt` edits are incomplete: guest-state declarations/imports and some conditions were removed, but grep still finds references to `isListenTogetherGuest` and `isMuted`; no build has been run since these latest edits.

## Next Move
1. Finish cleaning `Player.kt` guest-state references and remove the remaining guest checks in `ArtistMenu.kt`.
2. Remove or account for the Listen Together invite-link intent filters and notification receiver in `app/src/main/AndroidManifest.xml`; audit other guest-state callers.
3. Update `docs/AURA_IMPLEMENTATION_LOG.md`, run `assembleDebug` and `git diff --check`, then commit the completed stage.
4. Continue auditing startup, manifest, routes, network consumers, and module callers before local catalog/scanning work.

## Relevant Files
- `/tmp/opencode/aura-upstream/docs/AURA_IMPLEMENTATION_LOG.md`: Stage 3 details and commit line are pending.
- `/tmp/opencode/aura-upstream/docs/AURA_UPSTREAM_AUDIT.md`: architecture, gaps, and removal/retention policy.
- `/tmp/opencode/aura-upstream/app/src/main/kotlin/com/music/vivi/ui/player/Player.kt`: latest partial edits; remaining guest-state references are unresolved.
- `/tmp/opencode/aura-upstream/app/src/main/kotlin/com/music/vivi/ui/menu/ArtistMenu.kt`: remaining guest checks.
- `/tmp/opencode/aura-upstream/app/src/main/AndroidManifest.xml`: Listen Together invite-link filters and action receiver.
- `/tmp/opencode/aura-upstream/app/src/main/kotlin/com/music/vivi/MainActivity.kt`: manager composition local and startup/deep-link paths.
- `/tmp/opencode/aura-upstream/app/src/main/kotlin/com/music/vivi/playback/MusicService.kt`: Listen Together service coupling was partly removed.
- `/tmp/opencode/aura-upstream/app/src/main/kotlin/com/music/vivi/playback/PlayerConnection.kt`: guest-blocking playback checks were removed.
- `/tmp/opencode/aura-upstream/app/src/main/kotlin/com/music/vivi/ui/player/Player_v2.kt`: remaining guest-state checks.
- `/tmp/opencode/aura-upstream/app/src/main/kotlin/com/music/vivi/ui/player/MiniPlayer.kt`: remaining guest-state checks.
- `/tmp/opencode/aura-upstream/app/src/main/kotlin/com/music/vivi/ui/player/AppleMiniPlayer.kt`: remaining guest-state checks.
- `/tmp/opencode/aura-upstream/app/src/main/kotlin/com/music/vivi/ui/player/Queue.kt`: remaining guest-state checks.
- `/tmp/opencode/aura-upstream/app/src/main/kotlin/com/music/vivi/ui/player/PlayerV2Landscape.kt`: remaining guest-state checks.
- `/tmp/opencode/aura-upstream/app/src/main/kotlin/com/music/vivi/ui/player/Thumbnail.kt`: remaining guest-state checks.

## Important Context
- Repository is on `main`; commits through `a940b056` are present. Six files have uncommitted changes, including partial edits to `Player.kt`.
- `assembleDebug` succeeded before the latest `Player.kt` edits; `git diff --check` passed at that earlier point.
- Online modules include `:innertube`, `:jiosaavn`, `:spotify`, `:lastfm`, `:kizzy`, `:shazamkit`, `:artistvideo`, `:Motionartwork`, and `:lyricsProvider`; detach callers before removing modules.
- App-owned Ktor consumers include remote stream extraction, online lyrics, GitHub operations, Wikipedia, and Apple Music album descriptions; assess individually.
- Preserve MusicService persistence and local auto-backup; distinguish OTA/update work from local backup.
- Upstream has Room catalog, persisted queue/player state, Media3 playback, M3U utilities, and lyrics storage, but lacks a complete device-local audio scanner/file playback path; M3U import does not resolve entries to local files.
- `INTERNET` and `ACCESS_NETWORK_STATE` are declared; Last.fm API credentials are embedded in `app/build.gradle.kts`. A targeted audit found no Firebase Analytics/Crashlytics, Sentry, Amplitude, or PostHog SDK references.
- `rg` is unavailable (`/bin/bash: rg: command not found`).

644:             val fetched = when (motionartworkSource) {

646:                     AppleMusicMotionartworkProvider.getBySongArtist(s, a, requestedAlbum, storefront)

649:                         ?.takeIf { !it.preferredAnimationUrl.isNullOrBlank() && validateMotionartworkMatch(it, s, a, requestedAlbum) }
650:                         ?: ViviMusicMotionartworkProvider.getBySongArtist(s, a, requestedAlbum)
651:                         ?.takeIf { !it.preferredAnimationUrl.isNullOrBlank() && validateMotionartworkMatch(it, s, a, requestedAlbum) }
652:                 }
653:                 MotionartworkSource.APPLE_MUSIC -> {
654:                     AppleMusicMotionartworkProvider.getBySongArtist(s, a, requestedAlbum, storefront)
655:                         ?.takeIf { !it.preferredAnimationUrl.isNullOrBlank() }
656:                 }
657:                 MotionartworkSource.VIVIMUSIC -> {
658:                     ViviMusicMotionartworkProvider.getBySongArtist(s, a, requestedAlbum)
659:                         ?.takeIf { !it.preferredAnimationUrl.isNullOrBlank() }

## Objective
- Build AURA Music as a GPL-3.0 local-only derivative of `vivizzz007/vivi-music`, preserving upstream history and remote.
- Audit, implement, verify, and document offline features, removals, attribution, remaining gaps, and build/test results.

## Requirements
- Document upstream architecture and requirement-by-requirement gaps.
- Rebrand as AURA Music with monochrome styling while retaining upstream copyright notices and GPL-3.0 attribution.
- Remove or exclude streaming/scraping, presence, online Canvas artwork, telemetry/crash reporting, and OTA features; document removals.
- Support local files, scanning, folders, M3U import/export, local lyrics, persistent queue/position, and Home/Search/Library/Settings navigation.
- Retain relevant tests, add tests for new code, build and commit each stage.

## Decisions
- Work in `/tmp/opencode/aura-upstream`, retaining upstream history and remote `https://github.com/vivizzz007/vivi-music.git`.
- Use local Git author identity `AURA Agent <aura-agent@users.noreply.github.com>`.
- Detach Listen Together UI/navigation first; audit remaining callers before removing protocol/module code.

## Work State
### Completed
- Verified upstream baseline build; documented architecture and gaps; committed `12fff80d docs(audit): document upstream architecture and AURA gaps`.
- Implemented AURA identity and monochrome branding; build passed and committed `2eac54c8 chore(branding): rebrand app as AURA Music`.
- Disabled automatic updater checks and new-release worker scheduling; committed `0fbd7791 chore(offline): disable automatic update checks`.
- Detached Listen Together from navigation, Settings, Appearance, top-bar logic, and routes; committed `a940b056 chore(offline): detach Listen Together UI`.

### Active
- Remove remaining Listen Together player/menu/deep-link coupling and update Stage 3 implementation-log details; six files currently have uncommitted changes.
- Audit startup, manifest components/permissions, app-owned Ktor consumers, and online module callers before removing modules/dependencies or documenting retained items.
- Implement and test local-media scanning/playback, folders, playlists/M3U, lyrics, and navigation.
- Finish documenting feature removals and remaining gaps.

### Blocked
- `Player.kt` has unresolved `isListenTogetherGuest` and `isMuted` references after partial edits; no build has been run since those edits.

## Next Move
1. Inspect and resolve remaining guest-state references in `Player.kt` and `ArtistMenu.kt`.
2. Audit other guest-state callers found in player/menu UI, then remove Listen Together invite-link filters and notification receiver if no longer used.
3. Update `docs/AURA_IMPLEMENTATION_LOG.md`, run `assembleDebug` and `git diff --check`, then commit the completed stage.
4. Continue auditing startup, manifest, routes, network consumers, and module callers before local catalog/scanning work.

## Relevant Files
- `/tmp/opencode/aura-upstream/docs/AURA_IMPLEMENTATION_LOG.md`: Stage 3 details and commit line are pending.
- `/tmp/opencode/aura-upstream/docs/AURA_UPSTREAM_AUDIT.md`: architecture, gaps, and removal/retention policy.
- `/tmp/opencode/aura-upstream/app/src/main/kotlin/com/music/vivi/ui/player/Player.kt`: partial edits with unresolved guest-state references.
- `/tmp/opencode/aura-upstream/app/src/main/kotlin/com/music/vivi/ui/menu/ArtistMenu.kt`: remaining guest checks.
- `/tmp/opencode/aura-upstream/app/src/main/AndroidManifest.xml`: Listen Together invite-link filters and action receiver.
- `/tmp/opencode/aura-upstream/app/src/main/kotlin/com/music/vivi/MainActivity.kt`: manager composition local and startup/deep-link paths.
- `/tmp/opencode/aura-upstream/app/src/main/kotlin/com/music/vivi/playback/MusicService.kt`: partly removed Listen Together service coupling.
- `/tmp/opencode/aura-upstream/app/src/main/kotlin/com/music/vivi/playback/PlayerConnection.kt`: guest-blocking playback checks were removed.

## Important Context
- Commits through `a940b056` are present; six files have uncommitted changes: `MainActivity.kt`, `MusicService.kt`, `PlayerConnection.kt`, `OldPlayerMenu.kt`, `PlayerMenu.kt`, and `Player.kt`.
- `assembleDebug` and `git diff --check` passed before the latest `Player.kt` edits; not rerun afterward.
- Listen Together references remain across player/menu UI, including `Player_v2.kt`, `Queue_v2.kt`, `MiniPlayer.kt`, `AppleMiniPlayer.kt`, `Queue.kt`, and other menu/screen files.
- Online modules include `:innertube`, `:jiosaavn`, `:spotify`, `:lastfm`, `:kizzy`, `:shazamkit`, `:artistvideo`, `:Motionartwork`, and `:lyricsProvider`; detach callers before removing modules.
- App-owned Ktor consumers include remote stream extraction, online lyrics, GitHub operations, Wikipedia, and Apple Music album descriptions; assess individually.
- Preserve MusicService persistence and local auto-backup; distinguish OTA/update work from local backup.
- Upstream has Room catalog, persisted queue/player state, Media3 playback, M3U utilities, and lyrics storage, but lacks a complete device-local audio scanner/file playback path; M3U import does not resolve entries to local files.
- `INTERNET` and `ACCESS_NETWORK_STATE` are declared; Last.fm API credentials are embedded in `app/build.gradle.kts`. A targeted audit found no Firebase Analytics/Crashlytics, Sentry, Amplitude, or PostHog SDK references.
- `rg` is unavailable (`/bin/bash: rg: command not found`).

## Objective
- Build AURA Music as a GPL-3.0 local-only derivative of `vivizzz007/vivi-music`, preserving upstream history and remote.
- Audit, implement, verify, and document offline features, removals, attribution, remaining gaps, and build/test results.

## Requirements
- Document upstream architecture and requirement-by-requirement gaps.
- Rebrand as AURA Music with monochrome styling while retaining upstream copyright notices and GPL-3.0 attribution.
- Remove or exclude streaming/scraping, presence, online Canvas artwork, telemetry/crash reporting, and OTA features; document removals.
- Support local files, scanning, folders, M3U import/export, local lyrics, persistent queue/position, and Home/Search/Library/Settings navigation.
- Retain relevant tests, add tests for new code, build and commit each stage.

## Decisions
- Work in `/tmp/opencode/aura-upstream`, retaining upstream history and remote `https://github.com/vivizzz007/vivi-music.git`.
- Use local Git author identity `AURA Agent <aura-agent@users.noreply.github.com>`.
- Detach Listen Together UI/navigation first; audit remaining callers before removing protocol/module code.

## Work State
### Completed
- Verified upstream baseline build; documented architecture and gaps; committed `12fff80d docs(audit): document upstream architecture and AURA gaps`.
- Implemented AURA identity and monochrome branding; build passed and committed `2eac54c8 chore(branding): rebrand app as AURA Music`.
- Disabled automatic updater checks and new-release worker scheduling; committed `0fbd7791 chore(offline): disable automatic update checks`.
- Detached Listen Together from navigation, Settings, Appearance, top-bar logic, and routes; committed `a940b056 chore(offline): detach Listen Together UI`.

### Active
- Remove remaining Listen Together player/menu/deep-link coupling and update Stage 3 implementation-log details; six files have uncommitted changes.
- Audit startup, manifest components/permissions, app-owned Ktor consumers, and online module callers before removing modules/dependencies or documenting retained items.
- Implement and test local-media scanning/playback, folders, playlists/M3U, lyrics, and navigation.
- Finish documenting feature removals and remaining gaps.

### Blocked
- `Player.kt` still references removed `isListenTogetherGuest` and `isMuted` state; no build has been run since those edits.
- Guest-state coupling remains across numerous menus and player/queue components, so further detachment and caller audit are needed before removing Listen Together modules.

## Next Move
1. Resolve remaining guest-state references in `Player.kt`; remove dead Listen Together checks from `ArtistMenu.kt` and audit other callers.
2. Remove invite-link filters and the action receiver only after confirming remaining use.
3. Update `docs/AURA_IMPLEMENTATION_LOG.md`, run `assembleDebug` and `git diff --check`, then commit the stage.
4. Continue auditing startup, manifest, routes, network consumers, and module callers before local catalog/scanning work.

## Relevant Files
- `/tmp/opencode/aura-upstream/app/src/main/kotlin/com/music/vivi/ui/player/Player.kt`: remaining guest-state references include unresolved identifiers.
- `/tmp/opencode/aura-upstream/app/src/main/kotlin/com/music/vivi/ui/menu/ArtistMenu.kt`: retains Listen Together guest checks.
- `/tmp/opencode/aura-upstream/app/src/main/kotlin/com/music/vivi/MainActivity.kt`: manager composition provider was removed, but the `LocalListenTogetherManager` declaration remains.
- `/tmp/opencode/aura-upstream/app/src/main/kotlin/com/music/vivi/playback/PlayerConnection.kt`: guest-blocking checks were removed; Listen Together-related fields and mute methods remain.
- `/tmp/opencode/aura-upstream/app/src/main/kotlin/com/music/vivi/playback/MusicService.kt`: Listen Together service coupling was partly removed.
- `/tmp/opencode/aura-upstream/app/src/main/AndroidManifest.xml`: still has Listen Together invite-link filters and action receiver.
- `/tmp/opencode/aura-upstream/docs/AURA_IMPLEMENTATION_LOG.md`: Stage 3 details and commit line are pending.
- `/tmp/opencode/aura-upstream/docs/AURA_UPSTREAM_AUDIT.md`: architecture, gaps, and removal/retention policy.

## Important Context
- Commits through `a940b056` are present; six files remain modified: `MainActivity.kt`, `MusicService.kt`, `PlayerConnection.kt`, `OldPlayerMenu.kt`, `PlayerMenu.kt`, and `Player.kt`.
- `assembleDebug` and `git diff --check` passed before the latest `Player.kt` edits; not rerun afterward.
- Listen Together guest checks also remain across player, queue, lyrics, artist screens, and several menu files; do not remove modules until callers are audited.
- Online modules include `:innertube`, `:jiosaavn`, `:spotify`, `:lastfm`, `:kizzy`, `:shazamkit`, `:artistvideo`, `:Motionartwork`, and `:lyricsProvider`.
- App-owned Ktor consumers include remote stream extraction, online lyrics, GitHub operations, Wikipedia, and Apple Music album descriptions; assess individually.
- Preserve MusicService persistence and local auto-backup; distinguish OTA/update work from local backup.
- Upstream has Room catalog, persisted queue/player state, Media3 playback, M3U utilities, and lyrics storage, but lacks a complete device-local audio scanner/file playback path; M3U import does not resolve entries to local files.
- `INTERNET` and `ACCESS_NETWORK_STATE` are declared; Last.fm API credentials are embedded in `app/build.gradle.kts`. A targeted audit found no Firebase Analytics/Crashlytics, Sentry, Amplitude, or PostHog SDK references.
- `rg` is unavailable (`/bin/bash: rg: command not found`).

## Objective
- Build AURA Music as a GPL-3.0 local-only derivative of `vivizzz007/vivi-music`, preserving upstream history and remote.
- Audit, implement, verify, and document offline features, removals, attribution, remaining gaps, and build/test results.

## Requirements
- Document upstream architecture and requirement-by-requirement gaps.
- Rebrand as AURA Music with monochrome styling while retaining upstream copyright notices and GPL-3.0 attribution.
- Remove or exclude streaming/scraping, presence, online Canvas artwork, telemetry/crash reporting, and OTA features; document removals.
- Support local files, scanning, folders, M3U import/export, local lyrics, persistent queue/position, and Home/Search/Library/Settings navigation.
- Retain relevant tests, add tests for new code, build and commit each stage.

## Decisions
- Work in `/tmp/opencode/aura-upstream`, retaining upstream history and remote `https://github.com/vivizzz007/vivi-music.git`.
- Use local Git author identity `AURA Agent <aura-agent@users.noreply.github.com>`.
- Detach Listen Together UI/navigation first; audit remaining callers before removing protocol/module code.

## Work State
### Completed
- Verified upstream baseline build; documented architecture and gaps; committed `12fff80d docs(audit): document upstream architecture and AURA gaps`.
- Implemented AURA identity and monochrome branding; build passed and committed `2eac54c8 chore(branding): rebrand app as AURA Music`.
- Disabled automatic updater checks and new-release worker scheduling; committed `0fbd7791 chore(offline): disable automatic update checks`.
- Detached Listen Together from navigation, Settings, Appearance, top-bar logic, and routes; committed `a940b056 chore(offline): detach Listen Together UI`.

### Active
- Remove remaining Listen Together player/menu/deep-link coupling and update Stage 3 implementation-log details; six files have uncommitted changes.
- Audit startup, manifest components/permissions, app-owned Ktor consumers, and online module callers before removing modules/dependencies or documenting retained items.
- Implement and test local-media scanning/playback, folders, playlists/M3U, lyrics, and navigation.
- Finish documenting feature removals and remaining gaps.

### Blocked
- `Player.kt` still references removed `isListenTogetherGuest` and `isMuted` state; no build has been run since those edits.
- Guest-state coupling remains across menus, player/queue components, lyrics, and artist screens; audit callers before removing Listen Together modules.

## Next Move
1. Resolve remaining guest-state references in `Player.kt`; remove dead Listen Together checks from `ArtistMenu.kt` and audit other callers.
2. Remove invite-link filters and the action receiver only after confirming remaining use.
3. Update `docs/AURA_IMPLEMENTATION_LOG.md`, run `assembleDebug` and `git diff --check`, then commit the stage.
4. Continue auditing startup, manifest, routes, network consumers, and module callers before local catalog/scanning work.

## Relevant Files
- `/tmp/opencode/aura-upstream/app/src/main/kotlin/com/music/vivi/ui/player/Player.kt`: remaining guest-state references and unresolved identifiers.
- `/tmp/opencode/aura-upstream/app/src/main/kotlin/com/music/vivi/ui/menu/ArtistMenu.kt`: retains Listen Together guest checks.
- `/tmp/opencode/aura-upstream/app/src/main/kotlin/com/music/vivi/MainActivity.kt`: manager composition provider was removed, but `LocalListenTogetherManager` declaration remains.
- `/tmp/opencode/aura-upstream/app/src/main/kotlin/com/music/vivi/playback/PlayerConnection.kt`: guest-blocking checks were removed; Listen Together-related fields and mute methods remain.
- `/tmp/opencode/aura-upstream/app/src/main/kotlin/com/music/vivi/playback/MusicService.kt`: Listen Together service coupling was partly removed.
- `/tmp/opencode/aura-upstream/app/src/main/AndroidManifest.xml`: still has Listen Together invite-link filters and action receiver.
- `/tmp/opencode/aura-upstream/docs/AURA_IMPLEMENTATION_LOG.md`: Stage 3 details and commit line are pending.
- `/tmp/opencode/aura-upstream/docs/AURA_UPSTREAM_AUDIT.md`: architecture, gaps, and removal/retention policy.

## Important Context
- Commits through `a940b056` are present; six files remain modified: `MainActivity.kt`, `MusicService.kt`, `PlayerConnection.kt`, `OldPlayerMenu.kt`, `PlayerMenu.kt`, and `Player.kt`.
- `assembleDebug` and `git diff --check` passed before the latest `Player.kt` edits; not rerun afterward.
- Online modules include `:innertube`, `:jiosaavn`, `:spotify`, `:lastfm`, `:kizzy`, `:shazamkit`, `:artistvideo`, `:Motionartwork`, and `:lyricsProvider`.
- App-owned Ktor consumers include remote stream extraction, online lyrics, GitHub operations, Wikipedia, and Apple Music album descriptions; assess individually.
- Preserve MusicService persistence and local auto-backup; distinguish OTA/update work from local backup.
- Upstream has Room catalog, persisted queue/player state, Media3 playback, M3U utilities, and lyrics storage, but lacks a complete device-local audio scanner/file playback path; M3U import does not resolve entries to local files.
- `INTERNET` and `ACCESS_NETWORK_STATE` are declared; Last.fm API credentials are embedded in `app/build.gradle.kts`. A targeted audit found no Firebase Analytics/Crashlytics, Sentry, Amplitude, or PostHog SDK references.

messages.summary:
## Objective
- Build AURA Music as a GPL-3.0 local-only derivative of `vivizzz007/vivi-music`, preserving upstream history and remote.
- Audit, implement, verify, and document offline features, removals, attribution, remaining gaps, and build/test results.

## Requirements
- Document upstream architecture and requirement-by-requirement gaps.
- Rebrand as AURA Music with monochrome styling while retaining upstream copyright notices and GPL-3.0 attribution.
- Remove or exclude streaming/scraping, presence, online Canvas artwork, telemetry/crash reporting, and OTA features; document removals.
- Support local files, scanning, folders, M3U import/export, local lyrics, persistent queue/position, and Home/Search/Library/Settings navigation.
- Retain relevant tests, add tests for new code, build and commit each stage.

## Decisions
- Work in `/tmp/opencode/aura-upstream`, retaining upstream history and remote `https://github.com/vivizzz007/vivi-music.git`.
- Use local Git author identity `AURA Agent <aura-agent@users.noreply.github.com>`.
- Detach Listen Together UI/navigation first; audit remaining callers before removing protocol/module code.

## Work State
### Completed
- Verified upstream baseline build; documented architecture and gaps; committed `12fff80d docs(audit): document upstream architecture and AURA gaps`.
- Implemented AURA identity and monochrome branding; build passed and committed `2eac54c8 chore(branding): rebrand app as AURA Music`.
- Disabled automatic updater checks and new-release worker scheduling; committed `0fbd7791 chore(offline): disable automatic update checks`.
- Detached Listen Together from navigation, Settings, Appearance, top-bar logic, and routes; committed `a940b056 chore(offline): detach Listen Together UI`.

### Active
- Finish removing Listen Together guest-state/player coupling and update Stage 3 implementation-log details; six files have uncommitted changes.
- Audit startup, manifest components/permissions, app-owned Ktor consumers, and online module callers before removing modules/dependencies or documenting retained items.
- Implement and test local-media scanning/playback, folders, playlists/M3U, lyrics, and navigation.
- Finish documenting feature removals and remaining gaps.

### Blocked
- `Player.kt` still references removed `isListenTogetherGuest` and `isMuted` state; build has not been run since those edits.
- Guest-state coupling remains across player, queue, thumbnail, mini-player, artist, lyrics, and menu UI; audit and remove those callers before removing Listen Together modules.

## Next Move
1. Resolve remaining guest-state references in `Player.kt`; remove dead Listen Together checks from `ArtistMenu.kt` and audit other UI callers.
2. Remove invite-link filters and the action receiver only after confirming remaining use.
3. Update `docs/AURA_IMPLEMENTATION_LOG.md`, run `assembleDebug` and `git diff --check`, then commit the stage.
4. Continue auditing startup, manifest, routes, network consumers, and module callers before local catalog/scanning work.

## Relevant Files
- `/tmp/opencode/aura-upstream/app/src/main/kotlin/com/music/vivi/ui/player/Player.kt`: unresolved guest-state references.
- `/tmp/opencode/aura-upstream/app/src/main/kotlin/com/music/vivi/ui/player/Queue.kt`: guest-only queue restrictions and manager coupling.
- `/tmp/opencode/aura-upstream/app/src/main/kotlin/com/music/vivi/ui/player/Player_v2.kt`: guest-specific controls and manager coupling.
- `/tmp/opencode/aura-upstream/app/src/main/kotlin/com/music/vivi/ui/player/MiniPlayer.kt`: manager, guest, and mute behavior.
- `/tmp/opencode/aura-upstream/app/src/main/kotlin/com/music/vivi/ui/menu/ArtistMenu.kt`: guest checks still gate artist actions.
- `/tmp/opencode/aura-upstream/app/src/main/kotlin/com/music/vivi/MainActivity.kt`: `LocalListenTogetherManager` declaration remains.
- `/tmp/opencode/aura-upstream/app/src/main/AndroidManifest.xml`: invite-link filters and action receiver remain.
- `/tmp/opencode/aura-upstream/app/src/main/kotlin/com/music/vivi/playback/PlayerConnection.kt`: residual Listen Together comment/state and mute API.
- `/tmp/opencode/aura-upstream/app/src/main/kotlin/com/music/vivi/playback/MusicService.kt`: Listen Together-related mute state remains.
- `/tmp/opencode/aura-upstream/docs/AURA_IMPLEMENTATION_LOG.md`: Stage 3 details and commit line pending.
- `/tmp/opencode/aura-upstream/docs/AURA_UPSTREAM_AUDIT.md`: architecture, gaps, and removal/retention policy.

## Important Context
- Commits through `a940b056` are present; six files remain modified: `MainActivity.kt`, `MusicService.kt`, `PlayerConnection.kt`, `OldPlayerMenu.kt`, `PlayerMenu.kt`, and `Player.kt`.
- `assembleDebug` and `git diff --check` passed before the latest `Player.kt` edits; not rerun afterward.
- Online modules include `:innertube`, `:jiosaavn`, `:spotify`, `:lastfm`, `:kizzy`, `:shazamkit`, `:artistvideo`, `:Motionartwork`, and `:lyricsProvider`.
- App-owned Ktor consumers include remote stream extraction, online lyrics, GitHub operations, Wikipedia, and Apple Music album descriptions; assess individually.
- Preserve MusicService persistence and local auto-backup; distinguish OTA/update work from local backup.
- Upstream has Room catalog, persisted queue/player state, Media3 playback, M3U utilities, and lyrics storage, but lacks a complete device-local audio scanner/file playback path; M3U import does not resolve entries to local files.
- `INTERNET` and `ACCESS_NETWORK_STATE` are declared; Last.fm API credentials are embedded in `app/build.gradle.kts`. A targeted audit found no Firebase Analytics/Crashlytics, Sentry, Amplitude, or PostHog SDK references.
- `rg` is unavailable (`/bin/bash: rg: command not found`).
