## Objective
- Build AURA Music as a GPL-3.0 local-only derivative of `vivizzz007/vivi-music`, preserving upstream history and remote.
- Audit, implement, verify, and document offline features, removals, attribution, remaining gaps, and build/test results.

## Requirements
- Document upstream architecture and requirement-by-requirement gaps.
- Rebrand as AURA Music with monochrome styling while retaining upstream copyright notices and GPL-3.0 attribution.
- Remove or exclude streaming/scraping, presence, online Canvas artwork, telemetry/crash reporting, and OTA features; document removals.
- Support local files, scanning, folders, M3U import/export, local lyrics, persistent queue/position, and Home/Search/Library/Settings navigation.
- Retain relevant tests, add tests for new code, build and commit each stage.

## Decisions
- Work in `/tmp/opencode/aura-upstream`, retaining upstream history and remote `https://github.com/vivizzz007/vivi-music.git`.
- Use local Git author identity `AURA Agent <aura-agent@users.noreply.github.com>`.
- Detach Listen Together UI/navigation first; audit remaining callers before removing protocol/module code.

## Work State
### Completed
- Verified upstream baseline build; documented architecture and gaps; committed `12fff80d docs(audit): document upstream architecture and AURA gaps`.
- Implemented AURA identity and monochrome branding; build passed and committed `2eac54c8 chore(branding): rebrand app as AURA Music`.
- Disabled automatic updater checks and new-release worker scheduling; committed `0fbd7791 chore(offline): disable automatic update checks`.
- Detached Listen Together from navigation, Settings, Appearance, top-bar logic, and routes; committed `a940b056 chore(offline): detach Listen Together UI`.

### Active
- Remove residual Listen Together guest-state/player coupling; six modified files remain uncommitted: `MainActivity.kt`, `MusicService.kt`, `PlayerConnection.kt`, `OldPlayerMenu.kt`, `PlayerMenu.kt`, and `Player.kt`.
- Audit startup, manifest components/permissions, app-owned Ktor consumers, and online module callers before removing modules/dependencies or documenting retained items.
- Implement and test local-media scanning/playback, folders, playlists/M3U, lyrics, and navigation.
- Finish documenting feature removals and remaining gaps.

### Blocked
- `Player.kt` still references `isListenTogetherGuest` and `isMuted`; build has not been run after the latest edits.
- Guest-state coupling remains in player/queue and other UI callers; audit and remove those callers before removing Listen Together modules.

## Next Move
1. Resolve remaining `Player.kt` guest/mute references; remove dead guest gating in `ArtistMenu.kt` and audit other UI callers, including `Queue.kt`, menus, artist screens, and lyrics.
2. Remove invite-link filters and the action receiver only after confirming remaining use.
3. Update `docs/AURA_IMPLEMENTATION_LOG.md`, run `assembleDebug` and `git diff --check`, then commit the stage.
4. Continue auditing startup, manifest, routes, network consumers, and module callers before local catalog/scanning work.

## Relevant Files
- `/tmp/opencode/aura-upstream/app/src/main/kotlin/com/music/vivi/ui/player/Player.kt`: unresolved guest/mute references.
- `/tmp/opencode/aura-upstream/app/src/main/kotlin/com/music/vivi/ui/player/Queue.kt`: guest-only queue restrictions and manager coupling.
- `/tmp/opencode/aura-upstream/app/src/main/kotlin/com/music/vivi/ui/player/Player_v2.kt`: guest-specific controls and manager coupling.
- `/tmp/opencode/aura-upstream/app/src/main/kotlin/com/music/vivi/ui/player/MiniPlayer.kt`: manager, guest, and mute behavior.
- `/tmp/opencode/aura-upstream/app/src/main/kotlin/com/music/vivi/ui/menu/ArtistMenu.kt`: guest checks still gate artist actions.
- `/tmp/opencode/aura-upstream/app/src/main/kotlin/com/music/vivi/ui/menu/PlayerMenu.kt`: residual Listen Together imports/coupling.
- `/tmp/opencode/aura-upstream/app/src/main/kotlin/com/music/vivi/MainActivity.kt`: `LocalListenTogetherManager` declaration remains.
- `/tmp/opencode/aura-upstream/app/src/main/AndroidManifest.xml`: invite-link filters and action receiver remain.
- `/tmp/opencode/aura-upstream/app/src/main/kotlin/com/music/vivi/playback/PlayerConnection.kt`: residual Listen Together comment/state and mute API.
- `/tmp/opencode/aura-upstream/app/src/main/kotlin/com/music/vivi/playback/MusicService.kt`: Listen Together-related mute state remains.
- `/tmp/opencode/aura-upstream/docs/AURA_IMPLEMENTATION_LOG.md`: Stage 3 details and commit line pending.
- `/tmp/opencode/aura-upstream/docs/AURA_UPSTREAM_AUDIT.md`: architecture, gaps, and removal/retention policy.

## Important Context
- Commits through `a940b056` are present; the six listed files are modified and uncommitted.
- `assembleDebug` and `git diff --check` passed before the latest `Player.kt` edits; not rerun afterward.
- Online modules include `:innertube`, `:jiosaavn`, `:spotify`, `:lastfm`, `:kizzy`, `:shazamkit`, `:artistvideo`, `:Motionartwork`, and `:lyricsProvider`.
- App-owned Ktor consumers include remote stream extraction, online lyrics, GitHub operations, Wikipedia, and Apple Music album descriptions; assess individually.
- Preserve MusicService persistence and local auto-backup; distinguish OTA/update work from local backup.
- Upstream has Room catalog, persisted queue/player state, Media3 playback, M3U utilities, and lyrics storage, but lacks a complete device-local audio scanner/file playback path; M3U import does not resolve entries to local files.
- `INTERNET` and `ACCESS_NETWORK_STATE` are declared; Last.fm API credentials are embedded in `app/build.gradle.kts`. A targeted audit found no Firebase Analytics/Crashlytics, Sentry, Amplitude, or PostHog SDK references.
- `rg` is unavailable (`/bin/bash: rg: command not found`).

messages.summary:
## Objective
- Build AURA Music as a GPL-3.0 local-only derivative of `vivizzz007/vivi-music`, preserving upstream history and remote.
- Audit, implement, verify, and document offline features, removals, attribution, remaining gaps, and build/test results.

## Requirements
- Document upstream architecture and requirement-by-requirement gaps.
- Rebrand as AURA Music with monochrome styling while retaining upstream copyright notices and GPL-3.0 attribution.
- Remove or exclude streaming/scraping, presence, online Canvas artwork, telemetry/crash reporting, and OTA features; document removals.
- Support local files, scanning, folders, M3U import/export, local lyrics, persistent queue/position, and Home/Search/Library/Settings navigation.
- Retain relevant tests, add tests for new code, build and commit each stage.

## Decisions
- Work in `/tmp/opencode/aura-upstream`, retaining upstream history and remote `https://github.com/vivizzz007/vivi-music.git`.
- Use local Git author identity `AURA Agent <aura-agent@users.noreply.github.com>`.
- Detach Listen Together UI/navigation first; audit remaining callers before removing protocol/module code.
- Preserve MusicService persistence and local auto-backup; distinguish OTA/update work from local backup.

## Work State
### Completed
- Verified upstream baseline build; documented architecture and gaps; committed `12fff80d docs(audit): document upstream architecture and AURA gaps`.
- Implemented AURA identity and monochrome branding; build passed and committed `2eac54c8 chore(branding): rebrand app as AURA Music`.
- Disabled automatic updater checks and new-release worker scheduling; committed `0fbd7791 chore(offline): disable automatic update checks`.
- Detached Listen Together from navigation, Settings, Appearance, top-bar logic, and routes; committed `a940b056 chore(offline): detach Listen Together UI`.
- Removed additional player guest restrictions and Listen Together mute behavior; `bash gradlew :app:assembleDebug` succeeded after these edits.

### Active
- Audit and remove residual Listen Together guest-state/player coupling; six files remain modified and uncommitted: `MainActivity.kt`, `MusicService.kt`, `PlayerConnection.kt`, `OldPlayerMenu.kt`, `PlayerMenu.kt`, and `Player.kt`.
- Audit startup, manifest components/permissions, app-owned Ktor consumers, and online module callers before removing modules/dependencies or documenting retained items.
- Implement and test local-media scanning/playback, folders, playlists/M3U, lyrics, and navigation.
- Finish documenting feature removals and remaining gaps.

### Blocked
- (none)

## Next Move
1. Audit remaining Listen Together callers, including `Queue.kt`, `Player_v2.kt`, `MiniPlayer.kt`, `ArtistMenu.kt`, and lyrics/artist screens; remove dead guest gating and coupling.
2. Remove invite-link filters and the action receiver only after confirming remaining use.

1: # AURA Music: upstream architecture and gap audit
2: 
3: Audit basis: upstream `vivizzz007/vivi-music` at `b10bf919` (`ci: remove nightly telegram workflow`), reviewed 2026-11-03. The repository is GPL-3.0. This document distinguishes the code that exists at that revision from the requested AURA Music local-only product scope.
4: 
5: ## Build and project configuration
6: 
7: - Root Gradle project name: `vivimusic`; Android application module: `:app`.
8: - The app uses Kotlin, Jetpack Compose, Hilt, Room/KSP, DataStore, Media3, and Protocol Buffers.
9: - Android namespace: `com.music.vivi`; application ID: `com.vivi.vivimusic`.
10: - `minSdk = 26`, `compileSdk = 37`, `targetSdk = 37`; Java and Kotlin JVM target 21.
11: - Build flavors include `foss`/`gms` and universal/ABI variants. The `foss` flavor disables Cast availability; the GMS flavor enables it.
12: - `app/build.gradle.kts` contains embedded Last.fm API key and secret values. These are upstream credentials and must not be copied into an offline AURA build.
13: - The upstream baseline was verified with `bash ./gradlew assembleDebug --no-configuration-cache --console=plain` (757 actionable tasks; 120 executed, 637 up-to-date). The wrapper file is not executable in this checkout, hence the explicit `bash` invocation.
14:

16:

18: | --- | --- | --- |
19: | `:app` | Android UI, app lifecycle, dependency injection, Room, Media3 service, widgets and integrations | Retain and rework for AURA local playback |
20: | `:innertube` | YouTube Music/Innertube networking and extraction | Remove from AURA runtime/build |

31: 
32: ## Architecture findings
33: 
34: ### Dependency injection
35: 
36: The app is Hilt-based. `app/src/main/kotlin/com/music/vivi/di/AppModule.kt` supplies application-level dependencies, including cache-related objects. Feature and persistence services are injected into ViewModels and the playback service. AURA should keep Hilt and bind local catalog/scanner and local-file access abstractions rather than online providers.
37: 
38: ### Database and persistence
39: 
40: `app/src/main/kotlin/com/music/vivi/db/MusicDatabase.kt` and `DatabaseDao.kt` define the Room database and queries. Upstream already has catalog-oriented song/album/artist/playlist data and database migrations. Playback queue/player state is persisted through the existing preference/state layer. The upstream database is designed primarily around remote catalog IDs and metadata; local URI, stable file identity, folder membership, and scan state are not established as a complete local-library model. Prefer additive schema changes with migrations, not destructive recreation.
41: 
42: M3U import/export exists in `BackupRestoreViewModel.kt` and `utils/PlaylistExporter.kt`, but it is oriented around playlist/catalog metadata and does not provide complete robust resolution of local filesystem entries into playable tracks. AURA needs path/URI-aware import/export and missing-file handling.
43: 
44: ### Playback
45: 
46: `playback/MusicService.kt` uses Media3 and persists playback state; `MediaLibrarySessionCallback.kt` exposes a media library/session. Existing media item construction (`extensions/MediaItemExt.kt`) assumes upstream media identities and can participate in remote stream resolution. AURA must ensure that queue items use local content URIs and that the service resolves only locally authorized media, with notification/background playback and restart restoration retained.
47: 
48: No local-device media scanner or end-to-end local-file playback path was found in the audited app source. Local permission handling, MediaStore indexing, folder browsing and selection, and `.lrc` sidecar discovery are gaps.
49: 
50: ### UI, navigation, and theme
51: 
52: The interface is a large Jetpack Compose application with player, library, search, settings, playlist, online integration, and updater routes. `ui/screens/NavigationBuilder.kt` includes online integrations. The theme is defined in `ui/theme/Theme.kt`, including Material You/dynamic color behavior. AURA requires its own monochrome palette/assets and a pared-down primary navigation for Home, Search, Library and Settings. Search should only search the indexed local catalog.
53: 
54: Canvas is overloaded in upstream source to refer both to the online animated artwork feature and to Compose drawing primitives. Removing animated online Canvas artwork must not remove Compose `Canvas` uses for sliders, lyric rendering, or other local UI drawing.
55: 
56: ## Requirement-by-requirement gap analysis
57: 
58: | Requirement | Status at upstream revision | Evidence / work required |
59: | --- | --- | --- |
60: | GPL-3.0 derivative with upstream history and remote preserved | Exists as foundation | Repository has upstream history and `origin`; retain LICENSE and relevant copyright notices, document AURA modifications and attribution. |
61: | AURA Music name, monochrome identity and assets | Missing | Project/app branding remains Vivi Music; update app labels, icons, splash/metadata, theme and documentation without removing upstream notices. |
62: | Local-only operation; no network audio/metadata acquisition | Missing | Innertube, JioSaavn, Spotify and lyrics provider integrations are included. Remove dependencies/routes and ensure local player has no network fallback. |
63: | Local device audio scanning/indexing | Missing | No complete MediaStore scanner was found. Implement permission-aware scan, refresh and catalog persistence. |
64: | Folder browsing | Missing | Build a local folder view backed by indexed local URIs/paths. |
65: | Local file playback | Missing | Existing Media3 session/player is reusable, but local content URI construction/resolution is not a full app path. |
66: | M3U import/export for local tracks | Partial | Import/export utilities exist, but local paths, URI permissions, unavailable items and local queue mapping need implementation and tests. |
67: | Local `.lrc` lyrics | Missing | Existing lyrics are provider/online oriented; implement same-directory sidecar lookup and timed/plain text parsing. |
68: | Persistent queue and playback position | Partial / present | Existing database/preferences and service persist player state. Verify restart restoration specifically for local content URIs and update/add regression tests. |
69: | Home, Search, Library, Settings navigation | Partial | Equivalent navigation and settings exist among larger online-oriented surfaces; simplify and rewire search/library to local data only. |
70: | Remove Discord presence | Present upstream; remove | `:kizzy` and associated preferences/service/UI must not be included. |
71: | Remove animated Canvas/artwork online features | Present upstream; remove | `:Motionartwork`, Spotify Canvas, artwork fetching and related settings/routes; retain ordinary Compose drawing Canvas. |
72: | Remove analytics and crash telemetry | No targeted analytics/crash SDK found in inspected app source | No Firebase Analytics/Crashlytics, Sentry, Amplitude or PostHog symbols were found by the initial targeted search. Recheck all dependencies, manifest providers and build plugins before claiming removal. |
73: | Remove OTA/updater | Present upstream; remove | Updater workers, download/install flows, release checks, update routes/notifications and update-specific permissions should be removed. |
74: | Remove hard-coded online credentials | Present upstream; remove | Last.fm values in `app/build.gradle.kts` must be deleted along with the provider integration. |
75: | Tests for local behavior and retained behavior | Missing for new functionality | Keep applicable upstream tests; add scanner, M3U, lyrics, URI playback/persistence tests and run available test/build tasks per stage. |
76: 
77: ## Removal and retention policy
78: 
79: Remove networking and online service integrations, not useful local Android infrastructure. Retain the Media3 playback service/session, Room and migrations, queue state, local playlist management, notification/background playback, widgets only if they work wholly from local data, and Compose drawing primitives. Explicitly document removed features and do not leave reachable UI routes or hidden background work for the removed services.
80: 
81: ## Staged implementation and verification
82: 
83: Changes are intended to be split into small buildable commits: (1) audit/branding and app identity; (2) offline scope and online feature detachment; (3) local catalog/scanning and folder UI; (4) local playback and persistent queue; (5) local playlists and lyrics; (6) final navigation/theme/docs and full requirement review. Each stage should run its narrow tests and compile check before committing. The baseline build is not evidence that the AURA modifications compile.

## Objective
- Build AURA Music as a GPL-3.0 local-only derivative of `vivizzz007/vivi-music`, preserving upstream history and remote.
- Audit, implement, verify, and document offline features, removals, attribution, remaining gaps, and build/test results.

## Requirements
- Document upstream architecture and requirement-by-requirement gaps.
- Rebrand as AURA Music with monochrome styling while retaining upstream copyright notices and GPL-3.0 attribution.
- Remove or exclude streaming/scraping, presence, online Canvas artwork, telemetry/crash reporting, and OTA features; document removals.
- Support local files, scanning, folders, M3U import/export, local lyrics, persistent queue/position, and Home/Search/Library/Settings navigation.
- Retain relevant tests, add tests for new code, build and commit each stage.

## Decisions
- Work in `/tmp/opencode/aura-upstream`, retaining upstream history and remote `https://github.com/vivizzz007/vivi-music.git`.
- Use local Git author identity `AURA Agent <aura-agent@users.noreply.github.com>`.
- Detach Listen Together UI/navigation first; audit remaining callers before removing protocol/module code.
- Preserve MusicService persistence and local auto-backup; distinguish OTA/update work from local backup.

## Work State
### Completed
- Verified upstream baseline build; documented architecture and gaps; committed `12fff80d docs(audit): document upstream architecture and AURA gaps`.
- Implemented AURA identity and monochrome branding; build passed and committed `2eac54c8 chore(branding): rebrand app as AURA Music`.
- Disabled automatic updater checks and new-release worker scheduling; committed `0fbd7791 chore(offline): disable automatic update checks`.
- Detached Listen Together from navigation, Settings, Appearance, top-bar logic, and routes; committed `a940b056 chore(offline): detach Listen Together UI`.
- Latest `bash gradlew :app:assembleDebug` succeeded after uncommitted Listen Together cleanup edits.

### Active
- Audit and remove residual Listen Together guest-state/player coupling; six files are modified and uncommitted: `MainActivity.kt`, `MusicService.kt`, `PlayerConnection.kt`, `OldPlayerMenu.kt`, `PlayerMenu.kt`, and `Player.kt`.
- Audit startup, manifest components/permissions, app-owned Ktor consumers, and online module callers before removing modules/dependencies or documenting retained items.
- Implement and test local-media scanning/playback, folders, playlists/M3U, lyrics, and navigation.
- Finish documenting feature removals and remaining gaps.

### Blocked
- (none)

## Next Move
1. Continue auditing/removing Listen Together coupling throughout player, queue, menu, artist, and lyrics UI; many callers remain beyond the initially identified files.
2. Remove invite-link filters and the action receiver after confirming remaining use; assess whether protocol/module code can then be removed safely.
3. Update `docs/AURA_IMPLEMENTATION_LOG.md`, run `bash gradlew :app:assembleDebug` and `git diff --check`, then commit the stage.
4. Continue auditing startup, manifest, routes, network consumers, and module callers before local catalog/scanning work.

## Relevant Files
- `/tmp/opencode/aura-upstream/docs/AURA_IMPLEMENTATION_LOG.md`: stage progress; Stage 3 commit line still pending.
- `/tmp/opencode/aura-upstream/docs/AURA_UPSTREAM_AUDIT.md`: architecture, gaps, and removal/retention policy.
- `/tmp/opencode/aura-upstream/app/src/main/AndroidManifest.xml`: Listen Together invite-link filters and action receiver remain.
- `/tmp/opencode/aura-upstream/app/src/main/kotlin/com/music/vivi/MainActivity.kt`: manager initialization/coupling mostly removed; `LocalListenTogetherManager` declaration remains.
- `/tmp/opencode/aura-upstream/app/src/main/kotlin/com/music/vivi/playback/PlayerConnection.kt`: guest-block fields and mute API remain; manager still references some fields.
- `/tmp/opencode/aura-upstream/app/src/main/kotlin/com/music/vivi/playback/MusicService.kt`: mute state remains; Listen Together crossfade coupling was removed.
- `/tmp/opencode/aura-upstream/app/src/main/kotlin/com/music/vivi/ui/player/Queue.kt`: many guest-only restrictions remain.
- `/tmp/opencode/aura-upstream/app/src/main/kotlin/com/music/vivi/ui/player/Queue_v2.kt`: guest queue lock/coupling remains.
- `/tmp/opencode/aura-upstream/app/src/main/kotlin/com/music/vivi/ui/player/Player_v2.kt`: guest-gated controls remain.
- `/tmp/opencode/aura-upstream/app/src/main/kotlin/com/music/vivi/ui/player/MiniPlayer.kt`: manager, guest, and mute behavior remain.
- `/tmp/opencode/aura-upstream/app/src/main/kotlin/com/music/vivi/ui/player/Thumbnail.kt`: manager status, guest swipe restrictions, and role overlay remain.
- `/tmp/opencode/aura-upstream/app/src/main/kotlin/com/music/vivi/ui/menu/ArtistMenu.kt`: guest checks still gate artist actions.
- `/tmp/opencode/aura-upstream/app/src/main/kotlin/com/music/vivi/listentogether/ListenTogetherManager.kt`: protocol manager still refers to player blocking/mute APIs.

## Important Context
- Commits through `a940b056` are present; the six listed files have further uncommitted Listen Together cleanup.
- `bash gradlew :app:assembleDebug` passed after latest edits; direct `./gradlew` invocation fails with `/bin/bash: ./gradlew: Permission denied`.
- Listen Together residual references also exist in `PlayerV2Landscape.kt`, `AppleMiniPlayer.kt`, `ArtistScreen.kt`, `Lyrics.kt`, `Lyrics_v2.kt`, multiple menu files, and `ListenTogetherManager.kt`.
- `INTERNET` and `ACCESS_NETWORK_STATE` are declared; invite-link filters are in `app/src/main/AndroidManifest.xml`, and the receiver is `.listentogether.ListenTogetherActionReceiver`.
- Online modules include `:innertube`, `:jiosaavn`, `:spotify`, `:lastfm`, `:kizzy`, `:shazamkit`, `:artistvideo`, `:Motionartwork`, and `:lyricsProvider`.
- App-owned Ktor consumers include remote stream extraction, online lyrics, GitHub operations, Wikipedia, and Apple Music album descriptions; assess individually.
- Upstream has Room catalog, persisted queue/player state, Media3 playback, M3U utilities, and lyrics storage, but lacks a complete device-local audio scanner/file playback path; M3U import does not resolve entries to local files.
- Last.fm API credentials are embedded in `app/build.gradle.kts`; a targeted audit found no Firebase Analytics/Crashlytics, Sentry, Amplitude, or PostHog SDK references.
- `rg` is unavailable (`/bin/bash: rg: command not found`).

## Objective
- Build AURA Music as a GPL-3.0 local-only derivative of `vivizzz007/vivi-music`, preserving upstream history and remote.
- Audit, implement, verify, and document offline features, removals, attribution, remaining gaps, and build/test results.

## Requirements
- Document upstream architecture and requirement-by-requirement gaps.
- Rebrand as AURA Music with monochrome styling while retaining upstream copyright notices and GPL-3.0 attribution.
- Remove or exclude streaming/scraping, presence, online Canvas artwork, telemetry/crash reporting, and OTA features; document removals.
- Support local files, scanning, folders, M3U import/export, local lyrics, persistent queue/position, and Home/Search/Library/Settings navigation.
- Retain relevant tests, add tests for new code, build, and commit each stage.

## Decisions
- Work in `/tmp/opencode/aura-upstream`, retaining upstream history and remote `https://github.com/vivizzz007/vivi-music.git`.
- Use local Git author identity `AURA Agent <aura-agent@users.noreply.github.com>`.
- Detach Listen Together UI/navigation first; audit remaining callers before removing protocol/module code.
- Preserve MusicService persistence and local auto-backup; distinguish OTA/update work from local backup.

## Work State
### Completed
- Verified upstream baseline build; documented architecture and gaps; committed `12fff80d docs(audit): document upstream architecture and AURA gaps`.
- Implemented AURA identity and monochrome branding; build passed and committed `2eac54c8 chore(branding): rebrand app as AURA Music`.
- Disabled automatic updater checks and new-release worker scheduling; committed `0fbd7791 chore(offline): disable automatic update checks`.
- Detached Listen Together from navigation, Settings, Appearance, top-bar logic, and routes; committed `a940b056 chore(offline): detach Listen Together UI`.
- Latest `bash gradlew :app:assembleDebug` succeeded after uncommitted Listen Together cleanup edits.

### Active
- Continue auditing/removing Listen Together guest-state/player coupling; six files are modified and uncommitted.
- Remove invite-link filters and action receiver after confirming use; assess whether protocol/module code can then be removed safely.
- Audit startup, manifest components/permissions, app-owned Ktor consumers, and online module callers before removing modules/dependencies or documenting retained items.
- Implement and test local-media scanning/playback, folders, playlists/M3U, lyrics, and navigation.
- Finish documenting feature removals and remaining gaps.

### Blocked
- (none)

## Next Move
1. Continue auditing/removing Listen Together coupling throughout player, queue, menu, artist, and lyrics UI; callers remain across many files.
2. Remove invite-link filters and action receiver after auditing remaining uses, then assess removal of protocol/module code.
3. Update `docs/AURA_IMPLEMENTATION_LOG.md` with Stage 3 results, run `bash gradlew :app:assembleDebug` and `git diff --check`, then commit the stage.
4. Continue auditing startup, manifest, routes, network consumers, and module callers before local catalog/scanning work.

## Relevant Files
- `/tmp/opencode/aura-upstream/docs/AURA_IMPLEMENTATION_LOG.md`: stage progress; Stage 3 commit line is pending.
- `/tmp/opencode/aura-upstream/docs/AURA_UPSTREAM_AUDIT.md`: architecture, gaps, and removal/retention policy.

- `/tmp/opencode/aura-upstream/app/src/main/kotlin/com/music/vivi/playback/PlayerConnection.kt`: guest-block fields and mute API remain.
- `/tmp/opencode/aura-upstream/app/src/main/kotlin/com/music/vivi/playback/MusicService.kt`: Listen Together crossfade coupling was removed; mute state remains.
- `/tmp/opencode/aura-upstream/app/src/main/kotlin/com/music/vivi/ui/player/Queue.kt`: guest-only restrictions remain.
- `/tmp/opencode/aura-upstream/app/src/main/kotlin/com/music/vivi/ui/player/Queue_v2.kt`: guest queue lock/coupling remains.
- `/tmp/opencode/aura-upstream/app/src/main/kotlin/com/music/vivi/ui/player/Player_v2.kt`: guest-gated controls remain.
- `/tmp/opencode/aura-upstream/app/src/main/kotlin/com/music/vivi/ui/player/MiniPlayer.kt`: manager, guest, and mute behavior remain.
- `/tmp/opencode/aura-upstream/app/src/main/kotlin/com/music/vivi/ui/player/Thumbnail.kt`: manager status, guest swipe restrictions, and role overlay remain.
- `/tmp/opencode/aura-upstream/app/src/main/kotlin/com/music/vivi/listentogether/ListenTogetherManager.kt`: protocol manager still refers to player blocking/mute APIs.

## Important Context
- Commits through `a940b056` are present; six files have further uncommitted cleanup: `MainActivity.kt`, `MusicService.kt`, `PlayerConnection.kt`, `OldPlayerMenu.kt`, `PlayerMenu.kt`, and `Player.kt`.

messages.summary:
## Objective
- Build AURA Music as a GPL-3.0 local-only derivative of `vivizzz007/vivi-music`, preserving upstream history and remote.
- Audit, implement, verify, and document offline features, removals, attribution, remaining gaps, and build/test results.

## Requirements
- Document upstream architecture and requirement-by-requirement gaps.
- Rebrand as AURA Music with monochrome styling while retaining upstream copyright notices and GPL-3.0 attribution.
- Remove or exclude streaming/scraping, presence, online Canvas artwork, telemetry/crash reporting, and OTA features; document removals.
- Support local files, scanning, folders, M3U import/export, local lyrics, persistent queue/position, and Home/Search/Library/Settings navigation.
- Retain relevant tests, add tests for new code, build, and commit each stage.

## Decisions
- Work in `/tmp/opencode/aura-upstream`, retaining upstream history and remote `https://github.com/vivizzz007/vivi-music.git`.
- Use local Git author identity `AURA Agent <aura-agent@users.noreply.github.com>`.
- Detach Listen Together UI/navigation first; audit remaining callers before removing protocol/module code.
- Preserve MusicService persistence and local auto-backup; distinguish OTA/update work from local backup.
- Remove guest-only restrictions while retaining ordinary player/menu actions; remove dedicated Listen Together suggestion actions.

## Work State
### Completed
- Verified upstream baseline build; documented architecture and gaps; committed `12fff80d docs(audit): document upstream architecture and AURA gaps`.
- Implemented AURA identity and monochrome branding; build passed and committed `2eac54c8 chore(branding): rebrand app as AURA Music`.
- Disabled automatic updater checks and new-release worker scheduling; committed `0fbd7791 chore(offline): disable automatic update checks`.
- Detached Listen Together from navigation, Settings, Appearance, top-bar logic, and routes; commit `a940b056 chore(offline): detach Listen Together UI`.
- Latest `bash gradlew :app:assembleDebug` succeeded after uncommitted Listen Together cleanup edits.

### Active
- Remove remaining Listen Together guest restrictions and suggestion actions from player, queue, menus, lyrics, and artist UI.
- Remove unused playback callbacks/internal-sync wiring, then audit and remove invite-link filters, receiver, DI providers, and protocol/module code.
- Update `docs/AURA_IMPLEMENTATION_LOG.md` (Stage 3 still says commit pending), run build and `git diff --check`, and commit the cleanup stage.
- Audit startup, manifest components/permissions, app-owned network consumers, and online module callers.
- Implement and test local-media scanning/playback, folders, playlists/M3U, lyrics, and navigation; document removals and remaining gaps.

### Blocked
- (none)

## Next Move
1. Continue removing residual guest restrictions and Listen Together-only actions, preserving normal player/menu controls.
2. Confirm remaining callers, then remove disconnected feature wiring and components.
3. Update the implementation log, build, run `git diff --check`, and commit this cleanup stage.

## Relevant Files
- `/tmp/opencode/aura-upstream/docs/AURA_IMPLEMENTATION_LOG.md`: stage progress; Stage 3 commit entry is pending.

messages.summary:
## Objective
- Build AURA Music as a GPL-3.0 local-only derivative of `vivizzz007/vivi-music`, preserving upstream history and remote.
- Audit, implement, verify, and document offline features, removals, attribution, remaining gaps, and build/test results.

## Requirements
- Document upstream architecture and requirement-by-requirement gaps.
- Rebrand as AURA Music with monochrome styling while retaining upstream copyright notices and GPL-3.0 attribution.
- Remove or exclude streaming/scraping, presence, online Canvas artwork, telemetry/crash reporting, and OTA features; document removals.
- Support local files, scanning, folders, M3U import/export, local lyrics, persistent queue/position, and Home/Search/Library/Settings navigation.
- Retain relevant tests, add tests for new code, build, and commit each stage.

## Decisions
- Work in `/tmp/opencode/aura-upstream`, retaining upstream history and remote `https://github.com/vivizzz007/vivi-music.git`.
- Use local Git author identity `AURA Agent <aura-agent@users.noreply.github.com>`.
- Detach Listen Together UI/navigation first; audit remaining callers before removing protocol/module code.
- Preserve MusicService persistence and local auto-backup; distinguish OTA/update work from local backup.
- Remove guest-only restrictions while retaining ordinary player/menu actions; remove dedicated Listen Together suggestion actions.

## Work State
### Completed
- Verified upstream baseline build; documented architecture and gaps; committed `12fff80d docs(audit): document upstream architecture and AURA gaps`.
- Implemented AURA identity and monochrome branding; build passed and committed `2eac54c8 chore(branding): rebrand app as AURA Music`.
- Disabled automatic updater checks and new-release worker scheduling; committed `0fbd7791 chore(offline): disable automatic update checks`.
- Detached Listen Together from navigation, Settings, Appearance, top-bar logic, and routes; committed `a940b056 chore(offline): detach Listen Together UI`.
- Latest `bash gradlew :app:assembleDebug` succeeded after uncommitted Listen Together cleanup edits.

### Active
- Remove residual Listen Together guest restrictions and suggestion actions across player, queue, menus, lyrics, artist, and playlist UI; the latest search found matches across many UI files.
- Remove unused playback callbacks/internal-sync wiring, then audit and remove invite-link filters, receiver, DI providers, and protocol/module code.
- Update `docs/AURA_IMPLEMENTATION_LOG.md` (Stage 3 commit line still pending), run build and `git diff --check`, and commit the cleanup stage.
- Audit startup, manifest components/permissions, app-owned network consumers, and online module callers.
- Implement and test local-media scanning/playback, folders, playlists/M3U, lyrics, and navigation; document removals and remaining gaps.

### Blocked
- (none)

## Next Move
1. Continue removing residual guest restrictions and Listen Together-only actions, preserving normal player/menu controls.
2. Confirm remaining callers, then remove disconnected feature wiring and components.
3. Update the implementation log, build, run `git diff --check`, and commit this cleanup stage.

## Relevant Files
- `/tmp/opencode/aura-upstream/docs/AURA_IMPLEMENTATION_LOG.md`: stage progress; Stage 3 commit entry is pending.
- `/tmp/opencode/aura-upstream/docs/AURA_UPSTREAM_AUDIT.md`: architecture, gaps, and removal/retention policy.

messages.summary:
## Objective
- Build AURA Music as a GPL-3.0 local-only derivative of `vivizzz007/vivi-music`, preserving upstream history and remote.
- Audit, implement, verify, and document offline features, removals, attribution, remaining gaps, and build/test results.

## Requirements
- Document upstream architecture and requirement-by-requirement gaps.
- Rebrand as AURA Music with monochrome styling while retaining upstream copyright notices and GPL-3.0 attribution.
- Remove or exclude streaming/scraping, presence, online Canvas artwork, telemetry/crash reporting, and OTA features; document removals.
- Support local files, scanning, folders, M3U import/export, local lyrics, persistent queue/position, and Home/Search/Library/Settings navigation.
- Retain relevant tests, add tests for new code, build, and commit each stage.

## Decisions
- Work in `/tmp/opencode/aura-upstream`, retaining upstream history and remote `https://github.com/vivizzz007/vivi-music.git`.
- Use local Git author identity `AURA Agent <aura-agent@users.noreply.github.com>`.
- Detach Listen Together UI/navigation first; audit remaining callers before removing protocol/module code.
- Preserve MusicService persistence and local auto-backup; distinguish OTA/update work from local backup.
- Remove guest-only restrictions while retaining ordinary player/menu actions; remove dedicated Listen Together suggestion actions.

## Work State
### Completed
- Verified upstream baseline build; documented architecture and gaps; committed `12fff80d docs(audit): document upstream architecture and AURA gaps`.
- Implemented AURA identity and monochrome branding; build passed and committed `2eac54c8 chore(branding): rebrand app as AURA Music`.
- Disabled automatic updater checks and new-release worker scheduling; committed `0fbd7791 chore(offline): disable automatic update checks`.
- Detached Listen Together from navigation, Settings, Appearance, top-bar logic, and routes; committed `a940b056 chore(offline): detach Listen Together UI`.
- Latest `bash gradlew :app:assembleDebug` succeeded after uncommitted Listen Together cleanup edits.

### Active
- Remove residual Listen Together guest restrictions and suggestion actions across player, queue, menus, lyrics, artist, and playlist UI; a UI-reference audit is underway.
- Remove unused playback callbacks/internal-sync wiring, then audit and remove invite-link filters, receiver, DI providers, and protocol/module code.
- Update `docs/AURA_IMPLEMENTATION_LOG.md` (Stage 3 commit line still pending), run build and `git diff --check`, and commit the cleanup stage.
- Audit startup, manifest components/permissions, app-owned network consumers, and online module callers.
- Implement and test local-media scanning/playback, folders, playlists/M3U, lyrics, and navigation; document removals and remaining gaps.

### Blocked
- (none)

## Next Move
1. Continue removing residual guest restrictions and Listen Together-only actions, preserving normal player/menu controls.
2. Confirm remaining callers, then remove disconnected feature wiring and components.
3. Update the implementation log, build, run `git diff --check`, and commit this cleanup stage.

## Relevant Files
- `/tmp/opencode/aura-upstream/docs/AURA_IMPLEMENTATION_LOG.md`: stage progress; Stage 3 commit entry is pending.
- `/tmp/opencode/aura-upstream/docs/AURA_UPSTREAM_AUDIT.md`: architecture, gaps, and removal/retention policy.
- `/tmp/opencode/aura-upstream/app/src/main/AndroidManifest.xml`: Listen Together receiver remains; invite-link filters need review.
- `/tmp/opencode/aura-upstream/app/src/main/kotlin/com/music/vivi/MainActivity.kt`: manager composition-local declaration remains.
- `/tmp/opencode/aura-upstream/app/src/main/kotlin/com/music/vivi/playback/PlayerConnection.kt`: guest-block callback and internal-sync fields remain.
- `/tmp/opencode/aura-upstream/app/src/main/kotlin/com/music/vivi/playback/MusicService.kt`: inspect remaining mute coupling.
- `/tmp/opencode/aura-upstream/app/src/main/kotlin/com/music/vivi/di/AppModule.kt`: Listen Together DI providers remain.
- `/tmp/opencode/aura-upstream/app/src/main/kotlin/com/music/vivi/ui/menu/`: many menus still have guest restrictions and suggestion actions.
- `/tmp/opencode/aura-upstream/app/src/main/kotlin/com/music/vivi/ui/player/`: residual queue/player guest restrictions and manager wiring.
- `/tmp/opencode/aura-upstream/app/src/main/kotlin/com/music/vivi/ui/component/Lyrics.kt`: residual lyrics guest restrictions.
- `/tmp/opencode/aura-upstream/app/src/main/kotlin/com/music/vivi/ui/screens/artist/ArtistScreen.kt`: residual guest restrictions.
- `/tmp/opencode/aura-upstream/app/src/main/kotlin/com/music/vivi/listentogether/`: protocol manager/client and action receiver; pending caller audit.

## Important Context
- Six files have uncommitted cleanup changes: `MainActivity.kt`, `MusicService.kt`, `PlayerConnection.kt`, `OldPlayerMenu.kt`, `PlayerMenu.kt`, and `Player.kt`; latest recorded diff was 131 insertions and 1,532 deletions.
- `git log` confirms commits through `a940b056`; the implementation log’s Stage 3 commit entry remains pending.
- Direct `./gradlew` invocation fails with `/bin/bash: ./gradlew: Permission denied`; use `bash gradlew`.
- App-owned Ktor consumers include remote stream extraction, online lyrics, GitHub operations, Wikipedia, and Apple Music album descriptions.
- Online modules include `:innertube`, `:jiosaavn`, `:spotify`, `:lastfm`, `:kizzy`, `:shazamkit`, `:artistvideo`, `:Motionartwork`, and `:lyricsProvider`.
- Upstream has Room catalog, persisted queue/player state, Media3 playback, M3U utilities, and lyrics storage, but lacks a complete device-local audio scanner/file playback path; M3U import does not resolve entries to local files.
- `INTERNET` and `ACCESS_NETWORK_STATE` are declared; Last.fm API credentials are embedded in `app/build.gradle.kts`. A targeted audit found no Firebase Analytics/Crashlytics, Sentry, Amplitude, or PostHog SDK references. `rg` is unavailable (`/bin/bash: rg: command not found`).

## Objective
- Build AURA Music as a GPL-3.0 local-only derivative of `vivizzz007/vivi-music`, preserving upstream history and remote.
- Audit, implement, verify, and document offline features, removals, attribution, remaining gaps, and build/test results.

## Requirements
- Document upstream architecture and requirement-by-requirement gaps.
- Rebrand as AURA Music with monochrome styling while retaining upstream copyright notices and GPL-3.0 attribution.
- Remove or exclude streaming/scraping, presence, online Canvas artwork, telemetry/crash reporting, and OTA features; document removals.
- Support local files, scanning, folders, M3U import/export, local lyrics, persistent queue/position, and Home/Search/Library/Settings navigation.
- Retain relevant tests, add tests for new code, build, and commit each stage.

## Decisions
- Work in `/tmp/opencode/aura-upstream`, retaining upstream history and remote `https://github.com/vivizzz007/vivi-music.git`.
- Use local Git author identity `AURA Agent <aura-agent@users.noreply.github.com>`.
- Detach Listen Together UI/navigation first; audit remaining callers before removing protocol/module code.
- Preserve MusicService persistence and local auto-backup; distinguish OTA/update work from local backup.
- Remove guest-only restrictions while retaining ordinary player/menu actions; remove dedicated Listen Together suggestion actions.

## Work State
### Completed
- Verified upstream baseline build; documented architecture and gaps; committed `12fff80d docs(audit): document upstream architecture and AURA gaps`.
- Implemented AURA identity and monochrome branding; build passed and committed `2eac54c8 chore(branding): rebrand app as AURA Music`.
- Disabled automatic updater checks and new-release worker scheduling; committed `0fbd7791 chore(offline): disable automatic update checks`.
- Detached Listen Together from navigation, Settings, Appearance, top-bar logic, and routes; committed `a940b056 chore(offline): detach Listen Together UI`.
- Latest `bash gradlew :app:assembleDebug` succeeded after uncommitted Listen Together cleanup edits.

### Active
- Remove residual Listen Together guest restrictions and suggestion actions across player, queue, menus, lyrics, artist, and playlist UI; recent audits confirmed many references remain.
- Remove unused playback callbacks/internal-sync wiring, then audit and remove invite-link filters, receiver, DI providers, and protocol/module code.
- Update `docs/AURA_IMPLEMENTATION_LOG.md` (Stage 3 commit line still pending), run build and `git diff --check`, and commit the cleanup stage.
- Audit startup, manifest components/permissions, app-owned network consumers, and online module callers.
- Implement and test local-media scanning/playback, folders, playlists/M3U, lyrics, and navigation; document removals and remaining gaps.

### Blocked
- (none)

## Next Move
1. Continue removing residual guest restrictions and Listen Together-only actions, preserving normal player/menu controls.
2. Confirm remaining callers, then remove disconnected feature wiring and components.
3. Update the implementation log, build, run `git diff --check`, and commit this cleanup stage.

## Relevant Files
- `/tmp/opencode/aura-upstream/docs/AURA_IMPLEMENTATION_LOG.md`: stage progress; Stage 3 commit entry is pending.
- `/tmp/opencode/aura-upstream/docs/AURA_UPSTREAM_AUDIT.md`: architecture, gaps, and removal/retention policy.
- `/tmp/opencode/aura-upstream/app/src/main/AndroidManifest.xml`: Listen Together receiver and invite-link filters remain; review other filters before editing.
- `/tmp/opencode/aura-upstream/app/src/main/kotlin/com/music/vivi/MainActivity.kt`: uncommitted manager/composition cleanup.
- `/tmp/opencode/aura-upstream/app/src/main/kotlin/com/music/vivi/playback/PlayerConnection.kt`: uncommitted guest-block removals; callback/internal-sync fields remain.
- `/tmp/opencode/aura-upstream/app/src/main/kotlin/com/music/vivi/playback/MusicService.kt`: inspect remaining mute coupling.
- `/tmp/opencode/aura-upstream/app/src/main/kotlin/com/music/vivi/di/AppModule.kt`: Listen Together DI providers remain.
- `/tmp/opencode/aura-upstream/app/src/main/kotlin/com/music/vivi/ui/menu/`: many menus still have guest restrictions and suggestion actions.
- `/tmp/opencode/aura-upstream/app/src/main/kotlin/com/music/vivi/ui/player/`: residual queue/player guest restrictions and manager wiring.
- `/tmp/opencode/aura-upstream/app/src/main/kotlin/com/music/vivi/ui/component/Lyrics.kt`: residual lyrics guest restrictions.
- `/tmp/opencode/aura-upstream/app/src/main/kotlin/com/music/vivi/ui/screens/artist/ArtistScreen.kt`: residual guest restrictions.
- `/tmp/opencode/aura-upstream/app/src/main/kotlin/com/music/vivi/listentogether/`: protocol manager/client and action receiver; pending caller audit.

## Important Context
- Six files have uncommitted cleanup changes: `MainActivity.kt`, `MusicService.kt`, `PlayerConnection.kt`, `OldPlayerMenu.kt`, `PlayerMenu.kt`, and `Player.kt`; latest recorded diff was 131 insertions and 1,532 deletions.
- `git log` confirms commits through `a940b056`; the implementation log’s Stage 3 commit entry remains pending.
- Direct `./gradlew` invocation fails with `/bin/bash: ./gradlew: Permission denied`; use `bash gradlew`.
- App-owned Ktor consumers include remote stream extraction, online lyrics, GitHub operations, Wikipedia, and Apple Music album descriptions.
- Online modules include `:innertube`, `:jiosaavn`, `:spotify`, `:lastfm`, `:kizzy`, `:shazamkit`, `:artistvideo`, `:Motionartwork`, and `:lyricsProvider`.
- Upstream has Room catalog, persisted queue/player state, Media3 playback, M3U utilities, and lyrics storage, but lacks a complete device-local audio scanner/file playback path; M3U import does not resolve entries to local files.
- `INTERNET` and `ACCESS_NETWORK_STATE` are declared; Last.fm API credentials are embedded in `app/build.gradle.kts`. A targeted audit found no Firebase Analytics/Crashlytics, Sentry, Amplitude, or PostHog SDK references.

## Objective
- Build AURA Music as a GPL-3.0 local-only derivative of `vivizzz007/vivi-music`, preserving upstream history and remote.
- Audit, implement, verify, and document offline features, removals, attribution, remaining gaps, and build/test results.

## Requirements
- Document upstream architecture and requirement-by-requirement gaps.
- Rebrand as AURA Music with monochrome styling while retaining upstream copyright notices and GPL-3.0 attribution.
- Remove or exclude streaming/scraping, presence, online Canvas artwork, telemetry/crash reporting, and OTA features; document removals.
- Support local files, scanning, folders, M3U import/export, local lyrics, persistent queue/position, and Home/Search/Library/Settings navigation.
- Retain relevant tests, add tests for new code, build, and commit each stage.

## Decisions
- Work in `/tmp/opencode/aura-upstream`, retaining upstream history and remote `https://github.com/vivizzz007/vivi-music.git`.
- Use local Git author identity `AURA Agent <aura-agent@users.noreply.github.com>`.
- Detach Listen Together UI/navigation first; audit remaining callers before removing protocol/module code.
- Preserve MusicService persistence and local auto-backup; distinguish OTA/update work from local backup.
- Remove guest-only restrictions while retaining ordinary player/menu actions; remove dedicated Listen Together suggestion actions.

## Work State
### Completed
- Verified upstream baseline build; documented architecture and gaps; committed `12fff80d docs(audit): document upstream architecture and AURA gaps`.
- Implemented AURA identity and monochrome branding; build passed and committed `2eac54c8 chore(branding): rebrand app as AURA Music`.
- Disabled automatic updater checks and new-release worker scheduling; committed `0fbd7791 chore(offline): disable automatic update checks`.
- Detached Listen Together from navigation, Settings, Appearance, top-bar logic, and routes; committed `a940b056 chore(offline): detach Listen Together UI`.
- Latest `bash gradlew :app:assembleDebug` succeeded after uncommitted Listen Together cleanup edits.

### Active
- Remove residual guest restrictions and Listen Together-only suggestion actions across player, queue, menus, lyrics, artist, and playlist UI; a recent audit still found 185 UI references.
- Remove unused playback callbacks/internal-sync wiring, then audit and remove invite-link filters, receiver, DI providers, and protocol/module code.
- Update `docs/AURA_IMPLEMENTATION_LOG.md` (Stage 3 commit line still pending), run build and `git diff --check`, and commit the cleanup stage.
- Audit startup, manifest components/permissions, app-owned network consumers, and online module callers.
- Implement and test local-media scanning/playback, folders, playlists/M3U, lyrics, and navigation; document removals and remaining gaps.

### Blocked
- (none)

## Next Move
1. Continue removing residual guest restrictions and suggestion actions, preserving normal player/menu controls.
2. Confirm remaining callers, then remove disconnected feature wiring and components.
3. Update the implementation log, build, run `git diff --check`, and commit this cleanup stage.

## Relevant Files
- `/tmp/opencode/aura-upstream/docs/AURA_IMPLEMENTATION_LOG.md`: stage progress; Stage 3 commit entry is pending.
- `/tmp/opencode/aura-upstream/docs/AURA_UPSTREAM_AUDIT.md`: architecture, gaps, and removal/retention policy.
- `/tmp/opencode/aura-upstream/app/src/main/AndroidManifest.xml`: Listen Together receiver and invite-link filters remain; review other filters before editing.
- `/tmp/opencode/aura-upstream/app/src/main/kotlin/com/music/vivi/MainActivity.kt`: uncommitted manager/composition cleanup.
- `/tmp/opencode/aura-upstream/app/src/main/kotlin/com/music/vivi/playback/PlayerConnection.kt`: guest-block callback/internal-sync fields remain.
- `/tmp/opencode/aura-upstream/app/src/main/kotlin/com/music/vivi/playback/MusicService.kt`: inspect remaining mute coupling.
- `/tmp/opencode/aura-upstream/app/src/main/kotlin/com/music/vivi/di/AppModule.kt`: Listen Together DI providers remain.
- `/tmp/opencode/aura-upstream/app/src/main/kotlin/com/music/vivi/ui/menu/`: residual guest restrictions and suggestion actions.
- `/tmp/opencode/aura-upstream/app/src/main/kotlin/com/music/vivi/ui/player/`: residual queue/player restrictions and manager wiring.
- `/tmp/opencode/aura-upstream/app/src/main/kotlin/com/music/vivi/ui/component/Lyrics.kt`: residual lyrics guest restrictions.
- `/tmp/opencode/aura-upstream/app/src/main/kotlin/com/music/vivi/ui/screens/artist/ArtistScreen.kt`: residual guest restrictions.
- `/tmp/opencode/aura-upstream/app/src/main/kotlin/com/music/vivi/listentogether/`: protocol manager/client and action receiver; pending caller audit.

## Important Context
- Six files have uncommitted cleanup changes: `MainActivity.kt`, `MusicService.kt`, `PlayerConnection.kt`, `OldPlayerMenu.kt`, `PlayerMenu.kt`, and `Player.kt`.
- `git log` confirms commits through `a940b056`; the implementation log’s Stage 3 commit entry remains pending.
- `./gradlew` fails with `/bin/bash: ./gradlew: Permission denied`; invoke Gradle as `bash gradlew`.
- App-owned Ktor consumers include remote stream extraction, online lyrics, GitHub operations, Wikipedia, and Apple Music album descriptions.
- Online modules include `:innertube`, `:jiosaavn`, `:spotify`, `:lastfm`, `:kizzy`, `:shazamkit`, `:artistvideo`, `:Motionartwork`, and `:lyricsProvider`.
- Upstream has Room catalog, persisted queue/player state, Media3 playback, M3U utilities, and lyrics storage, but lacks a complete device-local audio scanner/file playback path; M3U import does not resolve entries to local files.
- `INTERNET` and `ACCESS_NETWORK_STATE` are declared; Last.fm API credentials are embedded in `app/build.gradle.kts`. A targeted audit found no Firebase Analytics/Crashlytics, Sentry, Amplitude, or PostHog SDK references.

# AURA Music implementation log

AURA Music is a local-only derivative of `vivizzz007/vivi-music`, licensed under GPL-3.0. Upstream history and the `origin` remote are retained. Upstream copyright and license notices remain in source; see `LICENSE` and `docs/AURA_UPSTREAM_AUDIT.md` for attribution and the architecture/gap record.

## Stage 1 — identity and monochrome brand

- Set the display name to **AURA Music**, the Android application ID to `com.aura.music`, and the Gradle project name to `aura-music`.
- Replaced adaptive launcher icon artwork with a monochrome A-mark and dark background.
- Set the default theme seed to black so the default generated palette is monochrome, and renamed the app Compose theme/style identifiers to AURA branding.
- Kept the upstream Kotlin namespace and package structure to avoid a risky mass package migration; that source history remains attributable to upstream.
- No online integrations or user-facing features have been removed in this stage. Their removal will be tracked in the offline-scope stage.
- Verification: `bash ./gradlew assembleDebug --no-configuration-cache --console=plain` succeeded; `git diff --check` passed. Gradle emitted existing deprecation notices and benign FOSS manifest-removal warnings.
- Commit: `2eac54c8 chore(branding): rebrand app as AURA Music`.

## Stage 2 — disable automatic update checks

- Removed automatic update checks from app launch, Settings entry, and the Update settings screen; removed startup scheduling for new-release notifications.
- Kept the updater implementation and manual update UI temporarily so later offline-scope work can remove the feature and its dependencies as a separate buildable stage.
- Verification: `bash ./gradlew assembleDebug --no-configuration-cache --console=plain` succeeded; `git diff --check` passed. Gradle emitted existing deprecation notices and benign FOSS manifest-removal warnings.
- Commit: `0fbd7791 chore(offline): disable automatic update checks`.

## Stage 3 — detach Listen Together UI entry points

- Removed Listen Together from the main navigation tabs, Settings and Appearance entries, top-bar button/title logic, and navigation routes.
- Left the feature's source files, service/protocol code, manager initialization, and deep-link/caller paths in place for a later call-site audit; this stage only removes the user-facing navigation/settings entry points.
- Verification: `bash ./gradlew assembleDebug --no-configuration-cache --console=plain` succeeded; `git diff --check` passed.
- Commit: pending.

messages.summary:
## Objective
- Build AURA Music as a GPL-3.0 local-only derivative of `vivizzz007/vivi-music`, preserving upstream history and remote.
- Audit, implement, verify, and document offline features, removals, attribution, remaining gaps, and build/test results.

## Requirements
- Document upstream architecture and requirement-by-requirement gaps.
- Rebrand as AURA Music with monochrome styling while retaining upstream copyright notices and GPL-3.0 attribution.
- Remove or exclude streaming/scraping, presence, online Canvas artwork, telemetry/crash reporting, and OTA features; document removals.
- Support local files, scanning, folders, M3U import/export, local lyrics, persistent queue/position, and Home/Search/Library/Settings navigation.
- Retain relevant tests, add tests for new code, build, and commit each stage.

## Decisions
- Work in `/tmp/opencode/aura-upstream`, retaining upstream history and remote `https://github.com/vivizzz007/vivi-music.git`.
- Use local Git author identity `AURA Agent <aura-agent@users.noreply.github.com>`.
- Detach Listen Together UI/navigation first; audit remaining callers before removing protocol/module code.
- Preserve MusicService persistence and local auto-backup; distinguish OTA/update work from local backup.
- Remove guest-only restrictions while retaining ordinary player/menu actions; remove dedicated Listen Together suggestion actions.

## Work State
### Completed
- Verified upstream baseline build; documented architecture and gaps; committed `12fff80d docs(audit): document upstream architecture and AURA gaps`.
- Implemented AURA identity and monochrome branding; build passed and committed `2eac54c8 chore(branding): rebrand app as AURA Music`.
- Disabled automatic updater checks and new-release worker scheduling; committed `0fbd7791 chore(offline): disable automatic update checks`.
- Detached Listen Together from navigation, Settings, Appearance, top-bar logic, and routes; committed `a940b056 chore(offline): detach Listen Together UI`.
- Current cleanup edits have removed many guest restrictions and Listen Together UI paths from `Player.kt`, `OldPlayerMenu.kt`, and `PlayerMenu.kt`; recent `bash gradlew :app:assembleDebug` succeeded.

### Active
- Continue removing residual guest restrictions and Listen Together-only suggestion actions across menus, queue, lyrics, artist, and player surfaces.
- Remove residual `PlayerConnection` callback/internal-sync fields; audit callers before deleting Listen Together DI providers, receiver, manifest filters, and protocol/module code.
- Update `docs/AURA_IMPLEMENTATION_LOG.md` with Stage 3 commit, run build and `git diff --check`, and commit this cleanup stage.
- Audit startup, manifest components/permissions, app-owned network consumers, and online module callers.
- Implement and test local-media scanning/playback, folders, playlists/M3U, lyrics, and navigation; document removals and remaining gaps.

### Blocked
- (none)

## Next Move
1. Continue auditing/removing guest-only restrictions and suggestion actions while preserving normal controls.
2. Remove disconnected Listen Together wiring and components only after confirming remaining callers.
3. Update the implementation log, run the build and `git diff --check`, then commit the cleanup stage.

## Relevant Files
- `/tmp/opencode/aura-upstream/docs/AURA_IMPLEMENTATION_LOG.md`: Stage 3 commit entry is pending.
- `/tmp/opencode/aura-upstream/docs/AURA_UPSTREAM_AUDIT.md`: architecture, gaps, and removal/retention policy.
- `/tmp/opencode/aura-upstream/app/src/main/AndroidManifest.xml`: Listen Together receiver and invite-link filters remain; review other filters before editing.
- `/tmp/opencode/aura-upstream/app/src/main/kotlin/com/music/vivi/MainActivity.kt`: manager composition/injection cleanup is uncommitted; composition-local declaration remains.
- `/tmp/opencode/aura-upstream/app/src/main/kotlin/com/music/vivi/playback/PlayerConnection.kt`: guest-block callback/internal-sync fields remain.
- `/tmp/opencode/aura-upstream/app/src/main/kotlin/com/music/vivi/playback/MusicService.kt`: Listen Together injection/crossfade coupling was removed in uncommitted edits; inspect for other coupling.
- `/tmp/opencode/aura-upstream/app/src/main/kotlin/com/music/vivi/di/AppModule.kt`: Listen Together DI providers remain.
- `/tmp/opencode/aura-upstream/app/src/main/kotlin/com/music/vivi/listentogether/`: protocol manager/client and action receiver; pending caller audit.
- `/tmp/opencode/aura-upstream/app/src/main/kotlin/com/music/vivi/ui/menu/`: residual guest restrictions and suggestion actions.
- `/tmp/opencode/aura-upstream/app/src/main/kotlin/com/music/vivi/ui/player/`: residual queue/player restrictions and manager wiring.
- `/tmp/opencode/aura-upstream/app/src/main/kotlin/com/music/vivi/ui/component/Lyrics.kt`: residual lyrics guest restrictions.
- `/tmp/opencode/aura-upstream/app/src/main/kotlin/com/music/vivi/ui/screens/artist/ArtistScreen.kt`: residual guest restrictions.

## Important Context
- Six files currently have uncommitted cleanup changes: `MainActivity.kt`, `MusicService.kt`, `PlayerConnection.kt`, `OldPlayerMenu.kt`, `PlayerMenu.kt`, and `Player.kt`.
- Recent search still found many Listen Together references across UI and protocol sources; `PlayerConnection.kt` retains `shouldBlockPlaybackChanges` and `allowInternalSync` fields.
- App-owned Ktor consumers include remote stream extraction, online lyrics, GitHub operations, Wikipedia, and Apple Music album descriptions.
- Online modules include `:innertube`, `:jiosaavn`, `:spotify`, `:lastfm`, `:kizzy`, `:shazamkit`, `:artistvideo`, `:Motionartwork`, and `:lyricsProvider`.
- Upstream has Room catalog, persisted queue/player state, Media3 playback, M3U utilities, and lyrics storage, but lacks a complete device-local audio scanner/file playback path; M3U import does not resolve entries to local files.
- `INTERNET` and `ACCESS_NETWORK_STATE` are declared; Last.fm API credentials are embedded in `app/build.gradle.kts`. A targeted audit found no Firebase Analytics/Crashlytics, Sentry, Amplitude, or PostHog SDK references.
- `./gradlew` fails with `/bin/bash: ./gradlew: Permission denied`; invoke Gradle as `bash gradlew`.

messages.summary:
## Objective
- Build AURA Music as a GPL-3.0 local-only derivative of `vivizzz007/vivi-music`, preserving upstream history and remote.
- Audit, implement, verify, and document offline features, removals, attribution, remaining gaps, and build/test results.

## Requirements
- Document upstream architecture and requirement-by-requirement gaps.
- Rebrand as AURA Music with monochrome styling while retaining upstream copyright notices and GPL-3.0 attribution.
- Remove or exclude streaming/scraping, presence, online Canvas artwork, telemetry/crash reporting, and OTA features; document removals.
- Support local files, scanning, folders, M3U import/export, local lyrics, persistent queue/position, and Home/Search/Library/Settings navigation.
- Retain relevant tests, add tests for new code, build, and commit each stage.

## Decisions
- Work in `/tmp/opencode/aura-upstream`, retaining upstream history and remote `https://github.com/vivizzz007/vivi-music.git`.
- Use local Git author identity `AURA Agent <aura-agent@users.noreply.github.com>`.
- Detach Listen Together UI/navigation first; audit remaining callers before removing protocol/module code.
- Preserve MusicService persistence and local auto-backup; distinguish OTA/update work from local backup.
- Remove guest-only restrictions while retaining ordinary player/menu actions; remove dedicated Listen Together suggestion actions.

## Work State
### Completed
- Verified upstream baseline build; documented architecture and gaps; committed `12fff80d docs(audit): document upstream architecture and AURA gaps`.
- Implemented AURA identity and monochrome branding; build passed and committed `2eac54c8 chore(branding): rebrand app as AURA Music`.
- Disabled automatic updater checks and new-release worker scheduling; committed `0fbd7791 chore(offline): disable automatic update checks`.
- Detached Listen Together from navigation, Settings, Appearance, top-bar logic, and routes; committed `a940b056 chore(offline): detach Listen Together UI`.
- Removed many guest-only restrictions from `Player.kt`, `OldPlayerMenu.kt`, and `PlayerMenu.kt`; recent `bash gradlew :app:assembleDebug` succeeded before the latest edits.
- Removed Listen Together suggestion actions from `SongMenu.kt` and `YouTubeSongMenu.kt`.

### Active
- Remove remaining guest-only restrictions and Listen Together UI paths across menus, queue, lyrics, artist, and player surfaces.
- Remove residual `PlayerConnection` callback/internal-sync fields after auditing/removing their manager callers.
- Audit remaining Listen Together callers, then remove disconnected DI providers, receiver, manifest filters, and protocol/module code.
- Update `docs/AURA_IMPLEMENTATION_LOG.md` with Stage 3 commit, run build and `git diff --check`, and commit this cleanup stage.
- Audit startup, manifest components/permissions, app-owned network consumers, and online module callers.
- Implement and test local-media scanning/playback, folders, playlists/M3U, lyrics, and navigation; document removals and remaining gaps.

### Blocked
- (none)

## Next Move
1. Continue clearing guest-only behavior; recent search found references in `Queue.kt`, `PlayerV2Landscape.kt`, `MiniPlayer.kt`, `AppleMiniPlayer.kt`, `Player_v2.kt`, `Queue_v2.kt`, lyrics, artist and numerous menu files.
2. Finish the caller audit before removing Listen Together protocol wiring and components.
3. Update the implementation log, run `bash gradlew :app:assembleDebug` and `git diff --check`, then commit the cleanup stage.

## Relevant Files
- `/tmp/opencode/aura-upstream/docs/AURA_IMPLEMENTATION_LOG.md`: Stage 3 commit entry is pending.
- `/tmp/opencode/aura-upstream/docs/AURA_UPSTREAM_AUDIT.md`: architecture, gaps, and removal/retention policy.
- `/tmp/opencode/aura-upstream/app/src/main/AndroidManifest.xml`: Listen Together receiver and invite-link filters remain; review other filters before editing.
- `/tmp/opencode/aura-upstream/app/src/main/kotlin/com/music/vivi/MainActivity.kt`: manager composition/injection cleanup is uncommitted; composition-local declaration remains.
- `/tmp/opencode/aura-upstream/app/src/main/kotlin/com/music/vivi/playback/PlayerConnection.kt`: guest-block callback/internal-sync fields remain.
- `/tmp/opencode/aura-upstream/app/src/main/kotlin/com/music/vivi/playback/MusicService.kt`: Listen Together injection/crossfade coupling was removed in uncommitted edits.
- `/tmp/opencode/aura-upstream/app/src/main/kotlin/com/music/vivi/di/AppModule.kt`: Listen Together DI providers remain.
- `/tmp/opencode/aura-upstream/app/src/main/kotlin/com/music/vivi/listentogether/`: protocol manager/client and action receiver await caller audit.
- `/tmp/opencode/aura-upstream/app/src/main/kotlin/com/music/vivi/ui/menu/`: residual guest restrictions and suggestion actions.
- `/tmp/opencode/aura-upstream/app/src/main/kotlin/com/music/vivi/ui/player/`: residual queue/player restrictions and manager wiring.
- `/tmp/opencode/aura-upstream/app/src/main/kotlin/com/music/vivi/ui/component/Lyrics.kt`: residual lyrics guest restrictions.
- `/tmp/opencode/aura-upstream/app/src/main/kotlin/com/music/vivi/ui/screens/artist/ArtistScreen.kt`: residual guest restrictions.

## Important Context
- Current branch is `main`, ahead of `origin/main` by 4 commits; cleanup changes are uncommitted in at least eight files, including `SongMenu.kt` and `YouTubeSongMenu.kt`.
- Recent search found `shouldBlockPlaybackChanges` and `allowInternalSync` callers in `ListenTogetherManager.kt`; do not remove the fields until that manager is removed or callers are updated.
- App-owned Ktor consumers include remote stream extraction, online lyrics, GitHub operations, Wikipedia, and Apple Music album descriptions.
- Online modules include `:innertube`, `:jiosaavn`, `:spotify`, `:lastfm`, `:kizzy`, `:shazamkit`, `:artistvideo`, `:Motionartwork`, and `:lyricsProvider`.
- Upstream has Room catalog, persisted queue/player state, Media3 playback, M3U utilities, and lyrics storage, but lacks a complete device-local audio scanner/file playback path; M3U import does not resolve entries to local files.
- `INTERNET` and `ACCESS_NETWORK_STATE` are declared; Last.fm API credentials are embedded in `app/build.gradle.kts`. A targeted audit found no Firebase Analytics/Crashlytics, Sentry, Amplitude, or PostHog SDK references.
- `./gradlew` fails with `/bin/bash: ./gradlew: Permission denied`; invoke Gradle as `bash gradlew`.

messages.summary:
## Objective
- Build AURA Music as a GPL-3.0 local-only derivative of `vivizzz007/vivi-music`, preserving upstream history and attribution.
- Audit, implement, verify, and document offline behavior, removals, remaining gaps, and build/test results.

## Requirements
- Document upstream architecture and requirement-by-requirement gaps.
- Rebrand as AURA Music with monochrome styling while retaining upstream copyright notices and GPL-3.0 attribution.
- Remove or exclude streaming/scraping, presence, online Canvas artwork, telemetry/crash reporting, and OTA features; document removals.
- Support local files, scanning, folders, M3U import/export, local lyrics, persistent queue/position, and Home/Search/Library/Settings navigation.
- Retain relevant tests, add tests for new code, build, and commit each stage.

## Decisions
- Work in `/tmp/opencode/aura-upstream`, retaining upstream history and remote `https://github.com/vivizzz007/vivi-music.git`.
- Use local Git author identity `AURA Agent <aura-agent@users.noreply.github.com>`.
- Detach Listen Together UI/navigation first; audit remaining callers before removing protocol/module code.
- Preserve MusicService persistence and local auto-backup; distinguish OTA/update work from local backup.
- Remove guest-only restrictions while retaining ordinary player/menu actions; remove dedicated Listen Together suggestion actions.

## Work State
### Completed
- Verified upstream baseline build; documented architecture and gaps; committed `12fff80d docs(audit): document upstream architecture and AURA gaps`.
- Implemented AURA identity and monochrome branding; build passed and committed `2eac54c8 chore(branding): rebrand app as AURA Music`.
- Disabled automatic updater checks and new-release worker scheduling; committed `0fbd7791 chore(offline): disable automatic update checks`.
- Detached Listen Together from navigation, Settings, Appearance, top-bar logic, and routes; committed `a940b056 chore(offline): detach Listen Together UI`.
- Began removing guest restrictions and Listen Together coupling: edited `Player.kt`, `PlayerConnection.kt`, `MusicService.kt`, `MainActivity.kt`, and player menus; removed Listen Together suggestion actions from `SongMenu.kt` and `YouTubeSongMenu.kt`.
- Recent `bash gradlew :app:assembleDebug` succeeded before the latest edits.

### Active
- Finish guest-only restriction cleanup across menus, queue, lyrics, artist, and player surfaces.
- Audit remaining Listen Together callers before removing DI providers, receiver, manifest filters, and protocol/module code.
- Update `docs/AURA_IMPLEMENTATION_LOG.md` with Stage 3 commit and cleanup-stage results; run build and `git diff --check`, then commit the cleanup stage.
- Audit startup, manifest components/permissions, app-owned network consumers, and online module callers.
- Implement and test local-media scanning/playback, folders, playlists/M3U, lyrics, and navigation; document removals and remaining gaps.

### Blocked
- (none)

## Next Move
1. Continue clearing guest-only behavior; references remain in menus, lyrics, artist, queue, mini-player, and player surfaces.
2. Finish the caller audit before removing Listen Together protocol wiring and components; `ListenTogetherManager` still calls `PlayerConnection` fields `shouldBlockPlaybackChanges` and `allowInternalSync`.
3. Update the implementation log, run `bash gradlew :app:assembleDebug` and `git diff --check`, then commit the cleanup stage.

## Relevant Files
- `/tmp/opencode/aura-upstream/docs/AURA_IMPLEMENTATION_LOG.md`: Stage 3 commit entry and cleanup-stage log are pending.
- `/tmp/opencode/aura-upstream/docs/AURA_UPSTREAM_AUDIT.md`: architecture, gaps, and removal/retention policy.
- `/tmp/opencode/aura-upstream/app/src/main/AndroidManifest.xml`: Listen Together receiver and invite-link filters remain.
- `/tmp/opencode/aura-upstream/app/src/main/kotlin/com/music/vivi/MainActivity.kt`: manager composition/injection was removed; composition-local declaration remains.
- `/tmp/opencode/aura-upstream/app/src/main/kotlin/com/music/vivi/playback/PlayerConnection.kt`: guest-block fields remain after playback-blocking guards were removed.
- `/tmp/opencode/aura-upstream/app/src/main/kotlin/com/music/vivi/playback/MusicService.kt`: Listen Together injection/crossfade coupling was removed.
- `/tmp/opencode/aura-upstream/app/src/main/kotlin/com/music/vivi/di/AppModule.kt`: Listen Together DI providers remain.
- `/tmp/opencode/aura-upstream/app/src/main/kotlin/com/music/vivi/listentogether/`: protocol manager/client and action receiver await caller audit.
- `/tmp/opencode/aura-upstream/app/src/main/kotlin/com/music/vivi/ui/menu/`: guest restrictions and remaining Listen Together references.
- `/tmp/opencode/aura-upstream/app/src/main/kotlin/com/music/vivi/ui/player/`: residual queue/player restrictions and manager wiring.
- `/tmp/opencode/aura-upstream/app/src/main/kotlin/com/music/vivi/ui/component/Lyrics.kt`: residual lyrics guest restrictions.
- `/tmp/opencode/aura-upstream/app/src/main/kotlin/com/music/vivi/ui/screens/artist/ArtistScreen.kt`: residual guest restrictions.

## Important Context
- Branch is `main`, ahead of `origin/main` by 4 commits; cleanup changes are uncommitted in at least eight files.
- `PlayerConnection` fields `shouldBlockPlaybackChanges` and `allowInternalSync` still have callers in `ListenTogetherManager.kt`; do not remove until callers are removed or updated.
- App-owned Ktor consumers include remote stream extraction, online lyrics, GitHub operations, Wikipedia, and Apple Music album descriptions.
- Online modules include `:innertube`, `:jiosaavn`, `:spotify`, `:lastfm`, `:kizzy`, `:shazamkit`, `:artistvideo`, `:Motionartwork`, and `:lyricsProvider`.
- Upstream has Room catalog, persisted queue/player state, Media3 playback, M3U utilities, and lyrics storage, but lacks a complete device-local audio scanner/file playback path; M3U import does not resolve entries to local files.
- `INTERNET` and `ACCESS_NETWORK_STATE` are declared; Last.fm API credentials are embedded in `app/build.gradle.kts`. A targeted audit found no Firebase Analytics/Crashlytics, Sentry, Amplitude, or PostHog SDK references.
- Invoke Gradle as `bash gradlew`; `./gradlew` fails with `/bin/bash: ./gradlew: Permission denied`.
