messages.summary:
## Objective
- Build AURA Music as a GPL-3.0 local-only derivative of `vivizzz007/vivi-music`, preserving upstream history and attribution.
- Audit, implement, verify, and document offline behavior, removals, remaining gaps, and build/test results.

## Requirements
- Document upstream architecture and requirement-by-requirement gaps.
- Rebrand as AURA Music with monochrome styling while retaining upstream copyright notices and GPL-3.0 attribution.
- Remove or exclude streaming/scraping, presence, online Canvas artwork, telemetry/crash reporting, and OTA features; document removals.
- Support local files, scanning, folders, M3U import/export, local lyrics, persistent queue/position, and Home/Search/Library/Settings navigation.
- Retain relevant tests, add tests for new code, build, and commit each stage.

## Decisions
- Work in `/tmp/opencode/aura-upstream`, retaining upstream history and remote `https://github.com/vivizzz007/vivi-music.git`.
- Use local Git author identity `AURA Agent <aura-agent@users.noreply.github.com>`.
- Detach Listen Together UI/navigation first; audit remaining callers before removing protocol/module code.
- Preserve MusicService persistence and local auto-backup; distinguish OTA/update work from local backup.
- Remove guest-only restrictions while retaining ordinary player/menu actions; remove dedicated Listen Together suggestion actions.

## Work State
### Completed
- Verified upstream baseline build; documented architecture and gaps; committed `12fff80d docs(audit): document upstream architecture and AURA gaps`.
- Implemented AURA identity and monochrome branding; build passed and committed `2eac54c8 chore(branding): rebrand app as AURA Music`.
- Disabled automatic updater checks and new-release worker scheduling; committed `0fbd7791 chore(offline): disable automatic update checks`.
- Detached Listen Together from navigation, Settings, Appearance, top-bar logic, and routes; committed `a940b056 chore(offline): detach Listen Together UI`.
- Began removing guest playback restrictions and Listen Together coupling in eight uncommitted files; removed Listen Together suggestion actions from `SongMenu.kt` and `YouTubeSongMenu.kt`.
- Recent `bash gradlew :app:assembleDebug` succeeded before these latest edits.

### Active
- Finish guest-only restriction cleanup across menus, lyrics, artist, queue, mini-player, and player surfaces.
- Audit remaining Listen Together callers before removing DI providers, receiver, manifest filters, and protocol/module code.
- Update `docs/AURA_IMPLEMENTATION_LOG.md` with Stage 3 commit and cleanup-stage results; run build and `git diff --check`, then commit the cleanup stage.
- Audit startup, manifest components/permissions, app-owned network consumers, and online module callers.
- Implement and test local-media scanning/playback, folders, playlists/M3U, lyrics, and navigation; document removals and remaining gaps.

### Blocked
- (none)

## Next Move
1. Continue clearing guest-only behavior; many references remain in menus, lyrics, artist, queue, mini-player, and player surfaces.
2. Finish the Listen Together caller audit; `ListenTogetherManager` still uses `PlayerConnection.shouldBlockPlaybackChanges` and `allowInternalSync`.
3. Inspect the large `PlayerMenu.kt` diff (1,265 deleted lines) to ensure ordinary player/menu actions were not removed unintentionally.
4. Update the implementation log, run `bash gradlew :app:assembleDebug` and `git diff --check`, then commit the cleanup stage.

## Relevant Files
- `/tmp/opencode/aura-upstream/docs/AURA_IMPLEMENTATION_LOG.md`: Stage 3 commit entry and cleanup-stage log are pending.
- `/tmp/opencode/aura-upstream/docs/AURA_UPSTREAM_AUDIT.md`: architecture, gaps, and removal/retention policy.
- `/tmp/opencode/aura-upstream/app/src/main/AndroidManifest.xml`: Listen Together receiver and invite-link filters remain.
- `/tmp/opencode/aura-upstream/app/src/main/kotlin/com/music/vivi/MainActivity.kt`: manager composition/injection was removed; composition-local declaration remains.
- `/tmp/opencode/aura-upstream/app/src/main/kotlin/com/music/vivi/playback/PlayerConnection.kt`: guest-block fields remain after playback-blocking guards were removed.
- `/tmp/opencode/aura-upstream/app/src/main/kotlin/com/music/vivi/playback/MusicService.kt`: Listen Together injection/crossfade coupling was removed.
- `/tmp/opencode/aura-upstream/app/src/main/kotlin/com/music/vivi/di/AppModule.kt`: Listen Together DI providers remain.
- `/tmp/opencode/aura-upstream/app/src/main/kotlin/com/music/vivi/listentogether/`: protocol manager/client and action receiver await caller audit.
- `/tmp/opencode/aura-upstream/app/src/main/kotlin/com/music/vivi/ui/menu/`: guest restrictions and remaining Listen Together references.
- `/tmp/opencode/aura-upstream/app/src/main/kotlin/com/music/vivi/ui/player/`: residual queue/player restrictions and manager wiring.
- `/tmp/opencode/aura-upstream/app/src/main/kotlin/com/music/vivi/ui/component/Lyrics.kt`: residual lyrics guest restrictions.
- `/tmp/opencode/aura-upstream/app/src/main/kotlin/com/music/vivi/ui/screens/artist/ArtistScreen.kt`: residual guest restrictions.

## Important Context
- Branch is `main`, ahead of `origin/main` by 4 commits; current cleanup changes are uncommitted in eight files.
- `PlayerConnection` fields `shouldBlockPlaybackChanges` and `allowInternalSync` still have callers in `ListenTogetherManager.kt`; do not remove until callers are removed or updated.
- App-owned Ktor consumers include remote stream extraction, online lyrics, GitHub operations, Wikipedia, and Apple Music album descriptions.
- Online modules include `:innertube`, `:jiosaavn`, `:spotify`, `:lastfm`, `:kizzy`, `:shazamkit`, `:artistvideo`, `:Motionartwork`, and `:lyricsProvider`.
- Upstream has Room catalog, persisted queue/player state, Media3 playback, M3U utilities, and lyrics storage, but lacks a complete device-local audio scanner/file playback path; M3U import does not resolve entries to local files.

## Objective
- Build AURA Music as a GPL-3.0 local-only derivative of `vivizzz007/vivi-music`, preserving upstream history and attribution.
- Audit, implement, verify, and document offline behavior, removals, remaining gaps, and build/test results.

## Requirements
- Document upstream architecture and requirement-by-requirement gaps.
- Rebrand as AURA Music with monochrome styling while retaining upstream copyright notices and GPL-3.0 attribution.
- Remove or exclude streaming/scraping, presence, online Canvas artwork, telemetry/crash reporting, and OTA features; document removals.
- Support local files, scanning, folders, M3U import/export, local lyrics, persistent queue/position, and Home/Search/Library/Settings navigation.
- Retain relevant tests, add tests for new code, build, and commit each stage.

## Decisions
- Work in `/tmp/opencode/aura-upstream`, retaining upstream history and remote `https://github.com/vivizzz007/vivi-music.git`.
- Use local Git author identity `AURA Agent <aura-agent@users.noreply.github.com>`.
- Detach Listen Together UI/navigation first; audit remaining callers before removing protocol/module code.
- Preserve MusicService persistence and local auto-backup; distinguish OTA/update work from local backup.
- Remove guest-only restrictions while retaining ordinary player/menu actions; remove dedicated Listen Together suggestion actions.

## Work State
### Completed
- Verified upstream baseline build; documented architecture and gaps; committed `12fff80d docs(audit): document upstream architecture and AURA gaps`.
- Implemented AURA identity and monochrome branding; build passed and committed `2eac54c8 chore(branding): rebrand app as AURA Music`.
- Disabled automatic updater checks and new-release worker scheduling; committed `0fbd7791 chore(offline): disable automatic update checks`.
- Detached Listen Together from navigation, Settings, Appearance, top-bar logic, and routes; committed `a940b056 chore(offline): detach Listen Together UI`.
- Removed Listen Together suggestion actions from `SongMenu.kt` and `YouTubeSongMenu.kt`.
- A recent `bash gradlew :app:assembleDebug` succeeded before the current uncommitted cleanup edits.

### Active
- Finish guest-only restriction cleanup across menus, lyrics, artist, queue, mini-player, and player surfaces.
- Audit remaining Listen Together callers before removing DI providers, receiver, manifest filters, and protocol/module code.
- Review the large `PlayerMenu.kt` diff to ensure ordinary player/menu actions were not removed unintentionally.
- Update `docs/AURA_IMPLEMENTATION_LOG.md` with completed stages and cleanup results; run build and `git diff --check`, then commit the cleanup stage.
- Audit startup, manifest components/permissions, app-owned network consumers, and online module callers.
- Implement and test local-media scanning/playback, folders, playlists/M3U, lyrics, and navigation; document removals and remaining gaps.

### Blocked
- (none)

## Next Move
1. Continue clearing guest-only behavior and inspect remaining restrictions/callers across menus, lyrics, artist, queue, mini-player, and player surfaces.
2. Finish the Listen Together caller audit; remove protocol/module pieces only after verifying no remaining callers.
3. Review `PlayerMenu.kt` deletions for unintended loss of ordinary functionality.
4. Update the implementation log, run `bash gradlew :app:assembleDebug` and `git diff --check`, then commit the cleanup stage.

## Relevant Files
- `/tmp/opencode/aura-upstream/docs/AURA_IMPLEMENTATION_LOG.md`: stage and cleanup progress log needs updating.
- `/tmp/opencode/aura-upstream/docs/AURA_UPSTREAM_AUDIT.md`: architecture, gaps, and removal/retention policy.
- `/tmp/opencode/aura-upstream/app/src/main/AndroidManifest.xml`: Listen Together receiver and invite-link filters remain.
- `/tmp/opencode/aura-upstream/app/src/main/kotlin/com/music/vivi/MainActivity.kt`: composition-local declaration remains after manager composition/injection removal.
- `/tmp/opencode/aura-upstream/app/src/main/kotlin/com/music/vivi/playback/PlayerConnection.kt`: guest-block fields remain.
- `/tmp/opencode/aura-upstream/app/src/main/kotlin/com/music/vivi/playback/MusicService.kt`: Listen Together injection/crossfade coupling was removed.
- `/tmp/opencode/aura-upstream/app/src/main/kotlin/com/music/vivi/di/AppModule.kt`: Listen Together DI providers remain.
- `/tmp/opencode/aura-upstream/app/src/main/kotlin/com/music/vivi/listentogether/`: protocol manager/client and action receiver await caller audit.
- `/tmp/opencode/aura-upstream/app/src/main/kotlin/com/music/vivi/ui/menu/`: guest restrictions and remaining Listen Together references.
- `/tmp/opencode/aura-upstream/app/src/main/kotlin/com/music/vivi/ui/player/`: residual queue/player restrictions and manager wiring.
- `/tmp/opencode/aura-upstream/app/src/main/kotlin/com/music/vivi/ui/component/Lyrics.kt`: residual lyrics guest restrictions.
- `/tmp/opencode/aura-upstream/app/src/main/kotlin/com/music/vivi/ui/screens/artist/ArtistScreen.kt`: residual guest restrictions.

## Important Context
- Branch is `main`, ahead of `origin/main` by 4 commits; current cleanup changes are uncommitted in eight files: `MainActivity.kt`, `MusicService.kt`, `PlayerConnection.kt`, `OldPlayerMenu.kt`, `PlayerMenu.kt`, `SongMenu.kt`, `YouTubeSongMenu.kt`, and `Player.kt`.
- `PlayerConnection.shouldBlockPlaybackChanges` and `allowInternalSync` still have callers in `ListenTogetherManager.kt`; do not remove until callers are removed or updated.
- Recent search found additional Listen Together/guest references, including `ArtistMenu.kt` and `YouTubePlaylistMenu.kt`.
- App-owned Ktor consumers include remote stream extraction, online lyrics, GitHub operations, Wikipedia, and Apple Music album descriptions.
- Online modules include `:innertube`, `:jiosaavn`, `:spotify`, `:lastfm`, `:kizzy`, `:shazamkit`, `:artistvideo`, `:Motionartwork`, and `:lyricsProvider`.
- Upstream has Room catalog, persisted queue/player state, Media3 playback, M3U utilities, and lyrics storage, but lacks a complete device-local audio scanner/file playback path; M3U import does not resolve entries to local files.
- `INTERNET` and `ACCESS_NETWORK_STATE` are declared; Last.fm API credentials are embedded in `app/build.gradle.kts`. A targeted audit found no Firebase Analytics/Crashlytics, Sentry, Amplitude, or PostHog SDK references.
- Invoke Gradle as `bash gradlew`; `./gradlew` fails with `/bin/bash: ./gradlew: Permission denied`.

messages.summary:
## Objective
- Build AURA Music as a GPL-3.0 local-only derivative of `vivizzz007/vivi-music`, preserving upstream history and attribution.
- Remove online/social features while supporting local media, scanning, folders, playlists/M3U, lyrics, persistent playback state, and core navigation.

## Requirements
- Document upstream architecture, requirement gaps, removals, remaining gaps, and verification results.
- Rebrand as AURA Music with monochrome styling while retaining upstream copyright notices and GPL-3.0 attribution.
- Remove or exclude streaming/scraping, presence, online artwork, telemetry/crash reporting, and OTA features; preserve local backup.
- Retain relevant tests, add tests for new code, build, and commit each stage.

## Decisions

@Composable
fun PlayerMenu(
    mediaMetadata: MediaMetadata?,
    navController: NavController,
    playerBottomSheetState: BottomSheetState,
    isQueueTrigger: Boolean? = false,
    onShowDetailsDialog: () -> Unit,
    onDismiss: () -> Unit,
) {
    mediaMetadata ?: return
    val context = LocalContext.current
    val database = LocalDatabase.current
    val playerConnection = LocalPlayerConnection.current ?: return
    val playerVolume = playerConnection.service.playerVolume.collectAsState()
    
    // Cast state for volume control - safely access castConnectionHandler to prevent crashes
    val castHandler = remember(playerConnection) {
        try {
            playerConnection.service.castConnectionHandler
        } catch (e: Exception) {
            null
        }
    }
    val isCasting by castHandler?.isCasting?.collectAsState() ?: remember { mutableStateOf(false) }
    val castVolume by castHandler?.castVolume?.collectAsState() ?: remember { mutableFloatStateOf(1f) }
    val castDeviceName by castHandler?.castDeviceName?.collectAsState() ?: remember { mutableStateOf<String?>(null) }
    
    val librarySong by database.song(mediaMetadata.id).collectAsState(initial = null)
    val coroutineScope = rememberCoroutineScope()
    val (saavnEnabled) = rememberPreference(EnableSaavnStreamingKey, defaultValue = false)

    val download by LocalDownloadUtil.current.getDownload(mediaMetadata.id)
        .collectAsState(initial = null)

    val artists =
        remember(mediaMetadata.artists) {
            mediaMetadata.artists.filter { it.id != null }
        }

    var showChoosePlaylistDialog by rememberSaveable {
        mutableStateOf(false)
    }
    
    AddToPlaylistDialog(
        isVisible = showChoosePlaylistDialog,
        onGetSong = { playlist ->
            database.transaction {
                insert(mediaMetadata)
            }
            coroutineScope.launch(Dispatchers.IO) {
                playlist.playlist.browseId?.let { YouTube.addToPlaylist(it, mediaMetadata.id) }
            }
            listOf(mediaMetadata.id)
        },
        onDismiss = {
            showChoosePlaylistDialog = false
        }
    )

    var showSelectArtistDialog by rememberSaveable {
        mutableStateOf(false)
    }

    if (showSelectArtistDialog) {
        ListDialog(
            onDismiss = { showSelectArtistDialog = false },
        ) {
            items(artists) { artist ->
                Box(
                    contentAlignment = Alignment.CenterStart,
                    modifier =
                    Modifier
                        .fillParentMaxWidth()
                        .height(ListItemHeight)
                        .clickable {
                            navController.navigate("artist/${artist.id}")
                            showSelectArtistDialog = false
                            playerBottomSheetState.collapseSoft()
                            onDismiss()
                        }
                        .padding(horizontal = 24.dp),
                ) {
                    Text(
                        text = artist.name,
                        fontSize = 18.sp,
                        fontWeight = FontWeight.Bold,
                        maxLines = 1,
                        overflow = TextOverflow.Ellipsis,
                    )
                }
            }
        }
    }

    var showPitchTempoDialog by rememberSaveable {
        mutableStateOf(false)
    }

    if (showPitchTempoDialog) {
        TempoPitchDialog(
            onDismiss = { showPitchTempoDialog = false },
        )
    }

    if (isQueueTrigger != true) {
        Column(
            modifier = Modifier
                .fillMaxWidth()
                .padding(horizontal = 24.dp)
                .padding(top = 24.dp, bottom = 6.dp),
        ) {
            // Show Cast indicator when casting
            if (isCasting && castDeviceName != null) {
                Row(
                    horizontalArrangement = Arrangement.Center,
                    verticalAlignment = Alignment.CenterVertically,
                    modifier = Modifier
                        .fillMaxWidth()
                        .padding(bottom = 16.dp)
                ) {
                    Icon(
                        painter = painterResource(R.drawable.cast),
                        contentDescription = null,
                        modifier = Modifier.size(24.dp),
                        tint = MaterialTheme.colorScheme.primary
                    )
                    Spacer(modifier = Modifier.width(10.dp))
                    Text(
                        text = stringResource(R.string.casting_to, castDeviceName ?: ""),
                        style = MaterialTheme.typography.bodyMedium,
                        color = MaterialTheme.colorScheme.primary
                    )
                }
            }
            
            VolumeSlider(
                value = if (isCasting) castVolume else playerVolume.value,
                onValueChange = { volume ->
                    if (isCasting) {
                        castHandler?.setVolume(volume)
                    } else {
                        playerConnection.service.playerVolume.value = volume
                    }
                },
                modifier = Modifier.fillMaxWidth(),
                accentColor = MaterialTheme.colorScheme.primary
            )
        }
    }

    Spacer(modifier = Modifier.height(20.dp))

    HorizontalDivider()

    Spacer(modifier = Modifier.height(12.dp))

    val configuration = LocalConfiguration.current
    val isPortrait = configuration.orientation == Configuration.ORIENTATION_PORTRAIT

import re
for name in ['SongMenu.kt', 'YouTubeSongMenu.kt']:
    path = Path('app/src/main/kotlin/com/music/vivi/ui/menu') / name
    text = path.read_text()
    pattern = re.compile(r'(?m)^([ \t]*)if \(!isGuest\) \{\n(.*?)\n\1\} else null,', re.S)
    text, count = pattern.subn(lambda m: '\n'.join(line[len(m.group(1)) + 4:] if line.startswith(m.group(1) + '    ') else line for line in m.group(2).splitlines()), text)
    if name == 'YouTubeSongMenu.kt':
        text = text.replace('columns = if (isGuest) 2 else 3,', 'columns = 3,')
    text = text.replace('    val isGuest = listenTogetherManager?.isInRoom == true && !listenTogetherManager.isHost\n\n', '')
    text = text.replace('    val listenTogetherManager = LocalListenTogetherManager.current\n', '')
    text = text.replace('import com.music.vivi.LocalListenTogetherManager\n', '')
    path.write_text(text)
    print(name, 'unwrapped', count)

messages.summary:
## Objective
- Build AURA Music as a GPL-3.0 local-only derivative of `vivizzz007/vivi-music`, preserving upstream history and attribution.
- Remove online/social features while supporting local media, scanning, folders, playlists/M3U, lyrics, persistent playback state, and core navigation.

## Requirements
- Document upstream architecture, requirement gaps, removals, remaining gaps, and verification results.
- Rebrand as AURA Music with monochrome styling while retaining upstream copyright notices and GPL-3.0 attribution.
- Remove or exclude streaming/scraping, presence, online artwork, telemetry/crash reporting, and OTA features; preserve local backup.
- Retain relevant tests, add tests for new code, build, and commit each stage.

## Decisions
- Work in `/tmp/opencode/aura-upstream`, retaining upstream history and remote `https://github.com/vivizzz007/vivi-music.git`.
- Detach Listen Together UI/navigation first; audit remaining callers before removing protocol/module code.
- Preserve MusicService persistence and local auto-backup; distinguish OTA updates from local backup.
- Remove guest-only restrictions while retaining ordinary player/menu actions and removing Listen Together suggestion actions.

## Work State
### Completed
- Verified upstream baseline build; documented architecture and gaps; committed `12fff80d docs(audit): document upstream architecture and AURA gaps`.
- Implemented AURA identity and monochrome branding; build passed and committed `2eac54c8 chore(branding): rebrand app as AURA Music`.
- Disabled automatic updater checks and new-release worker scheduling; committed `0fbd7791 chore(offline): disable automatic update checks`.
- Detached Listen Together from navigation, Settings, Appearance, top-bar logic, and routes; committed `a940b056 chore(offline): detach Listen Together UI`.
- Removed obsolete `isListenTogetherGuest = false` arguments from `Player.kt`.
- Removed guest gating from local/YouTube song menu queue and radio actions; removed corresponding Listen Together manager state/imports.

### Active
- Verify the recent `SongMenu.kt` and `YouTubeSongMenu.kt` edits for formatting and compilation; remove trailing whitespace in changed menu files.
- Continue the Listen Together caller audit, including `CommentTogether.kt`, composition-local consumers, DI providers, receiver, manifest filters, and protocol/module code.
- Update `docs/AURA_IMPLEMENTATION_LOG.md`; run `git diff --check` and `bash gradlew :app:assembleDebug`; commit the cleanup stage.
- Continue offline audit and implement/test local-media scanning/playback, folders, playlists/M3U, lyrics, and navigation.

### Blocked
- (none)

## Next Move
1. Inspect the recent song-menu action-list edits and remaining guest gates; run `git diff --check`.
2. Run `bash gradlew :app:assembleDebug`, fix failures, and update the implementation log.
3. Commit the cleanup stage, then continue the Listen Together call-site audit before removing its infrastructure.

## Relevant Files
- `/tmp/opencode/aura-upstream/docs/AURA_IMPLEMENTATION_LOG.md`: progress log; cleanup stage needs documenting.
- `/tmp/opencode/aura-upstream/docs/AURA_UPSTREAM_AUDIT.md`: architecture, gaps, and removal/retention policy.
- `/tmp/opencode/aura-upstream/app/src/main/kotlin/com/music/vivi/ui/menu/SongMenu.kt`: guest-gate removals; recent action-list edits need validation.
- `/tmp/opencode/aura-upstream/app/src/main/kotlin/com/music/vivi/ui/menu/YouTubeSongMenu.kt`: guest-gate removals; recent action-list edits need validation.
- `/tmp/opencode/aura-upstream/app/src/main/kotlin/com/music/vivi/ui/menu/PlayerMenu.kt`: detached Listen Together dialog; stale imports were removed.
- `/tmp/opencode/aura-upstream/app/src/main/kotlin/com/music/vivi/ui/player/Player.kt`: removed obsolete thumbnail arguments.
- `/tmp/opencode/aura-upstream/app/src/main/kotlin/com/music/vivi/ui/player/Thumbnail.kt`: room status indicator still consumes Listen Together state.
- `/tmp/opencode/aura-upstream/app/src/main/kotlin/com/music/vivi/ui/screens/CommentTogether.kt`: remaining live manager consumer.
- `/tmp/opencode/aura-upstream/app/src/main/kotlin/com/music/vivi/MainActivity.kt`: composition-local declaration remains.
- `/tmp/opencode/aura-upstream/app/src/main/kotlin/com/music/vivi/di/AppModule.kt`: Listen Together DI providers remain.
- `/tmp/opencode/aura-upstream/app/src/main/AndroidManifest.xml`: receiver and invite-link filters remain.
- `/tmp/opencode/aura-upstream/app/src/main/kotlin/com/music/vivi/listentogether/`: protocol manager/client and action receiver await caller audit.

## Important Context
- Cleanup changes are uncommitted across 27 files; current branch is `main`, previously ahead of `origin/main` by four commits.
- `git diff --check` previously failed on trailing whitespace in menu files; rerun after recent edits.
- The latest `SongMenu.kt` and `YouTubeSongMenu.kt` action lists were rewritten but have not yet been checked or built.
- Recent `bash gradlew :app:assembleDebug` passed before the current cleanup; invoke Gradle as `bash gradlew` because `./gradlew` fails with `/bin/bash: ./gradlew: Permission denied`.
- `PlayerConnection.shouldBlockPlaybackChanges` and `allowInternalSync` have assignments in `ListenTogetherManager.kt` but no discovered reads; verify together before deleting.
- App-owned Ktor consumers include remote stream extraction, online lyrics, GitHub operations, Wikipedia, and Apple Music album descriptions; online modules include `:innertube`, `:jiosaavn`, `:spotify`, `:lastfm`, `:kizzy`, `:shazamkit`, `:artistvideo`, `:Motionartwork`, and `:lyricsProvider`.
- `INTERNET` and `ACCESS_NETWORK_STATE` are declared; Last.fm API credentials are embedded in `app/build.gradle.kts`; no Firebase Analytics/Crashlytics, Sentry, Amplitude, or PostHog SDK references were found.

## Objective
- Build AURA Music as a GPL-3.0 local-only derivative of `vivizzz007/vivi-music`, preserving upstream history and attribution.
- Remove online/social features while supporting local media, scanning, folders, playlists/M3U, lyrics, persistent playback state, and core navigation.

## Requirements
- Document upstream architecture, requirement gaps, removals, remaining gaps, and verification results.
- Rebrand as AURA Music with monochrome styling while retaining upstream copyright notices and GPL-3.0 attribution.
- Remove or exclude streaming/scraping, presence, online artwork, telemetry/crash reporting, and OTA features; preserve local backup.
- Retain relevant tests, add tests for new code, build, and commit each stage.

## Decisions
- Work in `/tmp/opencode/aura-upstream`, retaining upstream history and remote `https://github.com/vivizzz007/vivi-music.git`.
- Detach Listen Together UI/navigation first; audit remaining callers before removing protocol/module code.
- Preserve MusicService persistence and local auto-backup; distinguish OTA updates from local backup.
- Remove guest-only restrictions while retaining ordinary player/menu actions and removing Listen Together suggestion actions.

## Work State
### Completed
- Verified upstream baseline build; documented architecture and gaps; committed `12fff80d docs(audit): document upstream architecture and AURA gaps`.
- Implemented AURA identity and monochrome branding; build passed and committed `2eac54c8 chore(branding): rebrand app as AURA Music`.
- Disabled automatic updater checks and new-release worker scheduling; committed `0fbd7791 chore(offline): disable automatic update checks`.
- Detached Listen Together from navigation, Settings, Appearance, top-bar logic, and routes; committed `a940b056 chore(offline): detach Listen Together UI`.
- Removed guest gating from local/YouTube song menu queue and radio actions; removed corresponding Listen Together manager state/imports.
- Fixed malformed action-list formatting in `YouTubeSongMenu.kt` and stripped trailing whitespace from modified files; `git diff --check` passed.

### Active
- Validate the current cleanup build: `bash gradlew :app:assembleDebug` ran past the 120-second timeout; output showed Kotlin compilation and packaging progressing but did not confirm task completion.
- Continue the Listen Together caller audit before removing its infrastructure.
- Update `docs/AURA_IMPLEMENTATION_LOG.md`, rerun verification, and commit the cleanup stage.
- Continue offline audit and implement/test local-media scanning/playback, folders, playlists/M3U, lyrics, and navigation.

### Blocked
- (none)

## Next Move
1. Rerun `bash gradlew :app:assembleDebug` with a longer timeout and confirm completion.
2. Review remaining Listen Together consumers, including `CommentTogether.kt`, `Thumbnail.kt`, composition-local consumers, DI providers, receiver, manifest filters, and protocol/module code.
3. Update the implementation log, run `git diff --check`, and commit the cleanup stage.

## Relevant Files
- `/tmp/opencode/aura-upstream/docs/AURA_IMPLEMENTATION_LOG.md`: progress log; cleanup stage still needs documenting.
- `/tmp/opencode/aura-upstream/docs/AURA_UPSTREAM_AUDIT.md`: architecture, gaps, and removal/retention policy.
- `/tmp/opencode/aura-upstream/app/src/main/kotlin/com/music/vivi/ui/menu/SongMenu.kt`: guest-gate removals.
- `/tmp/opencode/aura-upstream/app/src/main/kotlin/com/music/vivi/ui/menu/YouTubeSongMenu.kt`: guest-gate removals and corrected action-list formatting.
- `/tmp/opencode/aura-upstream/app/src/main/kotlin/com/music/vivi/ui/player/Thumbnail.kt`: remaining Listen Together status indicator.
- `/tmp/opencode/aura-upstream/app/src/main/kotlin/com/music/vivi/ui/screens/CommentTogether.kt`: remaining live manager consumer.
- `/tmp/opencode/aura-upstream/app/src/main/kotlin/com/music/vivi/MainActivity.kt`: composition-local declaration remains.
- `/tmp/opencode/aura-upstream/app/src/main/kotlin/com/music/vivi/di/AppModule.kt`: Listen Together DI providers remain.
- `/tmp/opencode/aura-upstream/app/src/main/AndroidManifest.xml`: receiver and invite-link filters remain.
- `/tmp/opencode/aura-upstream/app/src/main/kotlin/com/music/vivi/listentogether/`: protocol manager/client and action receiver await caller audit.

## Important Context
- Cleanup changes are uncommitted across 27 files on `main`; the branch was previously four commits ahead of `origin/main`.
- The latest `:app:assembleDebug` invocation timed out after 120 seconds, with compilation and packaging still progressing; it did not report a compile failure.
- `PlayerConnection.shouldBlockPlaybackChanges` and `allowInternalSync` assignments remain in `ListenTogetherManager.kt`; verify all uses before removing related fields.
- App-owned Ktor consumers include remote stream extraction, online lyrics, GitHub operations, Wikipedia, and Apple Music album descriptions; online modules include `:innertube`, `:jiosaavn`, `:spotify`, `:lastfm`, `:kizzy`, `:shazamkit`, `:artistvideo`, `:Motionartwork`, and `:lyricsProvider`.
- `INTERNET` and `ACCESS_NETWORK_STATE` are declared; Last.fm API credentials are embedded in `app/build.gradle.kts`; no Firebase Analytics/Crashlytics, Sentry, Amplitude, or PostHog SDK references were found.

154: @Stable

171:         thumbnailSize = effectiveSize,

176: /**
177:  * Get media items for the thumbnail carousel.
178:  * Calculates previous, current, and next items based on shuffle mode.
179:  */
180: @Stable
181: private fun getMediaItems(
182:     player: Player,
183:     swipeThumbnail: Boolean
184: ): MediaItemsData {
185:     val timeline = player.currentTimeline
186:     val currentIndex = player.currentMediaItemIndex
187:     val shuffleModeEnabled = player.shuffleModeEnabled
188: 
189:     val currentMediaItem = try {
190:         player.currentMediaItem
191:     } catch (e: Exception) { null }
192: 
193:     val previousMediaItem = if (swipeThumbnail && !timeline.isEmpty) {
194:         val previousIndex = timeline.getPreviousWindowIndex(
195:             currentIndex,
196:             Player.REPEAT_MODE_OFF,
197:             shuffleModeEnabled
198:         )
199:         if (previousIndex != C.INDEX_UNSET) {
200:             try { player.getMediaItemAt(previousIndex) } catch (e: Exception) { null }
201:         } else null
202:     } else null
203: 
204:     val nextMediaItem = if (swipeThumbnail && !timeline.isEmpty) {
205:         val nextIndex = timeline.getNextWindowIndex(
206:             currentIndex,
207:             Player.REPEAT_MODE_OFF,
208:             shuffleModeEnabled
209:         )
210:         if (nextIndex != C.INDEX_UNSET) {
211:             try { player.getMediaItemAt(nextIndex) } catch (e: Exception) { null }
212:         } else null
213:     } else null
214: 
215:     val items = listOfNotNull(previousMediaItem, currentMediaItem, nextMediaItem)
216:     val currentMediaIndex = items.indexOf(currentMediaItem)
217: 
218:     return MediaItemsData(items, currentMediaIndex)
219: }

235: object MotionartworkPlaybackCache {
236:     private const val defaultMaxSize = 256
237:     private val map = LinkedHashMap<String, Motionartwork>(defaultMaxSize, 0.75f, true)
238:     @Volatile private var maxSize = defaultMaxSize
239: 
240:     @Synchronized
241:     fun get(mediaId: String): Motionartwork? {
242:         if (maxSize <= 0) return null
243:         return map[mediaId]
244:     }
245: 
246:     @Synchronized
247:     fun put(mediaId: String, artwork: Motionartwork) {
248:         val limit = maxSize
249:         if (limit <= 0) return
250:         if (mediaId.isBlank()) return
251:         map[mediaId] = artwork
252:         while (map.size > limit) {
253:             val it = map.entries.iterator()
254:             if (it.hasNext()) {
255:                 it.next()
256:                 it.remove()
257:             }
258:         }
259:     }
260: 
261:     @Synchronized
262:     fun clear() {
263:         map.clear()
264:     }
265: 
266:     @Synchronized
267:     fun setMaxSize(value: Int) {
268:         maxSize = value.coerceAtLeast(0)
269:         if (maxSize == 0) {
270:             map.clear()
271:             return
272:         }
273:         while (map.size > maxSize) {
274:             val it = map.entries.iterator()
275:             if (it.hasNext()) {
276:                 it.next()
277:                 it.remove()
278:             } else {
279:                 break
280:             }
281:         }
282:     }
283: }

490:                     ) {

494:                                 item.mediaId.ifEmpty { "unknown_${item.hashCode()}" }

496:                         ) { item ->

606: @Composable
607: private fun ThumbnailItem(
608:     item: MediaItem,
609:     dimensions: ThumbnailDimensions,
610:     hidePlayerThumbnail: Boolean,
611:     cropAlbumArt: Boolean,
612:     textBackgroundColor: Color,
613:     layoutDirection: LayoutDirection,
614:     onSeek: (String, Boolean) -> Unit,
615:     playerConnection: com.music.vivi.playback.PlayerConnection,
616:     context: android.content.Context,
617:     isLandscape: Boolean = false,
618:     currentMediaId: String? = null,
619:     currentMediaThumbnail: String? = null,
620:     playerBackground: PlayerBackgroundStyle = PlayerBackgroundStyle.DEFAULT,
621:     modifier: Modifier = Modifier,
622: ) {
623:     val rotatingThumbnail by rememberPreference(RotatingThumbnailKey, defaultValue = false)
624:     val showPlayerThumbnailShadow by rememberPreference(ShowPlayerThumbnailShadowKey, defaultValue = false)
625:     val playerThumbnailShadowElevation by rememberPreference(PlayerThumbnailShadowElevationKey, defaultValue = 8f)
626:     val isPlaying by playerConnection.isPlaying.collectAsState()
627:     val isCurrentItem = item.mediaId == currentMediaId
628: 
629:     val infiniteTransition = rememberInfiniteTransition(label = "ThumbnailRotation")
630:     val rotation by infiniteTransition.animateFloat(
631:         initialValue = 0f,
632:         targetValue = if (isPlaying && rotatingThumbnail && isCurrentItem) 360f else 0f,
633:         animationSpec = infiniteRepeatable(
634:             animation = tween(20000, easing = LinearEasing),
635:             repeatMode = androidx.compose.animation.core.RepeatMode.Restart
636:         ),
637:         label = "Rotation"
638:     )
639: 
640:     val incrementalSeekSkipEnabled by rememberPreference(SeekExtraSeconds, defaultValue = false)
641:     var skipMultiplier by remember { mutableIntStateOf(1) }
642:     var lastTapTime by remember { mutableLongStateOf(0L) }
643: 
644:     val canvasThumbnailAnimation by rememberPreference(CanvasThumbnailAnimationKey, defaultValue = true)
645:     val canvasLoadOnlyWifi by rememberPreference(CanvasLoadOnlyWifiKey, defaultValue = false)
646: 
647:     Box(
648:         modifier = modifier
649:             .then(
650:                 if (isLandscape) {
651:                     Modifier.size(dimensions.thumbnailSize + (PlayerHorizontalPadding * 2))
652:                 } else {
653:                     Modifier
654:                         .width(dimensions.itemWidth)
655:                         .fillMaxSize()
656:                 }
657:             )
658:             .padding(horizontal = PlayerHorizontalPadding)
659:             .graphicsLayer {
660:                 // Render entire thumbnail item on separate hardware layer for smooth animations
661:                 // Offscreen compositing removed to prevent interference with AndroidView
662:             }
663:             .pointerInput(Unit) {
664:                 detectTapGestures(
665:                     onDoubleTap = { offset ->
666:                         val currentPosition = playerConnection.player.currentPosition
667:                         val duration = playerConnection.player.duration
668: 
669:                         val now = System.currentTimeMillis()
670:                         if (incrementalSeekSkipEnabled && now - lastTapTime < 1000) {
671:                             skipMultiplier++
672:                         } else {
673:                             skipMultiplier = 1
674:                         }
675:                         lastTapTime = now
676: 
677:                         val skipAmount = 5000 * skipMultiplier
678: 
679:                         val isLeftSide = (layoutDirection == LayoutDirection.Ltr && offset.x < size.width / 2) ||
680:                                 (layoutDirection == LayoutDirection.Rtl && offset.x > size.width / 2)
681: 
682:                         if (isLeftSide) {
683:                             playerConnection.player.seekTo((currentPosition - skipAmount).coerceAtLeast(0))
684:                             onSeek(context.getString(R.string.seek_backward_dynamic, skipAmount / 1000), true)
685:                         } else {
686:                             playerConnection.player.seekTo((currentPosition + skipAmount).coerceAtMost(duration))
687:                             onSeek(context.getString(R.string.seek_forward_dynamic, skipAmount / 1000), true)
688:                         }
689:                     }
690:                 )
691:             },
692:         contentAlignment = Alignment.Center
693:     ) {
694:         val shape = if (rotatingThumbnail) {
695:             MaterialShapes.Clover8Leaf.toShape()
696:         } else {
697:             RoundedCornerShape(dimensions.cornerRadius)
698:         }
699: 
700:         Box(
701:             modifier = Modifier
702:                 .size(dimensions.thumbnailSize)
703:                 .graphicsLayer {
704:                     rotationZ = rotation
705:                 }
706:                 .then(
707:                     if (showPlayerThumbnailShadow) {
708:                         if (rotatingThumbnail) {
709:                             Modifier.shadow(
710:                                 elevation = playerThumbnailShadowElevation.dp,
711:                                 shape = shape,
712:                                 clip = false,
713:                                 ambientColor = Color.Black.copy(alpha = 0.4f),
714:                                 spotColor = Color.Black.copy(alpha = 0.4f)
715:                             )
716:                         } else {
717:                             Modifier.customSoftShadow(
718:                                 elevation = playerThumbnailShadowElevation.dp,
719:                                 cornerRadius = dimensions.cornerRadius,
720:                                 enabled = true
721:                             )
722:                         }
723:                     } else {
724:                         Modifier
725:                     }
726:                 ),
727:             contentAlignment = Alignment.Center
728:         ) {
729:             Box(
730:                 modifier = Modifier
731:                     .size(dimensions.thumbnailSize)
732:                     .clip(shape)
733:                     .graphicsLayer {
734:                         rotationZ = -rotation
735:                     }
736:             ) {
737:                 if (hidePlayerThumbnail) {
738:                     HiddenThumbnailPlaceholder(textBackgroundColor = textBackgroundColor)
739:                 } else {
740:                     val artworkUriToUse = if (item.mediaId == currentMediaId && !currentMediaThumbnail.isNullOrBlank()) {
741:                         currentMediaThumbnail
742:                     } else {
743:                         item.mediaMetadata.artworkUri?.toString()
744:                     }
745: 
746:                     ThumbnailImage(
747:                         artworkUri = artworkUriToUse?.resize(1200, 1200),
748:                         cropArtwork = cropAlbumArt
749:                     )
750:                 }
751: 
752:                 if (canvasThumbnailAnimation && item.mediaId == currentMediaId && !rotatingThumbnail && playerBackground != PlayerBackgroundStyle.APPLE_MUSIC && (!canvasLoadOnlyWifi || isWifiConnected(context))) {
753:                 val (motionartworkSource) = rememberEnumPreference(MotionartworkSourceKey, defaultValue = MotionartworkSource.AUTO)
754:                 val albumTitle = item.mediaMetadata.albumTitle?.toString()
755:                 var canvasArtwork by remember(item.mediaId, albumTitle) { mutableStateOf<Motionartwork?>(null) }
756:                 var canvasFetchInFlight by remember(item.mediaId, albumTitle) { mutableStateOf(false) }
757:                 val storefront = remember {
758:                     val country = Locale.getDefault().country
759:                     if (country.length == 2) country.lowercase(Locale.ROOT) else "us"
760:                 }
761: 
762:                 LaunchedEffect(item.mediaId, albumTitle, motionartworkSource) {
763:                     val cacheKey = "${item.mediaId}:${motionartworkSource.name}"
764:                     MotionartworkPlaybackCache.get(cacheKey)?.let { cached ->
765:                         canvasArtwork = cached
766:                         return@LaunchedEffect
767:                     }
768: 
769:                     if (canvasFetchInFlight) return@LaunchedEffect
770:                     canvasFetchInFlight = true
771: 
772:                     val fetched = withContext(Dispatchers.IO) {
773:                         val metadata = item.metadata
774:                         val albumName = (metadata?.album?.title ?: item.mediaMetadata.albumTitle)?.toString()
775:                         val duration = metadata?.duration
776: 
777:                         val songTitleRaw = item.mediaMetadata.title?.toString() ?: ""
778:                         val artistNameRaw = item.mediaMetadata.artist?.toString() ?: ""
779: 
780:                         val songTitle = songTitleRaw
781:                         val artistName = artistNameRaw
782: 
783:                         println("CanvasFetch: Song='$songTitle' (raw='$songTitleRaw'), Artist='$artistName' (raw='$artistNameRaw'), Album='$albumName'")
784: 
785:                         val searchTasks = listOf(
786:                             songTitleRaw to artistNameRaw
787:                         ).filter { (s, a) -> s.isNotBlank() && a.isNotBlank() }
788: 
789:                         when (motionartworkSource) {
790:                             MotionartworkSource.AUTO -> {
791:                                 searchTasks.firstNotNullOfOrNull { (s, a) ->
792:                                     val album = albumName ?: ""
793:                                     AppleMusicMotionartworkProvider.getBySongArtist(
794:                                         song = s,
795:                                         artist = a,

798:                                     )?.takeIf { !it.preferredAnimationUrl.isNullOrBlank() && validateMotionartworkMatch(it, s, a, album) }
799:                                         ?: TidalMotionartworkProvider.getBySongArtist(
800:                                             song = s,
801:                                             artist = a,
802:                                             album = albumName
803:                                         )?.takeIf { !it.preferredAnimationUrl.isNullOrBlank() && validateMotionartworkMatch(it, s, a, album) }
804:                                         ?: ViviMusicMotionartworkProvider.getBySongArtist(
805:                                             song = s,
806:                                             artist = a,
807:                                             album = album
808:                                         )?.takeIf { !it.preferredAnimationUrl.isNullOrBlank() && validateMotionartworkMatch(it, s, a, album) }
809:                                 }
810:                             }
811:                             MotionartworkSource.APPLE_MUSIC -> {
812:                                 searchTasks.firstNotNullOfOrNull { (s, a) ->
813:                                     AppleMusicMotionartworkProvider.getBySongArtist(
814:                                         song = s,
815:                                         artist = a,
816:                                         album = albumName,
817:                                         storefront = storefront
818:                                     )?.takeIf { !it.preferredAnimationUrl.isNullOrBlank() }
819:                                 }
820:                             }
821:                             MotionartworkSource.VIVIMUSIC -> {
822:                                 searchTasks.firstNotNullOfOrNull { (s, a) ->
823:                                     ViviMusicMotionartworkProvider.getBySongArtist(
824:                                         song = s,

827:                                     )?.takeIf { !it.preferredAnimationUrl.isNullOrBlank() }
828:                                 }
829:                             }
830:                             MotionartworkSource.TIDAL -> {
831:                                 searchTasks.firstNotNullOfOrNull { (s, a) ->
832:                                     TidalMotionartworkProvider.getBySongArtist(
833:                                         song = s,
834:                                         artist = a,
835:                                         album = albumName
836:                                     )?.takeIf { !it.preferredAnimationUrl.isNullOrBlank() }
837:                                 }
838:                             }
839:                         }
840:                     }
841: 
842:                     // Client-side safety check: ensure the fetched canvas matches the requested song
843:                     // This prevents "wrong canvas" if a provider returned a generic or incorrect match
844:                     val requestedArtist = item.mediaMetadata.artist?.toString() ?: ""
845:                     val requestedTitle = item.mediaMetadata.title?.toString() ?: ""
846: 
847:                     // For AUTO mode validation is already done per-provider inside takeIf.
848:                     // For single-source modes this block acts as the safety net.
849:                     val requestedAlbum = item.mediaMetadata.albumTitle?.toString() ?: ""
850:                     val validated = fetched?.let { artwork ->
851:                         val passes = validateMotionartworkMatch(artwork, requestedTitle, requestedArtist, requestedAlbum)
852:                         println("CanvasValidation: artistMatches=${artwork.artist.orEmpty().trim().equals(requestedArtist.trim(), ignoreCase = true)}, songMatches=${artwork.name.orEmpty().trim().equals(requestedTitle.trim(), ignoreCase = true)}, albumMatches=${artwork.albumName.orEmpty().trim().equals(requestedAlbum.trim(), ignoreCase = true)}")
853:                         println("  Requested: Title='$requestedTitle', Album='$requestedAlbum', Artists='$requestedArtist'")
854:                         println("  Returned: Title='${artwork.name}', Album='${artwork.albumName}', Artists='${artwork.artist}'")
855:                         if (passes) {

857:                             artwork

859:                             println("CanvasValidation: Match FAILED for '${artwork.name}' by '${artwork.artist}'")
860:                             null

862:                     }
863: 
864:                     canvasArtwork = validated

866:                         MotionartworkPlaybackCache.put("${item.mediaId}:${motionartworkSource.name}", validated)

868:                     canvasFetchInFlight = false
869:                 }
870: 
871:                 canvasArtwork?.let { artwork ->

978: /**
979:  * Strict canvas match: song title, artist, and album must all match exactly.
980:  * For artists, all listed artists must match (set-based comparison to handle different separators like commas or ampersands).
981:  * Returns true only if ALL three pass. Any one failing returns false.
982:  */
983: internal fun validateMotionartworkMatch(
984:     artwork: com.music.vivi.Motionartwork.Motionartwork,
985:     requestedTitle: String,
986:     requestedArtist: String,
987:     requestedAlbum: String
988: ): Boolean {
989:     val artist = artwork.artist
990:     val name = artwork.name
991:     val albumName = artwork.albumName
992: 
993:     val artistMatches = if (artist != null && requestedArtist.isNotBlank()) {
994:         val requestedList = splitAndNormalizeArtists(requestedArtist)
995:         val resultList = splitAndNormalizeArtists(artist)
996:         requestedList.isNotEmpty() && resultList.isNotEmpty() &&
997:             requestedList.size == resultList.size &&
998:             requestedList.all { req -> resultList.any { res -> res == req } }
999:     } else true
1000: 
1001:     val songMatches = if (name != null && requestedTitle.isNotBlank()) {
1002:         name.normalizeForComparison() == requestedTitle.normalizeForComparison()
1003:     } else true
1004: 
1005:     val albumMatches = if (albumName != null && requestedAlbum.isNotBlank()) {
1006:         albumName.normalizeForComparison() == requestedAlbum.normalizeForComparison()
1007:     } else false
1008: 
1009:     return artistMatches && songMatches && albumMatches
1010: }
1011: 
1012: internal fun splitAndNormalizeArtists(raw: String): List<String> {
1013:     return raw.split(
1014:         Regex(
1015:             "(?:\\s*,\\s*|\\s*&\\s*|\\s+×\\s+|\\s+x\\s+|\\bfeat\\.?\\b|\\bft\\.?\\b|\\bfeaturing\\b|\\bwith\\b)",
1016:             RegexOption.IGNORE_CASE,
1017:         )
1018:     ).map { it.normalizeForComparison() }
1019:         .filter { it.isNotBlank() }
1020: }

1022: fun Modifier.customSoftShadow(
1023:     elevation: Dp,
1024:     cornerRadius: Dp,

## Objective
- Build AURA Music as a GPL-3.0 local-only derivative of `vivizzz007/vivi-music`, preserving upstream history and attribution.
- Remove online/social features while supporting local media, scanning, folders, playlists/M3U, lyrics, persistent playback state, and core navigation.

## Requirements
- Document upstream architecture, requirement gaps, removals, remaining gaps, and verification results.
- Rebrand as AURA Music with monochrome styling while retaining upstream copyright notices and GPL-3.0 attribution.
- Remove or exclude streaming/scraping, presence, online artwork, telemetry/crash reporting, and OTA features; preserve local backup.
- Retain relevant tests, add tests for new code, build, and commit each stage.

## Decisions
- Work in `/tmp/opencode/aura-upstream`, retaining upstream history and remote `https://github.com/vivizzz007/vivi-music.git`.
- Detach Listen Together UI/navigation first; audit remaining callers before removing protocol/module code.
- Preserve MusicService persistence and local auto-backup; distinguish OTA updates from local backup.
- Remove guest-only restrictions while retaining ordinary player/menu actions and removing Listen Together suggestion actions.

## Work State
### Completed
- Verified upstream baseline build; documented architecture and gaps; committed `12fff80d docs(audit): document upstream architecture and AURA gaps`.
- Implemented AURA identity and monochrome branding; build passed and committed `2eac54c8 chore(branding): rebrand app as AURA Music`.
- Disabled automatic updater checks and new-release worker scheduling; committed `0fbd7791 chore(offline): disable automatic update checks`.
- Detached Listen Together from navigation, Settings, Appearance, top-bar logic, and routes; committed `a940b056 chore(offline): detach Listen Together UI`.
- Removed guest gating from local/YouTube song menu queue and radio actions; removed corresponding Listen Together manager state/imports.
- Fixed malformed action-list formatting in `YouTubeSongMenu.kt` and stripped trailing whitespace from modified files; `git diff --check` passed.

### Active
- Validate the current cleanup build: `bash gradlew :app:assembleDebug` is running in the background; completion is unconfirmed.
- Continue the Listen Together caller audit and determine which infrastructure and orphaned UI files can be removed.
- Update `docs/AURA_IMPLEMENTATION_LOG.md`, rerun verification, and commit the cleanup stage.
- Continue offline audit and implement/test local-media scanning/playback, folders, playlists/M3U, lyrics, and navigation.

### Blocked
- (none)

## Next Move
1. Confirm the running `:app:assembleDebug` result.
2. Finish auditing/removing Listen Together consumers, including `CommentTogether.kt`, `Thumbnail.kt`, composition-local consumers, DI providers, receiver, manifest filters, and protocol/module code.
3. Update the implementation log, run `git diff --check`, and commit the cleanup stage.

## Relevant Files
- `/tmp/opencode/aura-upstream/docs/AURA_IMPLEMENTATION_LOG.md`: progress log; cleanup stage is pending documentation and commit.
- `/tmp/opencode/aura-upstream/docs/AURA_UPSTREAM_AUDIT.md`: architecture, gaps, and removal/retention policy.
- `/tmp/opencode/aura-upstream/app/src/main/kotlin/com/music/vivi/ui/menu/SongMenu.kt`: guest-gate removals.
- `/tmp/opencode/aura-upstream/app/src/main/kotlin/com/music/vivi/ui/menu/YouTubeSongMenu.kt`: guest-gate removals and corrected action-list formatting.
- `/tmp/opencode/aura-upstream/app/src/main/kotlin/com/music/vivi/ui/screens/CommentTogether.kt`: remaining live manager consumer.
- `/tmp/opencode/aura-upstream/app/src/main/kotlin/com/music/vivi/ui/screens/ListenTogetherScreen.kt`: feature screen remains after navigation detachment.
- `/tmp/opencode/aura-upstream/app/src/main/kotlin/com/music/vivi/ui/player/Thumbnail.kt`: remaining Listen Together status indicator.
- `/tmp/opencode/aura-upstream/app/src/main/kotlin/com/music/vivi/MainActivity.kt`: composition-local declaration remains.
- `/tmp/opencode/aura-upstream/app/src/main/kotlin/com/music/vivi/di/AppModule.kt`: Listen Together DI providers remain.
- `/tmp/opencode/aura-upstream/app/src/main/AndroidManifest.xml`: action receiver remains.
- `/tmp/opencode/aura-upstream/app/src/main/kotlin/com/music/vivi/listentogether/`: protocol manager/client and action receiver await caller audit.

## Important Context
- Cleanup changes are uncommitted across 27 files on `main`; the branch was previously four commits ahead of `origin/main`.
- A previous `:app:assembleDebug` invocation timed out after 120 seconds without reporting a compile failure; a new background run is in progress.
- Auditing found remaining references in `PlayerConnection.kt`, `AppModule.kt`, `PreferenceKeys.kt`, `MainActivity.kt`, `Thumbnail.kt`, and `CommentTogether.kt`; feature-only settings/viewmodel/screen files and localization strings also remain.
- `PlayerConnection.shouldBlockPlaybackChanges` and `allowInternalSync` assignments remain in `ListenTogetherManager.kt`; verify all uses before removing related fields.
- App-owned Ktor consumers include remote stream extraction, online lyrics, GitHub operations, Wikipedia, and Apple Music album descriptions; online modules include `:innertube`, `:jiosaavn`, `:spotify`, `:lastfm`, `:kizzy`, `:shazamkit`, `:artistvideo`, `:Motionartwork`, and `:lyricsProvider`.
- `INTERNET` and `ACCESS_NETWORK_STATE` are declared; Last.fm API credentials are embedded in `app/build.gradle.kts`; no Firebase Analytics/Crashlytics, Sentry, Amplitude, or PostHog SDK references were found.

## Objective
- Build AURA Music as a GPL-3.0 local-only derivative of `vivizzz007/vivi-music`, preserving upstream history and attribution.
- Remove online/social features while supporting local media, scanning, folders, playlists/M3U, lyrics, persistent playback state, and core navigation.

## Requirements
- Document upstream architecture, requirement gaps, removals, remaining gaps, and verification results.
- Rebrand as AURA Music with monochrome styling while retaining upstream copyright notices and GPL-3.0 attribution.
- Remove or exclude streaming/scraping, presence, online artwork, telemetry/crash reporting, and OTA features; preserve local backup.
- Retain relevant tests, add tests for new code, build, and commit each stage.

## Decisions
- Work in `/tmp/opencode/aura-upstream`, retaining upstream history and remote `https://github.com/vivizzz007/vivi-music.git`.
- Detach Listen Together UI/navigation first; audit remaining callers before removing protocol/module code.
- Preserve MusicService persistence and local auto-backup; distinguish OTA updates from local backup.
- Remove guest-only restrictions while retaining ordinary player/menu actions and removing Listen Together suggestion actions.

## Work State
### Completed
- Verified upstream baseline build; documented architecture and gaps; committed `12fff80d docs(audit): document upstream architecture and AURA gaps`.
- Implemented AURA identity and monochrome branding; build passed and committed `2eac54c8 chore(branding): rebrand app as AURA Music`.
- Disabled automatic updater checks and new-release worker scheduling; committed `0fbd7791 chore(offline): disable automatic update checks`.
- Detached Listen Together from navigation, Settings, Appearance, top-bar logic, and routes; committed `a940b056 chore(offline): detach Listen Together UI`.
- Removed guest gating from local/YouTube song menu queue and radio actions; removed corresponding Listen Together manager state/imports.
- Fixed malformed action-list formatting in `YouTubeSongMenu.kt` and stripped trailing whitespace from modified files.
- `bash gradlew :app:assembleDebug` succeeded after the current cleanup changes; `git diff --check` passed.

### Active
- Finish the Listen Together caller audit and remove safe-to-delete infrastructure and orphaned UI.
- Update `docs/AURA_IMPLEMENTATION_LOG.md`, rerun verification, and commit the cleanup stage.
- Continue the offline audit and implement/test local-media scanning/playback, folders, playlists/M3U, lyrics, and navigation.

### Blocked
- (none)

## Next Move
1. Audit remaining Listen Together consumers, including `CommentTogether.kt`, `Thumbnail.kt`, composition-local consumers, DI providers, receiver, manifest filters, and protocol/module code.
2. Remove confirmed orphaned code and feature-only resources/settings; check all remaining references before deleting modules or shared fields.
3. Update the implementation log, run `git diff --check` and the build, then commit the cleanup stage.

## Relevant Files
- `/tmp/opencode/aura-upstream/docs/AURA_IMPLEMENTATION_LOG.md`: progress log; cleanup stage awaits documentation and commit.
- `/tmp/opencode/aura-upstream/docs/AURA_UPSTREAM_AUDIT.md`: architecture, gaps, and removal/retention policy.
- `/tmp/opencode/aura-upstream/app/src/main/kotlin/com/music/vivi/listentogether/`: protocol manager/client and action receiver to audit.
- `/tmp/opencode/aura-upstream/app/src/main/kotlin/com/music/vivi/ui/screens/CommentTogether.kt`: remaining live manager consumer.
- `/tmp/opencode/aura-upstream/app/src/main/kotlin/com/music/vivi/ui/player/Thumbnail.kt`: remaining Listen Together status indicator.
- `/tmp/opencode/aura-upstream/app/src/main/kotlin/com/music/vivi/MainActivity.kt`: composition-local declaration remains.
- `/tmp/opencode/aura-upstream/app/src/main/kotlin/com/music/vivi/di/AppModule.kt`: Listen Together DI providers remain.
- `/tmp/opencode/aura-upstream/app/src/main/AndroidManifest.xml`: action receiver remains.
- `/tmp/opencode/aura-upstream/app/src/main/kotlin/com/music/vivi/playback/PlayerConnection.kt`: remaining synchronization/blocking references to audit.
- `/tmp/opencode/aura-upstream/app/src/main/kotlin/com/music/vivi/constants/PreferenceKeys.kt`: Listen Together preference keys remain.

## Important Context
- Current branch is `main`, four commits ahead of `origin/main`; cleanup changes remain uncommitted across 27 files.
- The latest `:app:assembleDebug` finished with `BUILD SUCCESSFUL in 14s`; this validates the current cleanup state, not later edits.
- Listen Together references were found in `PlayerConnection.kt`, `AppModule.kt`, `PreferenceKeys.kt`, `MainActivity.kt`, `Thumbnail.kt`, `CommentTogether.kt`, and the manifest; feature-only settings/viewmodel/screen files and localization strings also remain.
- `PlayerConnection.shouldBlockPlaybackChanges` and `allowInternalSync` assignments in `ListenTogetherManager.kt` require use-site checks before removal.
- App-owned Ktor consumers include remote stream extraction, online lyrics, GitHub operations, Wikipedia, and Apple Music album descriptions; online modules include `:innertube`, `:jiosaavn`, `:spotify`, `:lastfm`, `:kizzy`, `:shazamkit`, `:artistvideo`, `:Motionartwork`, and `:lyricsProvider`.
- `INTERNET` and `ACCESS_NETWORK_STATE` are declared; Last.fm API credentials are embedded in `app/build.gradle.kts`; no Firebase Analytics/Crashlytics, Sentry, Amplitude, or PostHog SDK references were found.

1: # AURA Music: upstream architecture and gap audit
2: 
3: Audit basis: upstream `vivizzz007/vivi-music` at `b10bf919` (`ci: remove nightly telegram workflow`), reviewed 2026-11-03. The repository is GPL-3.0. This document distinguishes the code that exists at that revision from the requested AURA Music local-only product scope.
4: 
5: ## Build and project configuration
6: 
7: - Root Gradle project name: `vivimusic`; Android application module: `:app`.
8: - The app uses Kotlin, Jetpack Compose, Hilt, Room/KSP, DataStore, Media3, and Protocol Buffers.
9: - Android namespace: `com.music.vivi`; application ID: `com.vivi.vivimusic`.
10: - `minSdk = 26`, `compileSdk = 37`, `targetSdk = 37`; Java and Kotlin JVM target 21.
11: - Build flavors include `foss`/`gms` and universal/ABI variants. The `foss` flavor disables Cast availability; the GMS flavor enables it.
12: - `app/build.gradle.kts` contains embedded Last.fm API key and secret values. These are upstream credentials and must not be copied into an offline AURA build.
13: - The upstream baseline was verified with `bash ./gradlew assembleDebug --no-configuration-cache --console=plain` (757 actionable tasks; 120 executed, 637 up-to-date). The wrapper file is not executable in this checkout, hence the explicit `bash` invocation.
14: 
15: ## Module map
16: 
17: | Module | Upstream role | AURA disposition |
18: | --- | --- | --- |
19: | `:app` | Android UI, app lifecycle, dependency injection, Room, Media3 service, widgets and integrations | Retain and rework for AURA local playback |
20: | `:innertube` | YouTube Music/Innertube networking and extraction | Remove from AURA runtime/build |
21: | `:jiosaavn` | JioSaavn search/streaming integration | Remove from AURA runtime/build |
22: | `:spotify` | Spotify API/Canvas integration | Remove from AURA runtime/build |
23: | `:lastfm` | Last.fm integration/scrobbling | Remove from AURA runtime/build |
24: | `:kizzy` | Discord rich-presence integration | Remove from AURA runtime/build |
25: | `:shazamkit` | ShazamKit integration | Remove from AURA runtime/build |
26: | `:artistvideo` | Artist-video feature | Remove from AURA runtime/build |
27: | `:Motionartwork` | Motion artwork/Canvas provider | Remove from AURA runtime/build |
28: | `:lyricsProvider` | Online lyrics providers/scraping | Remove from AURA runtime/build; retain only sidecar/local lyrics support if needed |
29: 
30: The exact dependency edges and unused code should be rechecked as each module is detached; deleting source modules before Gradle references and UI entry points are removed risks breaking compilation.
31: 
32: ## Architecture findings
33: 
34: ### Dependency injection
35: 
36: The app is Hilt-based. `app/src/main/kotlin/com/music/vivi/di/AppModule.kt` supplies application-level dependencies, including cache-related objects. Feature and persistence services are injected into ViewModels and the playback service. AURA should keep Hilt and bind local catalog/scanner and local-file access abstractions rather than online providers.
37: 
38: ### Database and persistence
39: 
40: `app/src/main/kotlin/com/music/vivi/db/MusicDatabase.kt` and `DatabaseDao.kt` define the Room database and queries. Upstream already has catalog-oriented song/album/artist/playlist data and database migrations. Playback queue/player state is persisted through the existing preference/state layer. The upstream database is designed primarily around remote catalog IDs and metadata; local URI, stable file identity, folder membership, and scan state are not established as a complete local-library model. Prefer additive schema changes with migrations, not destructive recreation.
41: 
42: M3U import/export exists in `BackupRestoreViewModel.kt` and `utils/PlaylistExporter.kt`, but it is oriented around playlist/catalog metadata and does not provide complete robust resolution of local filesystem entries into playable tracks. AURA needs path/URI-aware import/export and missing-file handling.
43: 
44: ### Playback
45: 
46: `playback/MusicService.kt` uses Media3 and persists playback state; `MediaLibrarySessionCallback.kt` exposes a media library/session. Existing media item construction (`extensions/MediaItemExt.kt`) assumes upstream media identities and can participate in remote stream resolution. AURA must ensure that queue items use local content URIs and that the service resolves only locally authorized media, with notification/background playback and restart restoration retained.
47: 
48: No local-device media scanner or end-to-end local-file playback path was found in the audited app source. Local permission handling, MediaStore indexing, folder browsing and selection, and `.lrc` sidecar discovery are gaps.
49: 
50: ### UI, navigation, and theme
51: 
52: The interface is a large Jetpack Compose application with player, library, search, settings, playlist, online integration, and updater routes. `ui/screens/NavigationBuilder.kt` includes online integrations. The theme is defined in `ui/theme/Theme.kt`, including Material You/dynamic color behavior. AURA requires its own monochrome palette/assets and a pared-down primary navigation for Home, Search, Library and Settings. Search should only search the indexed local catalog.
53: 
54: Canvas is overloaded in upstream source to refer both to the online animated artwork feature and to Compose drawing primitives. Removing animated online Canvas artwork must not remove Compose `Canvas` uses for sliders, lyric rendering, or other local UI drawing.
55: 
56: ## Requirement-by-requirement gap analysis
57: 
58: | Requirement | Status at upstream revision | Evidence / work required |
59: | --- | --- | --- |
60: | GPL-3.0 derivative with upstream history and remote preserved | Exists as foundation | Repository has upstream history and `origin`; retain LICENSE and relevant copyright notices, document AURA modifications and attribution. |
61: | AURA Music name, monochrome identity and assets | Missing | Project/app branding remains Vivi Music; update app labels, icons, splash/metadata, theme and documentation without removing upstream notices. |
62: | Local-only operation; no network audio/metadata acquisition | Missing | Innertube, JioSaavn, Spotify and lyrics provider integrations are included. Remove dependencies/routes and ensure local player has no network fallback. |
63: | Local device audio scanning/indexing | Missing | No complete MediaStore scanner was found. Implement permission-aware scan, refresh and catalog persistence. |
64: | Folder browsing | Missing | Build a local folder view backed by indexed local URIs/paths. |
65: | Local file playback | Missing | Existing Media3 session/player is reusable, but local content URI construction/resolution is not a full app path. |
66: | M3U import/export for local tracks | Partial | Import/export utilities exist, but local paths, URI permissions, unavailable items and local queue mapping need implementation and tests. |
67: | Local `.lrc` lyrics | Missing | Existing lyrics are provider/online oriented; implement same-directory sidecar lookup and timed/plain text parsing. |
68: | Persistent queue and playback position | Partial / present | Existing database/preferences and service persist player state. Verify restart restoration specifically for local content URIs and update/add regression tests. |
69: | Home, Search, Library, Settings navigation | Partial | Equivalent navigation and settings exist among larger online-oriented surfaces; simplify and rewire search/library to local data only. |
70: | Remove Discord presence | Present upstream; remove | `:kizzy` and associated preferences/service/UI must not be included. |
71: | Remove animated Canvas/artwork online features | Present upstream; remove | `:Motionartwork`, Spotify Canvas, artwork fetching and related settings/routes; retain ordinary Compose drawing Canvas. |
72: | Remove analytics and crash telemetry | No targeted analytics/crash SDK found in inspected app source | No Firebase Analytics/Crashlytics, Sentry, Amplitude or PostHog symbols were found by the initial targeted search. Recheck all dependencies, manifest providers and build plugins before claiming removal. |
73: | Remove OTA/updater | Present upstream; remove | Updater workers, download/install flows, release checks, update routes/notifications and update-specific permissions should be removed. |
74: | Remove hard-coded online credentials | Present upstream; remove | Last.fm values in `app/build.gradle.kts` must be deleted along with the provider integration. |
75: | Tests for local behavior and retained behavior | Missing for new functionality | Keep applicable upstream tests; add scanner, M3U, lyrics, URI playback/persistence tests and run available test/build tasks per stage. |
76: 
77: ## Removal and retention policy
78: 
79: Remove networking and online service integrations, not useful local Android infrastructure. Retain the Media3 playback service/session, Room and migrations, queue state, local playlist management, notification/background playback, widgets only if they work wholly from local data, and Compose drawing primitives. Explicitly document removed features and do not leave reachable UI routes or hidden background work for the removed services.
80: 
81: ## Staged implementation and verification
82: 
83: Changes are intended to be split into small buildable commits: (1) audit/branding and app identity; (2) offline scope and online feature detachment; (3) local catalog/scanning and folder UI; (4) local playback and persistent queue; (5) local playlists and lyrics; (6) final navigation/theme/docs and full requirement review. Each stage should run its narrow tests and compile check before committing. The baseline build is not evidence that the AURA modifications compile.

153: private fun createExportFile(

158:     val exportDir = File(context.getExternalFilesDir(Environment.DIRECTORY_DOCUMENTS), "ViviMusicExports")
159:     if (!exportDir.exists()) {
160:         exportDir.mkdirs()
161:     }
162: 
163:     // Create file with unique name (add timestamp if file exists)
164:     val baseFilename = filename.substringBeforeLast('.')
165:     val extension = filename.substringAfterLast('.', "")
166:     var exportFile = File(exportDir, filename)
167:     var counter = 1
168: 
169:     while (exportFile.exists()) {
170:         val newFilename =
171:             if (extension.isNotEmpty()) {
172:                 "${baseFilename}_$counter.$extension"
173:             } else {
174:                 "${baseFilename}_$counter"
175:             }
176:         exportFile = File(exportDir, newFilename)
177:         counter++
178:     }
179: 
180:     exportFile.createNewFile()

213:

217:                     put(MediaStore.MediaColumns.MIME_TYPE, mimeType)
218:                     put(MediaStore.MediaColumns.RELATIVE_PATH, relativePath)
219:                     put(MediaStore.MediaColumns.IS_PENDING, 1)
220:                 }
221: 
222:             // Use the primary external volume for generic files
223:             val collection = MediaStore.Files.getContentUri(MediaStore.VOLUME_EXTERNAL_PRIMARY)
224:             val destUri =
225:                 resolver.insert(collection, values)
226:                     ?: return Result.failure(IOException("Failed to create destination in MediaStore"))
227: 
228:             resolver.openOutputStream(destUri)?.use { out ->
229:                 source.inputStream().use { input ->
230:                     input.copyTo(out)
231:                 }
232:             } ?: return Result.failure(IOException("Failed to open output stream for MediaStore uri"))
233: 
234:             // Mark as not pending so it becomes visible
235:             val complete = ContentValues().apply { put(MediaStore.MediaColumns.IS_PENDING, 0) }
236:             resolver.update(destUri, complete, null, null)
237:
